descriptionByLocale.de:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Sulzer ist ein führendes Engineering-Unternehmen mit einer reichen Innovationstradition. Werden Sie Teil unseres globalen Teams, um Ihre Expertise zu erweitern und innovative Lösungen zu entwickeln, die eine wohlhabende und nachhaltigere Gesellschaft ermöglichen.

Sulzer Chemtech fertigt Stoffaustauschkomponenten für die chemische und petrochemische Industrie. Produktionsmitarbeiter im Bereich «Biege-, Laser- und Stanzmaschinen» sind verantwortlich die Fertigung von Bauteilen für unsere Verteiler, Böden, und anderen Kolonneneinbauten.

Sulzer bietet Ihnen eine Vielfalt von Möglichkeiten, Ihre Karriere in die von Ihnen gewünschte Richtung zu lenken, je nach Ihren Fähigkeiten und Interessen. Wir laden Sie ein, sich zu bewerben, wenn Sie bereit sind, den nächsten Schritt zu tun.

Karrierechance: Mitarbeiter/in für die Herstellung von strukturierten Packungen (m/w/d) bei Sulzer Chemtech in Essen. Aufgaben und Verantwortlichkeiten:

• Herstellen von strukturierten Packungen nach Vorgaben und Zeitplänen

• Arbeitsplätze: Stanzen und Nuten, Biegen, Schneiden, Montieren, Qualitätskontrolle, Verpacken

• Arbeiten an automatischen und halbautomatischen Produktionslinien mit maßgeschneiderten Produktionsanlagen

• Arbeit im Schichtbetrieb

• Durchführung von Einstellungen und Anpassungen von Maschinen zur Gewährleistung von Geschwindigkeit und Qualität der Produktionsleistung

• Mitwirkung bei der Durchführung von Projekten an allen Arbeitsplätzen in der strukturierten Verpackungswerkstatt

• Meldung von Nichtkonformitäten und Abweichungen von den Produktionsplänen an den Vorarbeiter der Verpackungswerkstatt

• Beitrag zu kontinuierlichen Verbesserungsmaßnahmen in Zusammenarbeit mit der Qualitätsabteilung

• Arbeit in Übereinstimmung mit allen relevanten Richtlinien, Prozessen und Standardarbeitsanweisungen

• Arbeit in Übereinstimmung mit den Richtlinien für Umwelt, Sicherheit und Gesundheit

• Andere produktionsbezogene Aufgaben und Projekte nach Zuweisung.

Anforderungen:

• Handwerkliche / Technische Ausbildung, Werkstattausbildung

• Mindestens 3-5 Jahre Berufserfahrung in diesen Bereichen

• Expertise: Kenntnisse der Fertigungsverfahren Schneiden, Stanzen, Biegen und Schweißen von Blechen

• Affinität zu aufmerksamer und qualitätsorientierter Zusammenarbeit mit Menschen unterschiedlicher Herkunft und Nationalität

• Verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse

What we offer you

Wir bieten:

• Attraktive Vergütung

• Unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag

• 30 Tage Urlaub

• JobRad

• Kostenlose Parkplätze auf dem Betriebsgelände

• Betriebliche Sonderleistungen (z.B. Altersvorsorge, Familienservice-Hotline)

Für diese Stelle können wir keine Unterstützung zum Erhalt eines Visums oder einer Arbeitserlaubnis bieten.

Sulzer ist ein Arbeitgeber, der Chancengleichheit und Gleichbehandlung fördert. Wir setzen uns für personelle Vielfalt ein.
83 % unserer Mitarbeitenden empfehlen Sulzer als guten Arbeitgeber und wir sind stolz darauf, in Brasilien, China, Deutschland, der Schweiz, dem Vereinigten Königreich und den Vereinigten Staaten als Top-Arbeitgeber 2024 ausgezeichnet zu sein. Kommen Sie und nehmen Sie an unserer Geschichte teil!

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer è una società di ingegneria leader con un patrimonio orgoglioso di innovazione. Unisciti al nostro team globale per accrescere le tue competenze e sviluppare soluzioni innovative che consentano una società prospera e più sostenibile.

Informazioni sul ruolo

Sulzer sta cercando un esperto Direttore HR – Messico per guidare la funzione HR per le nostre operazioni in Messico e servire come partner strategico di business per la leadership senior e operativa.

Questo ruolo richiede un leader che può combinare il pensiero strategico con la leadership HR hands-on in un ambiente di produzione. Il Direttore delle Risorse Umane guiderà la trasformazione organizzativa, la pianificazione della forza lavoro, la cultura e le iniziative di talento pur mantenendo una forte supervisione delle relazioni di lavoro, delle relazioni con i dipendenti e delle operazioni HR.

Il candidato di successo porterà forte acume aziendale, presenza esecutiva e una capacità dimostrata di tradurre le strategie delle persone in azioni pratiche e risultati aziendali misurabili.

Principali responsabilità

• Servire come partner strategico delle risorse umane per la leadership senior e operativa, allineare le strategie delle persone con priorità aziendali e prestazioni.

• Leader iniziative di cambiamento organizzativo e di trasformazione, tra cui progettazione organizzativa, strategie di comunicazione, allineamento degli stakeholder e gestione della resistenza al cambiamento.

• Rafforzare la cultura organizzativa, la capacità di leadership, l'impegno dei dipendenti e la responsabilità.

• Guida pianificazione strategica della forza lavoro, tra cui previsioni del lavoro, pianificazione di successione, pipeline di talento, ritenzione e sviluppo di abilità critiche.

• Lead dipendente e rapporti di lavoro, tra cui contrattazione collettiva, relazioni sindacali, risoluzione di conflitti e questioni complesse dei dipendenti.

• Utilizza metriche operative e finanziarie per identificare le sfide della forza lavoro e dimostrare l’impatto delle risorse umane sulla produttività, sulle prestazioni e sulla redditività.

• Assicurare una forte governance delle risorse umane, conformità, etica e adesione ai requisiti del lavoro messicano.

• Miglioramento continuo dei processi HR, dei sistemi e della fornitura di servizi, comprese le opportunità di automazione e digitalizzazione.

• Costruire e sviluppare un team HR altamente performante in grado di bilanciare le priorità strategiche con le esigenze operative del business.

Qualificazioni richieste

• Laurea in Risorse umane, Business Administration o un campo relativo.

• Avanzata esperienza di carriera HR con una crescita dimostrata in più discipline HR e crescente responsabilità di leadership.

• È richiesta un'esperienza HR per la produzione e/o l'automotive.

• Esperienza dimostrata che supporta le operazioni degli impianti e le popolazioni dipendenti orali e salariate.

• Esperienza comprovata personalmente principali iniziative di cambiamento organizzativo, trasformazione e/o progettazione organizzativa.

• Forte pianificazione strategica della forza lavoro, pianificazione della successione e esperienza di gestione del talento.

• Esperienza significativa dei rapporti tra i dipendenti e il lavoro, compresi gli ambienti di contrattazione collettiva e sindacali.

• Forte acume aziendale con la capacità di collegare le strategie HR e metriche alle prestazioni operative e finanziarie.

• Dimostrata capacità di influenzare e collaborare con i dirigenti aziendali senior.

• Forte conoscenza delle pratiche del lavoro messicano, della conformità e delle relazioni con i dipendenti.

• Fluente spagnolo e forte capacità di comunicazione professionale inglese.

Preferito

• Esperienza di leadership HR multi-sito o regionale.

• Esperienza all'interno di un'organizzazione multinazionale o matrice.

• Esperienza leader HR digitalizzazione, automazione o iniziative di miglioramento continuo.

Cosa stiamo cercando
Siamo alla ricerca di un leader di risorse umane strategiche, che è altrettanto confortevole con la leadership senior e la comprensione delle realtà del piano di produzione. Il candidato ideale ha personalmente portato cambiamenti significativi, ha costruito culture organizzative più forti, gestito ambienti di lavoro complessi e può dimostrare come la loro leadership HR ha contribuito a risultati aziendali misurabili.

Cosa ti offriamo

• Vantaggi Per legge

• Risparmio trovato

• Formazione

• Cofano di Natale
descriptionByLocale.en:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Sulzer is seeking an experienced HR Director –Mexico to lead the HR function for our Mexico operations and serve as a strategic business partner to senior and operational leadership.

This role requires a leader who can combine strategic thinking with hands-on HR leadership in a manufacturing environment . The HR Director will lead organizational transformation, workforce planning, culture and talent initiatives while maintaining strong oversight of labor relations, employee relations and HR operations.

The successful candidate will bring strong business acumen, executive presence and a demonstrated ability to translate people strategies into practical actions and measurable business results.

Key Responsibilities

• Serve as a strategic HR partner to senior and operational leadership, aligning people strategies with business priorities and performance.

• Lead organizational change and transformation initiatives, including organizational design, communication strategies, stakeholder alignment and management of resistance to change.

• Strengthen organizational culture, leadership capability, employee engagement and accountability.

• Lead strategic workforce planning, including labor forecasting, succession planning, talent pipelines, retention and critical skill development.

• Lead employee and labor relations, including collective bargaining, union relationships, conflict resolution and complex employee matters.

• Use HR, operational and financial metrics to identify workforce challenges and demonstrate HR’s impact on productivity, performance and profitability.

• Ensure strong HR governance, compliance, ethics and adherence to Mexican labor requirements.

• Drive continuous improvement of HR processes, systems and service delivery, including opportunities for automation and digitalization.

• Build and develop a high-performing HR team capable of balancing strategic priorities with the operational needs of the business.

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration or a related field.

• Progressive HR career experience with demonstrated growth across multiple HR disciplines and increasing leadership responsibility.

• Manufacturing and/or automotive HR experience is required.

• Demonstrated experience supporting plant operations and both hourly and salaried employee populations.

• Proven experience personally leading organizational change, transformation and/or organizational design initiatives.

• Strong strategic workforce planning, succession planning and talent management experience.

• Significant employee and labor relations experience, including union and collective bargaining environments.

• Strong business acumen with the ability to connect HR strategies and metrics to operational and financial performance.

• Demonstrated ability to influence and partner with senior business leaders.

• Strong knowledge of Mexican labor practices, compliance and employee relations.

• Fluent Spanish and strong professional English communication skills.

Preferred

• Multi-site or regional HR leadership experience.

• Experience within a multinational or matrixed organization.

• Experience leading HR digitalization, automation or continuous-improvement initiatives.

What We’re Looking For
We are seeking a hands-on, strategic HR leader who is equally comfortable partnering with senior leadership and understanding the realities of the manufacturing floor. The ideal candidate has personally led meaningful change, built stronger organizational cultures, managed complex labor environments and can demonstrate how their HR leadership has contributed to measurable business results.

What we offer you

• Benefits Over law

• Saving found

• Training

• Christmas bon
descriptionByLocale.de:
Sulzer ist ein führendes Ingenieurunternehmen mit einem stolzen Erbe an Innovationen. Schließen Sie sich unserem globalen Team an, um Ihr Fachwissen zu erweitern und innovative Lösungen zu entwickeln, die eine prosperierende und nachhaltigere Gesellschaft ermöglichen.

Über die Rolle

Sulzer sucht einen erfahrenen HR Director – Mexiko, der die HR-Funktion für unsere mexikanischen Betriebe leitet und als strategischer Geschäftspartner für die leitende und operative Führung fungiert.

Diese Rolle erfordert eine Führungskraft, die strategisches Denken mit praktischer HR-Führung in einer Fertigungsumgebung kombinieren kann. Der HR Director wird organisatorische Transformation, Personalplanung, Kultur- und Talentinitiativen leiten und gleichzeitig eine starke Aufsicht über Arbeitsbeziehungen, Mitarbeiterbeziehungen und HR-Operationen behalten.

Der erfolgreiche Kandidat bringt starken Geschäftssinn, Führungspräsenz und eine nachgewiesene Fähigkeit, Menschenstrategien in praktische Maßnahmen und messbare Geschäftsergebnisse zu übersetzen.

Hauptzuständigkeiten

• Dienen Sie als strategischer HR-Partner für leitende und operative Führungskräfte und richten Sie die Strategien der Mitarbeiter an den Geschäftsprioritäten und der Leistung aus.

• Führen Sie organisatorische Veränderungen und Transformationsinitiativen, einschließlich Organisationsdesign, Kommunikationsstrategien, Ausrichtung der Stakeholder und Management von Widerstand gegen Veränderungen.

• Stärkung der Organisationskultur, der Führungsfähigkeit, des Mitarbeiterengagements und der Rechenschaftspflicht.

• Führen Sie die strategische Personalplanung, einschließlich Arbeitsprognosen, Nachfolgeplanung, Talentpipelines, Bindung und Entwicklung kritischer Fähigkeiten.

• Führen Sie Mitarbeiter- und Arbeitsbeziehungen, einschließlich Tarifverhandlungen, Gewerkschaftsbeziehungen, Konfliktlösung und komplexe Mitarbeiterangelegenheiten.

• Verwenden Sie Personal-, Betriebs- und Finanzkennzahlen, um die Herausforderungen der Belegschaft zu identifizieren und die Auswirkungen der Personalabteilung auf Produktivität, Leistung und Rentabilität zu demonstrieren.

• Gewährleistung einer starken HR-Governance, Compliance, Ethik und Einhaltung der mexikanischen Arbeitsanforderungen.

• Förderung der kontinuierlichen Verbesserung der HR-Prozesse, -Systeme und der Servicebereitstellung, einschließlich der Möglichkeiten zur Automatisierung und Digitalisierung.

• Aufbau und Entwicklung eines leistungsstarken HR-Teams, das in der Lage ist, strategische Prioritäten mit den operativen Anforderungen des Unternehmens in Einklang zu bringen.

Benötigte Qualifikationen

• Bachelor-Abschluss in Human Resources, Business Administration oder einem verwandten Bereich.

• Progressive HR-Karriereerfahrung mit nachgewiesenem Wachstum in mehreren HR-Disziplinen und zunehmender Führungsverantwortung.

• Fertigung und / oder Automotive HR Erfahrung ist erforderlich.

• Nachgewiesene Erfahrung in der Unterstützung des Betriebs von Werken und sowohl stündlich als auch angestellt.

• Nachgewiesene Erfahrung in der persönlichen Leitung organisatorischer Veränderungs-, Transformations- und/oder Organisationsdesign-Initiativen.

• Starke strategische Personalplanung, Nachfolgeplanung und Talentmanagement-Erfahrung.

• Bedeutende Erfahrung mit Arbeitnehmern und Arbeitsbeziehungen, einschließlich gewerkschaftlicher und kollektiver Verhandlungsumgebungen.

About the role

The Application & Tendering Engineer is responsible for developing technical and commercial solutions for municipal and industrial wastewater treatment plants, supporting the preparation of competitive bids and tenders.
The role combines process understanding, application engineering, and tendering activities, with a strong focus on selecting, designing, and integrating treatment technologies based on customer requirements, project constraints, and applicable standards.

• Analyze RFQs, tender documents, and technical specifications related to wastewater treatment plants (WWTPs) , both civil and industrial .

• Develop complete technical and commercial proposals , ensuring compliance with process requirements, client expectations, and internal guidelines.

• Coordinate with internal departments (process engineering, mechanical engineering, procurement, finance, projects) to collect inputs for bids.

• Perform cost estimation, material take-offs, and preparation of BOQs for water and wastewater treatment solutions.

• Ensure timely and accurate submission of tenders and clarification responses.

Application Engineering & Process Support

• Secondary (biological) treatment

• Tertiary and polishing steps

• Sludge treatment and handling (where applicable)

• Prepare process descriptions, technical datasheets, layouts, and technical clarifications .

• Support and participate in technical meetings, workshops, and presentations with customers, consultants, EPC contractors, and authorities.

Client, Consultant & Vendor Interface

• Liaise with clients, consultants, technology partners, and EPC contractors to clarify process and technical aspects during the tender phase.

• Interface with suppliers and manufacturers to obtain quotations, technical data, and delivery information.

Post‑Bid Support & Project Handover

• Ensure a structured handover of awarded projects to the execution team, including all technical, commercial, and process documentation.

Organizational & Knowledge Sharing

• Strong understanding of treatment technologies, plant layouts, and process interfaces .

• Experience in tenders for EPC or public sector projects is a strong advantage.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Als lokaler IT Spezialist sind Sie die zentrale Ansprechperson der regionalen IT an unserem Produktionsstandort in Essen. In dieser Rolle stellen Sie den stabilen, regelkonformen und praxisnahen IT-Betrieb vor Ort sicher und übernehmen zugleich eine wichtige Schnittstellenfunktion zwischen zentralen IT-Einheiten, Produktionsbereichen und lokalem Management.
Ihre Aufgaben
Sie bringen fundierte Erfahrung in mindestens zwei der folgenden Aufgabenfelder mit:

• Betrieb und Weiterentwicklung der lokalen Hyper-V-Infrastruktur

• Sicherstellung der Backup-Compliance unter Berücksichtigung regulatorischer Anforderungen der chemischen Industrie, einschließlich Backup- und Restore-Verfahren, B2D und B2T

• Netzwerkadministration mit Schwerpunkt auf Cisco-Komponenten, VLAN-Management und strukturierter Verkabelung; idealerweise ergänzt um erste Erfahrung in der Integration von OT-Komponenten

• 2nd-Level-Support für Fachbereiche in Produktion und Verwaltung, insbesondere im Umfeld von Client- und Mobile-Device-Management

• Betreuung und Management von Drucklösungen, insbesondere Multifunktionsgeräten und Barcodedruckern

• Beschaffung, technische Bewertung und Integration von IT-Komponenten in das Unternehmensnetzwerk

Darüber hinaus wirken Sie regelmäßig an der lokalen Umsetzung konzernweiter IT-Projekte mit. Sie übersetzen zentrale Anforderungen in konkrete standortbezogene Arbeitspakete, koordinieren die technische Realisierung vor Ort und bewegen sich sicher in arbeitsteiligen Organisationsstrukturen.

Die Rolle erfordert neben technischem Know-how ein hohes Maß an Kommunikations- und Abstimmungsfähigkeit: Sie verstehen die Anforderungen des Produktionsumfelds ebenso wie die Erwartungen des Site Managements und agieren als verlässlicher Business Partner zwischen IT und operativem Geschäft.

Je nach Profil und Eignung ist zudem eine Mitarbeit in bereichsübergreifenden Teams möglich, beispielsweise in den Bereichen Client Management, Netzwerk, Rechenzentrum oder IT-Sicherheit.

Ihr Profil

• Berufserfahrung: ca. 3–5 Jahre in der IT-Systemadministration

• Ausbildung: Abgeschlossene Ausbildung im IT-Bereich (z. B. Fachinformatiker für Systemintegration) oder vergleichbare Qualifikation

• Expertise: Fundierte Kenntnisse in Microsoft Hyper-V, Windows Server, Client-Management und Netzwerktechnik (Cisco, VLAN)

• Zertifikate: Cisco- oder Microsoft-Zertifizierungen wünschenswert, aber nicht zwingend erforderlich

• Sprachen: Deutsch und Englisch gut in Wort und Schrift, zusätzliche Sprachkenntnisse (Spanisch oder Finnisch) von Vorteil

What we offer you

• Modernes Arbeitsumfeld: Top ausgestattete Arbeitsplätze, kostenlose Parkplätze sowie Kaffee und Wasser.

• Flexibilität für Ihre Work-Life-Balance: Gleitzeitsystem und flexible Arbeitszeiten für eine optimale Vereinbarkeit von Beruf und Privatleben.

• Attraktive Zusatzleistungen: JobRad-Leasing, Corporate Benefits, Betriebsrente und weitere Vergünstigungen für Mitarbeitende.

• Globale Perspektive & Zusammenarbeit: Enge Kooperation mit der zentralen IT und Anbindung an internationale Konzernstrukturen.

• Wir bieten darüber hinaus: Verantwortungsvolle und abwechslungsreiche Aufgaben in einem internationalen Umfeld, Zusammenarbeit mit einem engagierten Team und modernen Technologien, Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten und Entwicklungsperspektiven sowie eine attraktive Vergütung und Sozialleistungen.

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Service & Installationstekniker till Sulzer Pumps Sweden AB
Vi söker service och installations tekniker till Sulzers växande servicecenter i Veddesta och Malmö. Gillar du att arbeta i en varierande vardag med både arbete i verkstadsmiljö och ute hos kund? Då kan detta vara tjänsten för dig!

Om företaget

Sulzer är ett världsledande företag inom utveckling, tillverkning och service av pumpar, omrörare, luftarutrustning och blåsmaskiner. Våra kunder arbetar inom områden som olja, gas, vattenrening, gruvdrift och pappersindustri. Vi tillhandahåller en utmanande och givande arbetsmiljö där mångfald är värderad som nyckelfaktorn till framgång.

Huvudkontoret ligger i Vadstena och vi har kontor i Malmö, Göteborg, Norrköping och Stockholm. Våra servicecenter finner du i Vadstena, Göteborg,Veddesta,Årsta, Karlstad, Piteå och Arlöv. Läs gärna mer om oss på www.sulzer.com

Dina arbetsuppgifter

Sulzers servicecenter har framför allt kunder verksamma inom vatten- och avloppshantering. Din roll kommer i huvudsak bestå av montage, reparation och service av pumpar och pumpstationer. Arbetet utförs antingen i våra serviceverkstäder i Veddesta, Malmö eller direkt ute hos våra kunder, för att felsöka och åtgärda problem på plats. Som installations tekniker kommer du att jobba med ombyggnationer och nybyggnationer av pumpstationer, etc. Resor med övernattning kan förekomma samt även beredskap.

Administrativa uppgifter som ingår i tjänsten är bland annat handläggning av ordrar, skriva servicerapporter samt hantering av in- och ut leveranser.

Du blir en del av våra team som präglas av god stämning och sammanhållning. Vi ser fram emot att välkomna ytterligare en kollega.

Din profil

Vi söker dig som gillar att skruva, meka och lösa tekniska problem. Vi tror att du har läst ett tekniskt program på gymnasiet eller vidareutbildat dig inom området. Alternativt att du har erfarenhet av praktiskt verkstads- och fältarbete. Har du erfarenhete av svets arbeten och elinstallationer är det bra oxå. Du innehar körkortsbehörighet B och har ett genuint intresse för mekanik och teknik.

Det är meriterande om du har:

• Branschvana

• Erfarenhet av SAP eller liknande affärssystem

• Truckkort

• Certifikat i heta arbeten

• Kunskaper inom el samt styr- och reglerteknik

Som person ser vi att du är engagerad och driven. Du är praktiskt lagd och tycker det är roligt att hitta tekniska lösningar. För dig är det enkelt att prata med både kollegor och kunder samtidigt som du jobbar strukturerat.

På Sulzer finns goda möjligheter till att utvecklas och växa i rollen så tveka inte - det kan vara här som din resa startar!

Ansökningsförfarande

Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning på 100%, provanställning tillämpas. Vi tillämpar löpande urval och tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan ansökningstiden har gått ut. Missa inte chansen och ansök redan idag!

What we offer you

• Friskvårdsbidrag 3000kr/år (E-passi)

• Collea – Gratis pension och försäkringsrådgivning

• Gratis kaffe och frukt

• Företagshälsovård med regelbundna hälsokontroller

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Project Buyer with Supply Chain mindset to Nordic Water Products AB

You are a proactive and self-driven purchasing professional with experience from project-driven manufacturing or industrial environments. You combine strong analytical skills with commercial awareness and technical understanding, enabling you to manage complex sourcing activities and support successful project execution.

You have experience in project purchasing, supplier negotiations, and supply chain management, and are comfortable working closely with project managers, engineering, production, and suppliers. You take ownership, prioritize effectively, and thrive in a role with a high degree of independence.

As a person, you are a collaborative team player who builds strong relationships, drives continuous improvement, and delivers results in a dynamic environment.

To succeed in this role, you have:

• Experience in project purchasing within manufacturing or industrial businesses

• Strong negotiation and supplier management skills

• An analytical and structured approach to problem-solving

• Technical understanding and commercial acumen

• Knowledge of industrial manufacturing processes, sheet metal fabrication and stainless-steel products is meritorious

• A proactive mindset, ability to work independently, and strong teamwork skills

• Fluent in Swedish and English, both spoken and written

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys combining commercial responsibility, technical challenges, and project-driven work in a dynamic international environment.

Place of employment: Helsingborg

Contact

For further information about the position, please contact Daniel Bogren, Head of Procurement at Nordic Water on 070-403 25 26 or daniel.bogren@sulzer.com

About the role

Job Summary
The Machine Operator is responsible for overseeing the operation of machinery and equipment on the production floor, ensuring optimal performance and adherence to safety and quality standards. This role provides guidance to other machine operators and supports troubleshooting and maintenance activities.
This job profile is intended for professional-level staff that works autonomously and may coordinate the activities of other professional-level staff, especially in non-routine situations. SUMMARY:
Sets up and operates machine tools, including HBM, VBM, lathes, milling machines, ID/OD grinders, planers, and bore, without assistance, following department policy and procedures manual, to manufacture and recondition component parts to customer, OEM and industry standards. Interprets mechanical drawings, blueprints, and sketches and performs precision metal cutting, grinding, shaping and fitting. Measures components, parts, and raw materials with precision measuring instruments, gauges, and tools. Works under limited supervision.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

• Performs layouts, sets up, and operates conventional machine tools as required

• Reads and interprets all drawings, including geometric dimensioning and tolerancing

• Designs setups and methods where none exist

• Instructs other shop personnel in proper machining techniques

• Continually improving methods to deliver higher quality with improved costs

QUALIFICATIONS:

• High School diploma or equivalent

• G-Code programming is a plus

• Ability to perform with a minimum of direct supervision

• Working knowledge of tool geometry and application

• Working knowledge of effects of feeds and speeds

• At least 4 years experience in machine shops on the above equipment

• Willingness to work in a team environment

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer è una società di ingegneria leader con un patrimonio orgoglioso di innovazione. Unisciti al nostro team globale per accrescere le tue competenze e sviluppare soluzioni innovative che consentano una società prospera e più sostenibile.

Informazioni sul ruolo

Sulzer è un leader industriale globale con una rete mondiale di oltre 100 centri di servizio che offrono pezzi di ricambio all'avanguardia, soluzioni di manutenzione e assistenza per pompe, turbine, compressori, motori e generatori. Nel nostro Global Parts Pricing & Projects Team stiamo costruendo prezzi come una capacità commerciale strategica - e stiamo cercando un talento analitico eccezionale per accelerare questo viaggio.

Il ruolo
Questa non è una tipica posizione di prezzi o analisi. Ti siederai all'intersezione della scienza dei dati, della strategia commerciale e della trasformazione digitale — modellando le decisioni sui prezzi in un ~ CHF 1.4B+ Portafoglio di servizi con 45 paesi e 100+ centri di assistenza in tutto il mondo. Potrai lavorare direttamente con il Global Pricing Head e la leadership regionale per chiudere le lacune dei prezzi, costruire infrastrutture di visibilità e guidare un impatto commerciale misurabile su scala.
Se avete una fondazione di ingegneria premier, una mentalità di consulenza e l'ambizione di costruire qualcosa che conta a livello globale - questo ruolo è progettato per voi.

Il tuo
• responsabilità

Strategia e analisi dei prezzi
● Progettare e ottimizzare una strategia globale dei prezzi per l'aftermarket di Sulzer — coprendo ricambi OEM, prezzi di riparazione e modelli VBP in tutte le linee di prodotto
● Costruire e distribuire modelli di prezzi basati sui dati che chiudono il divario di copertura di CHF 1.4B+: identificare dove il margine viene lasciato sulla tabella e quantificare l'impatto finanziario completo
● Sviluppare strumenti e framework di prezzi che consentono decisioni di prezzi coerenti e rispondenti al mercato in tutte le regioni, linee di prodotti e segmenti dei clienti
● Analisi della redditività del piombo e governance dei prezzi del contratto — trasformando i dati in piani d'azione chiari e pronti per l'esecutivo
● Costruire cruscotti di prezzi che danno visibilità in tempo reale di leadership nel tasso di successo, GP end-to-end e l'impatto di aumento di prezzo attraverso il pieno
Portafoglio servizi
Scienza dei dati e intelligenza artificiale
● Applicare tecniche di machine learning e AI per l'ottimizzazione dei prezzi, l'analisi dei tassi di successo e la segmentazione dei clienti - utilizzando Python, R e moderni strumenti AI
● Progettazione e costruzione di API di prezzi e datadotti che collegano la logica dei prezzi ai sistemi operativi, tra cui SAP, Qlik e ZEST attraverso la rete di servizi globale
● Sviluppare motori di raccomandazione dei prezzi assistiti da AI e logica di escalation automatizzata che riduce l'intervento manuale e migliora la velocità delle decisioni
● Crea dashboard e visualizzazioni di dati Qlik che portano i KPI di prezzi chiave — tasso di successo, GP, prezzi contrattuali e impatto aumento dei prezzi — alla vita per gli utenti di affari a livello globale
● Servire come centro interno di eccellenza per la scienza dei dati — eseguire workshop, formare i team aziendali e costruire l'infrastruttura dei dati che rende i prezzi un motore commerciale proattivo
Progetti globali e trasformazione digitale
● Condurre e contribuire a progetti di digitalizzazione in tutta la rete globale del Service Centre di Sulzer, dalla ricerca e dal business case fino all'implementazione e all'adozione
● Tradurre complessi problemi di business in soluzioni analitiche strutturate — sviluppare l'idea, costruire il caso di business, sicuro stakeholder buy-in e la consegna del drive
● Guidare iniziative di eccellenza commerciale, tra cui prezzi urgenti, modelli di moltiplicatore clienti e capacità di margine stimata — costruzione dell'infrastruttura dei prezzi per 2027 e oltre

Il tuo
• Profilo
Il candidato ideale combina eccezionale capacità quantitativa e analitica con una capacità di consulenza di strutturare i problemi, comunicare intuizioni e guidare il cambiamento di business. Le prime basi ingegneristiche e le competenze pratiche di data science sono il nucleo di ciò che stiamo cercando.

Sfondo accademico e professionale
● B.Tech / M.Tech da IIT, NIT, BITS Pilani, o equivalente — solide basi quantitative non negoziabili; MBA da Tier 1 college è un vantaggio mentre non mand
descriptionByLocale.en:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Sulzer is a global industrial leader with a worldwide network of over 100 service centres offering state-of-the-art spare parts, maintenance and service solutions for pumps, turbines, compressors, motors and generators. In our Global Parts Pricing & Projects Team we are building pricing as a strategic commercial capability — and we are looking for exceptional analytical talent to accelerate that journey.

The Role
This is not a typical pricing or analytics position. You will sit at the intersection of data science, commercial strategy and digital transformation — shaping pricing decisions across a ~ CHF 1.4B+ Services portfolio spanning 45 countries and 100+ service centres worldwide. You will work directly with the Global Pricing Head and regional leadership to close pricing gaps, build visibility infrastructure and drive measurable commercial impact at scale.
If you have a premier engineering foundation, a consulting mindset and the ambition to build something that matters globally — this role is designed for you.

Your
• Responsibilities

Pricing Strategy & Analytics
● Design and optimize a global pricing strategy for Sulzer's aftermarket — covering OEM spares, repair pricing and VBP models across all product lines
● Build and deploy data-driven pricing models that close the CHF 1.4B+ coverage gap — identifying where margin is left on the table and quantifying the full financial impact
● Develop pricing tools and frameworks enabling consistent, market-responsive pricing decisions across all regions, product lines and customer segments
● Lead profitability analyses, and contract price governance — turning data into clear, executive-ready action plans
● Build pricing dashboards giving leadership real-time visibility into hit rate, end-to-end GP and price increase impact across the full
Services portfolio
Data Science & Artificial Intelligence
● Apply machine learning and AI techniques to pricing optimisation, hit rate analysis and customer segmentation — using Python, R and modern AI tooling
● Design and build pricing APIs and data pipelines that connect pricing logic to operational systems including SAP, Qlik and ZEST across the global service network
● Develop AI-assisted price recommendation engines and automated escalation logic that reduce manual intervention and improve decision speed
● Create Qlik dashboards and data visualisations that bring key pricing KPIs — hit rate, GP, contract prices and price increase impact — to life for business users globally
● Serve as the internal centre of excellence for data science — run workshops, train business teams and build the data infrastructure that makes pricing a proactive commercial engine
Global Projects & Digital Transformation
● Lead and contribute to digitalisation projects across Sulzer's global Service Centre network — from scoping and business case through to implementation and adoption
● Translate complex business problems into structured analytical solutions — develop the idea, build the business case, secure stakeholder buy-in and drive delivery
● Drive commercial excellence initiatives including urgency pricing, customer multiplier models and estimated margin capability — building the pricing infrastructure for 2027 and beyond

Your
• Profile
The ideal candidate combines outstanding quantitative and analytical capability with a consulting-grade ability to structure problems, communicate insights and drive business change. Premier engineering foundations and hands-on data science expertise are the core of what we are looking for.

Academic & Professional Background
● B.Tech / M.Tech from IIT, NIT, BITS Pilani, or equivalent — strong quantitative foundations are non-negotiable; MBA from Tier 1 college is an advantage while not mand

● Concevoir et construire des API de tarification et des pipelines de données qui relient la logique de tarification aux systèmes opérationnels, y compris SAP, Qlik et ZEST, à travers le réseau mondial de services

descriptionByLocale.en:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Technical Sales Engineer is responsible for providing technical expertise and support throughout the sales process, from initial customer engagement to post-sale implementation. This role involves analyzing customer requirements, preparing technical proposals, and delivering product demonstrations. The Sr. Sales Engineer ensures that solutions are technically sound and aligned with customer needs. Location: Almaty, Kazakhstan
We are looking for a technically strong Sales Engineer for industrial pumps and rotating equipment.
This role is not a pure sales position. The successful candidate should be able to understand customer processes, read technical documentation, discuss operating conditions, prepare technically correct offers, and support customers during project execution.
At the same time, the role requires commercial initiative: regular customer visits, development of new opportunities, follow-up of installed base, preparation of technical presentations/seminars, and active contribution to order intake growth in Kazakhstan and Central Asia.
The role is approximately 60–70% technical/application engineering and 30–40% commercial sales development.

Main responsibilities/Technical/Application sales

• Analyze customer requests, technical specifications, data sheets, operating conditions, and tender requirements.

• Prepare technically and commercially correct offers for industrial pumps, rotating equipment, and spare parts.

• Clarify technical requirements with customers, Sulzer factories, tendering teams, engineering teams, and service teams.

• Support the technical documentation approval process between customers and Sulzer factories.

• Review customer comments to technical/commercial documents and coordinate required changes.

• Participate in technical discussions with customers, design institutes, EPCs, and end users.

Customer and business development

• Develop regional sales in Kazakhstan and Central Asia with focus on mining, metallurgy, chemical industry, mineral fertilizers, and general industry.

• Maintain and develop relationships with existing customers.

• Search for new customers, applications, projects, and installed-base opportunities.

• Plan customer visits, technical meetings, seminars, webinars, and product presentations.

• Build opportunity pipeline and contribute to order intake growth.

Tendering, order execution, and coordination

• Prepare tender documentation, including work with electronic tender platforms.

• Review commercial conditions and support contract approval with customers.

• Register orders in SAP and coordinate order execution.

• Monitor delivery timelines and communicate with customers, factories, logistics, accounting, and tendering teams.

• Report activities, maintain forecasts, and provide regular updates on sales opportunities.

Requirements

• Higher technical education: mechanical engineering, hydraulic engineering, process engineering, materials science, or similar.

• Minimum 3 years of experience with industrial equipment, preferably pumps, compressors, rotating equipment, process equipment, or engineered products.

• Ability to read and understand technical specifications, pump data sheets, drawings, and customer RFQs.

• Understanding of centrifugal pump principles: flow, head, efficiency, NPSH, pump curves, operating point, cavitation risk.

• Basic understanding of industrial materials: cast iron, carbon steel, stainless steel, duplex/superduplex, elastomers, coatings.

• Experience with industrial customers in mining, metallurgy, chemical industry, oil & gas, power, water/wastewater, or general industry.

• Working professional English and fluent Russian. Kazakh is an advantage.

• Readiness for regular business trips across Kazakhstan an

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The role is responsible for supporting accounting operations including data entry, reconciliations, and assisting with financial reporting. This role ensures accuracy in financial records and supports compliance with accounting standards. Job Responsibilities

• Serve as a member of the RTR team in the CoE, providing support on ad hoc topics and accounting issues.

• Support with financial booking activities, ensuring accuracy and compliance with International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) and Sulzer regulations.

• Manage clearing, including reconciliations and adjustments, to maintain accurate financial records.

• Utilize advanced knowledge of ERP systems to streamline accounting processes.

• Support the Global Process Owner (GPO) with system implementations.

• Maintain and update the chart of accounts and hierarchies, ensuring it reflects the current business structure and reporting requirements.

• Collaborate closely with local Finance Teams in countries and Finance Shared Services teams / Business Process Outsourcing (BPO) provider.

Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in accounting or finance or business administration.

• Minimum of 3-4 years of experience in Accounting with a strong focus on general ledger and financial reporting.

• CPA, ACCA, CMA or equivalent certification preferred.

• Good financial analysis and advanced accounting knowledge.

• Good problem-solving skills.

• Proficient in ERP systems (SAP, Microsoft Dynamics 365 or iScala) and accounting software.

• Strong MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint) skills.

What we offer you

• 11 days' public holidays and maximum 15 days' annual leave.

• Supplementary Commercial Insurance.

• Annual Physical Examination.

• Festival & Birthday Gifts.

• Long service awards.

• Shuttle Bus.

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

Informazioni sul ruolo

Sintesi del lavoro
La FP&A Analyst è responsabile del supporto alle attività di pianificazione finanziaria e analisi, tra cui la raccolta dei dati, la segnalazione e la previsione di base. Questo ruolo contribuisce al processo decisionale finanziario applicando conoscenze teoriche e lavorando sotto controllo.
Questo profilo di lavoro è destinato a professionisti precoci che applicano una vasta conoscenza teorica e richiedono la capacità di indagare e analizzare i problemi. Le soluzioni sono tipicamente discusse/verificati con un membro più anziano. Principali responsabilità

• Sostenere la preparazione e il consolidamento del bilancio annuale, fornendo dati e analisi accurate

• Assistere a aggiornare periodicamente le previsioni finanziarie predittive, assicurando accuratezza e rilevanza

• Aiuta a condurre la redditività e la rendicontazione delle prestazioni, fornendo dati essenziali per il processo decisionale

• Contribuire a pianificare analisi e gestione dei rischi, aiutando nel miglioramento continuo dei processi di pianificazione e analisi finanziaria

• Condurre analisi finanziarie approfondite per sostenere le raccomandazioni aziendali, sotto la guida dei membri del team senior

• Raccolta di supporto e analisi, assicurando informazioni accurate e tempestive è disponibile per il processo decisionale

Competenze & Qualifiche

• Laurea in finanza, contabilità, amministrazione aziendale o campo relativo

• Minimo di 3-5 anni di esperienza nella pianificazione finanziaria e nell'analisi o ruoli finanziari correlati

• L'esperienza nel settore manifatturiero o industriale è un plus

• Competenza nella modellazione finanziaria e nella previsione, competenze avanzate nell'analisi dei dati e nel software finanziario

• Forte comprensione dei processi finanziari globali e degli standard

• Forte acume finanziario

• Capacità di comunicazione eccellenti per fornire informazioni chiave alla leadership

• Eccellente capacità interpersonali e la capacità di lavorare in collaborazione con altri stakeholder

• Appuyer la préparation et la consolidation du budget annuel, en fournissant des données et des analyses précises

• Aider à rafraîchir périodiquement les prévisions financières prédictives, en assurant l'exactitude et la pertinence

• Aider à établir des rapports sur la rentabilité et le rendement, en fournissant des données essentielles pour la prise de décisions

• Contribuer à la planification de l'analyse et de la gestion des risques, en contribuant à l'amélioration continue des processus de planification et d'analyse financières

• Effectuer une analyse financière approfondie à l'appui des recommandations des entreprises, sous la direction des membres de l'équipe supérieure

• Appuyer les collectes de rapports et d'analyses, en veillant à ce que des renseignements exacts et opportuns soient disponibles pour la prise de décisions

• Diplôme universitaire en finance, comptabilité, administration des affaires ou domaine connexe

• Au moins 3 à 5 ans d'expérience dans la planification et l'analyse financières ou les rôles financiers connexes

• L'expérience dans les secteurs manufacturiers ou industriels est

• Compétence en modélisation et en prévision financières, compétences avancées en analyse des données et logiciels financiers

• Forte acuité financière

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with strong interpersonal abilities.
• High level of professionalism and the ability to manage confidential information with discretion.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer è una società di ingegneria leader con un patrimonio orgoglioso di innovazione. Unisciti al nostro team globale per accrescere le tue competenze e sviluppare soluzioni innovative che consentano una società prospera e più sostenibile. Informazioni sul ruolo Sulzer è leader globale nell’ingegneria dei fluidi, specializzata nella progettazione e produzione di pompe e attrezzature associate per alcune delle industrie più critiche al mondo. Fondata nel 1834 e con sede in Svizzera, utilizziamo oltre 13.500 persone in tutto il mondo, operando in oltre 40 paesi, generando vendite annuali di circa 3,6 miliardi di franchi. Le nostre tecnologie di pompaggio supportano i clienti attraverso l'energia, l'acqua e le acque reflue, i prodotti chimici, la produzione industriale, le scienze della vita e i mercati alimentari, consentendo una gestione sicura, affidabile ed efficiente dei fluidi in applicazioni complesse. Il sito Wexford è un contributo fondamentale al portafoglio di pompaggio globale di Sulzer, con un forte focus sullo sviluppo del prodotto e sul supporto ingegneristico per pompe e attrezzature meccaniche associate. Il team lavora a stretto contatto con gli stakeholder internazionali, sostenendo la progettazione e lo sviluppo dei prodotti forniti ai clienti in tutti i mercati globali Informazioni sulla Role & Opportunity Stiamo cercando un tecnico di progettazione meccanica per unirsi al nostro team di sviluppo prodotti a Wexford. descriptionByLocale.en:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Sulzer is a global leader in fluid engineering, specialising in the design and manufacture of pumps and associated equipment for some of the world’s most critical industries. Founded in 1834 and headquartered in Switzerland, we employ over 13,500 people worldwide, operating in more than 40 countries, generating annual sales of approximately CHF 3.6 billion. Our pumping technologies support customers across the energy, water and wastewater, chemicals, industrial manufacturing, life sciences and food markets, enabling safe, reliable and efficient fluid handling in demanding applications.

The Wexford site is a key contributor to Sulzer’s global pumping portfolio, with a strong focus on product development and engineering support for pumps and associated mechanical equipment. The team works closely with international stakeholders, supporting the design and development of products supplied to customers across global markets About the Role & Opportunity

We are seeking a Mechanical Design Technician to join our Product Development team in Wexford. This role plays an important part in supporting the design and development of engineered pump solutions and related equipment, working closely with experienced Project Manager's.

You will be involved throughout the design lifecycle, contributing to products that are used worldwide in process‑critical environments. This is a development‑focused role within a structured engineering organisation, offering long‑term technical growth and progression opportunities.

Key Duties

• Create and maintain 3D models and 2D engineering drawings for pumps and associated mechanical equipment

• Produce detailed manufacturing drawings, assemblies and bills of materials

• Support engineering change requests, design updates and product improvements

• Collaborate with engineering, manufacturing, testing and quality teams

• Ensure compliance with engineering standards, procedures and documentation requirements

What We’re Looking For

• A qualification in Mechanical Engineering, Mechanical Design or a related discipline

• Experience creating engineering drawings and CAD models within a mechanical or manufacturing environment

• Understanding of mechanical assemblies, components and technical documentation

• A structured, detail‑orientated approach with good communication skills

• Motivation to learn, develop and build a long‑term career within engineering

What we offer you

• Competitive base salary

• Annual Leave: Enjoy 26 days of holiday

• Flexibility: Flexible Working Arrangements

• Pension: Benefit from a Defined Contribution Pension Scheme

• On site parking

• Subsidised Canteen on site

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

About the role

• Drill presses

• Large band saws and/or cold saws

Sur le rôle

Nous recherchons un manufacturier / opérateur de freins à pression compétent et motivé pour rejoindre notre équipe de fabrication. Cette position est principalement responsable de l'exploitation du frein à pression NC pour produire des composants en acier inoxydable de haute qualité selon les plans et les spécifications techniques. Le candidat idéal participera également à diverses tâches de fabrication, notamment l'utilisation d'un cisaillement manuel, d'une machine à rouler, d'une presse à forer et de scies à découper. Principales responsabilités

• Mettre en place et utiliser l'équipement de frein à pression NC pour former des composants en tôle d'acier inoxydable.

• Lisez, interprètez et suivez les plans techniques, les plans, les instructions de travail et les spécifications.

• Mesurez, marquez et étalez avec précision les découpes et les courbes sur les matériaux métalliques.

• Utilisez une machine de cisaillement manuelle pour couper le métal aux dimensions requises.

• Utilisez des outils manuels et électriques, y compris des meuleuses à angle et des outils d'ébarbage, pour terminer les pièces fabriquées.

• Expérience de la mesure, du marquage et de la mise en place des matériaux de fabrication.

• Capacité d'utiliser en toute sécurité les équipements de fabrication et de travail des métaux.

• Expérimentez l'utilisation d'outils manuels et électriques, y compris des meuleuses à angle.

• Capacité de travailler de façon indépendante et en équipe.

• Expérience de travail avec la tôle d'acier inoxydable.

• Expérimentez la mise en place et le fonctionnement des freins à pression NC ou CNC.

• Certification ou expérience de chariot élévateur (le cas échéant).

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Sulzer est une société d'ingénierie de premier plan avec un fier héritage d'innovation. Rejoignez notre équipe mondiale pour développer votre expertise et développer des solutions innovantes qui permettent une société prospère et plus durable.

Sur le rôle

Résumé de l'emploi
Le gestionnaire principal de la comptabilité est chargé de superviser les opérations comptables, d'assurer le respect des règlements financiers et de gérer une équipe de professionnels de la comptabilité. Ce rôle appuie la planification financière stratégique et assure l'exactitude et l'intégrité des rapports financiers. Ce profil d'emploi s'adresse aux gestionnaires de ressources humaines de plus de 4 employés expérimentés de niveau expert supérieur. Le chef des finances par pays/groupe est chargé de superviser toutes les opérations comptables dans le groupe de pays ou le groupe régional de pays, de gérer les éléments clés de la planification financière, de clôture et de présentation de rapports pour l'état des résultats, le bilan, l'état des flux de trésorerie et les rapports statutaires du groupe de pays/pays. Le chef des finances par pays est responsable de l'amélioration des processus et appuie les initiatives financières stratégiques visant à améliorer la performance financière globale des Sulzer.

Principales responsabilités

• Veiller au respect du Manuel de comptabilité Sulzer, des IFRS, des exigences réglementaires locales et des règlements fiscaux.
• Superviser les processus de fin de mois, de fin d'exercice et de rapports législatifs, en veillant à ce que les rapports financiers soient exacts et opportuns.
• Diriger les vérifications internes et externes et maintenir un solide environnement de contrôle interne.
• Veiller à ce que les états financiers et les présentations fiscales soient produits en temps opportun.
• Assurer le respect des contrôles internes (ICS), de la délégation de pouvoir (DoA) et des politiques de transaction interentreprises.
• Établir un partenariat avec les Centres d'excellence et de services partagés financiers pour améliorer et normaliser les processus financiers.
• Surveiller le respect de la trésorerie et de l'impôt conformément aux exigences du Groupe et des autorités locales.
• Diriger, développer et entraîner l'équipe locale des finances et de la comptabilité.
• Appuyer les initiatives budgétaires, de prévision et financières stratégiques grâce à des partenariats commerciaux efficaces.

Exigences:

• Baccalauréat en finance, en comptabilité ou dans un domaine connexe.
• CA(SA), CPA, ACCA ou qualification professionnelle équivalente.
• 7-9 ans d'expérience en leadership progressif en finance ou en comptabilité.
• Connaissance approfondie des IFRS, de l'information légale, de l'audit, de l'impôt et des contrôles financiers.
• Expérience dans les secteurs manufacturier, ingénierie ou industriel préféré.
• Expérience éprouvée des équipes comptables et de la gestion de multiples intervenants.
• Connaissances solides des systèmes ERP, analyse financière et compétences Microsoft Office.

Ce que nous vous offrons

-

Sulzer est un employeur à chances égales. Nous croyons en la force d'une main-d'oeuvre diversifiée et sommes déterminés à offrir un milieu de travail inclusif.

Nous sommes fiers d'être reconnus comme l'un des meilleurs employeurs 2026 au Brésil, au Canada, en Chine, en Finlande, en Allemagne, en Irlande, au Mexique, en Suisse, en Afrique du Sud, au Royaume-Uni et aux États-Unis.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

The role is responsible for managing large-scale legal and compliance projects, providing expert counsel, and ensuring the organization’s operations align with legal and regulatory standards. This role also supports junior professionals through coaching and delegation. Recognized subject matter expert in job area. Responsibilities typically include managing large projects or processes autonomously and coaching, reviewing, and delegating work to lower level experts. Key Responsibilities

• Manage the legal function for the legal entity, ensuring alignment with corporate legal strategy.

• Provide legal advice on commercial, corporate, and regulatory matters.
Oversee the drafting, negotiation, and review of complex contracts and legal documents.

• Ensure compliance with applicable laws, regulations, and internal policies.
Support the resolution of legal disputes and manage litigation in coordination with external legal counsel.

• Develop and implement legal policies, procedures, and training programs.
Collaborate with internal stakeholders to support business initiatives and manage legal risks.

• Monitor legal and regulatory developments and assess their impact on the organization.

• Lead, mentor, and develop external legal service providers.

Skills & Qualifications

• Typically a University degree (or equivalent work experience) and 6+ years of relevant work experience are minimally required.

• Qualified to practice law in China

• Strong experience in corporate and commercial law, with a focus on contract law and compliance.

• Excellent communication, negotiation, and stakeholder engagement abilities.

• Ability to manage complex legal issues and provide strategic legal advice.

• High ethical standards and sound legal judgment.

• Experience in a multinational or matrixed organization and industries such as oil and gas, power generation, mining, chemicals and water is preferred.

What we offer you

• 11 days' public holidays and maximum 15 days' annual leave.

• Supplementary Commercial Insurance.

• Annual Physical Examination.

• Festival & Birthday Gifts.

• Long service awards.

• Shuttle Bus.

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Sulzer ist ein führendes Engineering-Unternehmen mit einer reichen Innovationstradition. Werden Sie Teil unseres globalen Teams, um Ihre Expertise zu erweitern und innovative Lösungen zu entwickeln, die eine wohlhabende und nachhaltigere Gesellschaft ermöglichen.

Sulzer Chemtech fertigt Stoffaustauschkomponenten für die chemische und petrochemische Industrie. Produktionsmitarbeiter im Bereich «Biege-, Laser- und Stanzmaschinen» sind verantwortlich die Fertigung von Bauteilen für unsere Verteiler, Böden, und anderen Kolonneneinbauten.

Sulzer bietet Ihnen eine Vielfalt von Möglichkeiten, Ihre Karriere in die von Ihnen gewünschte Richtung zu lenken, je nach Ihren Fähigkeiten und Interessen. Wir laden Sie ein, sich zu bewerben, wenn Sie bereit sind, den nächsten Schritt zu tun.

Karrierechance: Mitarbeiter/in für die Herstellung von strukturierten Packungen (m/w/d) bei Sulzer Chemtech in Essen. Aufgaben und Verantwortlichkeiten:

• Herstellen von strukturierten Packungen nach Vorgaben und Zeitplänen

• Arbeitsplätze: Stanzen und Nuten, Biegen, Schneiden, Montieren, Qualitätskontrolle, Verpacken

• Arbeiten an automatischen und halbautomatischen Produktionslinien mit maßgeschneiderten Produktionsanlagen

• Arbeit im Schichtbetrieb

• Durchführung von Einstellungen und Anpassungen von Maschinen zur Gewährleistung von Geschwindigkeit und Qualität der Produktionsleistung

• Mitwirkung bei der Durchführung von Projekten an allen Arbeitsplätzen in der strukturierten Verpackungswerkstatt

• Meldung von Nichtkonformitäten und Abweichungen von den Produktionsplänen an den Vorarbeiter der Verpackungswerkstatt

• Beitrag zu kontinuierlichen Verbesserungsmaßnahmen in Zusammenarbeit mit der Qualitätsabteilung

• Arbeit in Übereinstimmung mit allen relevanten Richtlinien, Prozessen und Standardarbeitsanweisungen

• Arbeit in Übereinstimmung mit den Richtlinien für Umwelt, Sicherheit und Gesundheit

• Andere produktionsbezogene Aufgaben und Projekte nach Zuweisung.

Anforderungen:

• Handwerkliche / Technische Ausbildung, Werkstattausbildung

• Mindestens 3-5 Jahre Berufserfahrung in diesen Bereichen

• Expertise: Kenntnisse der Fertigungsverfahren Schneiden, Stanzen, Biegen und Schweißen von Blechen

• Affinität zu aufmerksamer und qualitätsorientierter Zusammenarbeit mit Menschen unterschiedlicher Herkunft und Nationalität

• Verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse

What we offer you

Wir bieten:

• Attraktive Vergütung

• Unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag

• 30 Tage Urlaub

• JobRad

• Kostenlose Parkplätze auf dem Betriebsgelände

• Betriebliche Sonderleistungen (z.B. Altersvorsorge, Familienservice-Hotline)

Für diese Stelle können wir keine Unterstützung zum Erhalt eines Visums oder einer Arbeitserlaubnis bieten.

Sulzer ist ein Arbeitgeber, der Chancengleichheit und Gleichbehandlung fördert. Wir setzen uns für personelle Vielfalt ein.
83 % unserer Mitarbeitenden empfehlen Sulzer als guten Arbeitgeber und wir sind stolz darauf, in Brasilien, China, Deutschland, der Schweiz, dem Vereinigten Königreich und den Vereinigten Staaten als Top-Arbeitgeber 2024 ausgezeichnet zu sein. Kommen Sie und nehmen Sie an unserer Geschichte teil!

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

The Jr. Machinery Mechanic is responsible for assisting in the maintenance and repair of industrial machinery under close supervision. This entry-level role supports senior mechanics in diagnosing issues, performing basic repairs, and ensuring equipment is safe and operational.
This job profile is intended for entry-level support staff who follow specific instructions and procedures, with supervision provided for non-routine situations. Tasks can be carried out after basic training or demonstration. SUMMARY

RESPONSIBILTIES

• Test electro-mechanical equipment to troubleshoot known or suspected problems using various methods (ac or de).

• Disassemble electro-mechanical equipment noting parts identifications, configuration and condition.

• Clean electro-mechanical equipment assemblies as needed using various methods and steps, including but not limited to: parts washer/steamers, caustic tanks, glass beaders, etc.

• Measure for or note proper replacement parts. Correctly requisition needed items from storekeeper, as approved by supervisor.

• Replace or repair worn or defective mechanical or electro-mechanical assemblies, including but not limited to: bearings, brushes, brush holders, motors leads gears seals, impellers, mechanical switches, brakes clutches, clutch rotors, tachs, fans, end shield,, etc.

• Operate specialized repair and testing equipment and other equipment as needed

• Observe all safety procedures and use proper protective gear (especially eye and car protection).

• Lift, tighten, adjust and/or secure heavy objects in order to perform work duties.

• Keep work area neat and clean as directed by supervisor.

• Assisted other mechanics or other shop personnel in skilled or –non-skilled duties as directed by supervisor or shop manager.

• Perform other skilled or not-skilled duties as directed by supervisor

• High school diploma or equivalent

• Basic mechanical aptitude

• Ability to understand, perform and retain various skill related training and operational and safety procedures demonstrated by supervisor.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

• While performing duties of this job, would occasionally be required to stand, walk, sit, reach with hands and arms, climb or balance, stoop or kneel, talk and hear, and use fingers and hands to feel objects.

• Remplacer ou réparer les assemblages mécaniques ou électromécaniques usés ou défectueux, y compris, sans s'y limiter, les roulements, les brosses, les porte-brosses, les moteurs qui conduisent les joints d'engrenages, les roues, les interrupteurs mécaniques, les embrayages de freins, les rotors d'embrayage, les taches, les ventilateurs, le bouclier d'extrémité, etc.

• Rétester l'équipement électromécanique réassemblé pour une sortie et un fonctionnement appropriés.

• Remplir les documents requis pour chaque emploi avec exactitude et en temps opportun.

• Utiliser au besoin du matériel spécialisé de réparation et d ' essai et d ' autres équipements

• Observer toutes les procédures de sécurité et utiliser un équipement de protection approprié (surtout la protection des yeux et des voitures).

• Soulevez, serrez, ajustez et/ou sécurisez des objets lourds afin d'effectuer des tâches de travail.

• Garder l'aire de travail propre et propre conformément aux directives du superviseur.

• Il a aidé d'autres mécaniciens ou d'autres membres du personnel d'atelier à accomplir des tâches qualifiées ou non, conformément aux directives du superviseur ou du directeur d'atelier.

• Accomplir d'autres fonctions qualifiées ou non qualifiées, conformément aux directives du superviseur

QUALIFICATIONS

• Diplôme d'études secondaires ou équivalent

• Aptitude mécanique de base

• Capacité de comprendre, d'exécuter et de conserver diverses formations et procédures opérationnelles et de sécurité liées aux compétences démontrées par le superviseur.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The (Mechanical) Engineering Specialist is responsible for researching, designing, and developing mechanical systems and components. This role applies advanced engineering knowledge to support the development and testing of mechanical and electromechanical systems.
This job profile is intended for specialist professionals that apply advanced knowledge of a job area. Required to manage projects / processes independently with limited supervision. Typically coaches and reviews the work of lower level professionals. 1. Serves as technical specialist in one or more of the following areas:
Vane Department
• Blade Department
• Combustion Department
• Gas Turbine Rotors
• Houston Aero

2. View parts immediately upon arrival. Visually inspect and inventory as required.

3. Work with Gas Turbine Inside Sales Representative during the quoting process.

4. Ensure that job work order releases are prompt and in order. Become completely aware of sales efforts and goals for the job.

5. Become completely aware of the customer requirements for the job, including technical requirements, hold points, and delivery.

6. Ensure that job work scopes are complete and correct. Ensure that the job work scopes are promptly issued to the Production Supervisors.

7. Ensure that all job work scopes contain all pertinent information with regards to procedures, prints, tolerances, and critical dimensions.

8. Order all material/parts required to complete each job. Ensure that material/parts are expedited as required for timely delivery. Production Engineer is responsible for the quality of the material supplied.

9. Review any challenging issues with Division Superintendent and/or Engineering. All first time jobs must be reviewed by Superintendent and Engineering.

10. Work together with Production Supervisors to establish schedules for production that ensure on-time deliveries.

11. Work together with Production Supervisors to optimize, refine, and streamline production work-flow and all of its effects.

• 12. Constantly monitor/check the following items on all working jobs. Review these items with the Component Division Superintendent on a weekly basis.
• · Job cost
• · Delivery status
• · Quotation status

13. Responsible for job coordination and tracking profitability.

14. Attend weekly production meetings.

What we offer you

• 15 days of paid time off and 12 company-paid holidays
• 401k plan with a 6% match
• Comprehensive health plan including medical, dental, vision, Life, short-term & long-term disability
• Health savings account matching
• Motivating wellness program
• Employee Assistance Program
• Paid paternal leave
• Gym reimbursement

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Vous serez habilité(e) à développer des stratégies de marché, de nouvelles applications, à diriger des discussions technico-commerciales et à gérer l'ensemble du cycle de vente, de la phase d’appel d’offre jusqu'à l'exécution, tout en collaborant avec des experts mondiaux et des équipes locales. Nous recherchons un(e) Responsable Commercial(e) Technique motivé(e) pour diriger la croissance de notre activité Mass Transfer Components and Services (MTCS) en Algérie et dans certains pays africains francophones. Les principales responsabilités sont :
• Effectuer des visites régulières chez les clients existants et potentiels pour comprendre les besoins techniques et commerciaux, présenter les capacités de l’entreprise, renforcer la proximité client et assurer des relations durables.
• Identifier, générer et développer de nouvelles opportunités commerciales dans le territoire et les marchés définis, assurant un solide pipeline de projets et une croissance durable.
• Évaluer les demandes clients sous les angles technique et commercial, en collaboration avec les « application managers » et les spécialistes techniques back-office afin d’assurer l'alignement avec les exigences clients.
• Préparer et présenter des offres techniquement et commercialement solides et réaliser des présentations techniques ou des formations mettant en avant les choix de conception, les performances et notre valeur ajoutée.
• Développer des conceptions performantes et économiques en utilisant les données de process clients et les outils logiciels internes.
• Préparer des estimations de coûts précises pour les solutions proposées en utilisant les outils internes et/ou avec les équipes CEG (Cost Estimation Group) basées en usine.
• Gérer l’ensemble du processus d'appel d'offres, incluant préparation, soumission, suivi, réunions de clarification et négociation des termes commerciaux afin de sécuriser des contrats équitables et d »fendant les intérêts de Sulzer. Pour réussir dans ce rôle :
• Formation : Diplôme d’ingénieur en génie chimique ou discipline technique apparentée. Un master est un avantage.
• Expérience : Minimum 10 ans d'expérience dans l’un des domaines suivants : Usines / installations industrielles ou support technique opérationnel dans des raffineries locales/régionales, usines pétrochimiques, unités de production/traitement de gaz ou autres installations chimiques/biobasées ou fournisseurs de technologies / EPC – Vente technique, ingénierie d'affaires chez un fournisseur local de technologies, organisation de services industriels ou contractant EPC.
• Un profil mixte – Une combinaison d’expérience en exploitation et chez un fournisseur/EPC est hautement valorisée. Les compétences demandées :
• Bonne compréhension des technologies de séparation, équipements de transfert de masse, technologies de mélange ou procédés associés.
• Capacité à analyser des données process et proposer des solutions fiables et économiques.
• Familiarité avec les schémas techniques tels que PFD et P&ID.
• Compétences commerciales : Compréhension des mécanismes et procédures commerciaux / Capacité à préparer offres, appels d’offres, estimations de coûts et à participer aux négociations contractuelles What we offer you
• Avantage 1 : Évoluer sur des projets dimensionnant et stratégiques pour le Groupe
• Avantage 2 : Avantages d'une "PME" au sein d'un grand Groupe
• Avantage 3 : Accès au Comité Social et Economique (CSE)
• Avantage 4 : Carte Ticket restaurant - Mutuelle Avantageuse - Prime d'intéressement & Participation - RTT - Variable avec un Bonus
• et bien d'autres... Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Sulzer GT Aero Services is a leading provider of gas turbine maintenance, repair and parts support services, serving customers across the power generation, oil & gas, and industrial sectors. With decades of engineering expertise, we help customers maximise turbine performance, reliability and operational uptime through specialist repair, overhaul and technical support solutions.

Our facility is home to one of the largest gas turbine spare parts inventories in the industry, enabling us to provide rapid support and exceptional service to customers around the world. As our business grows, we are seeking a highly organised and motivated Kitting Stores Person to join our team. Key Responsibilities

• Pick and assemble kits of components in line with workshop and customer requirements.

• Ensure all kits are accurate, complete and delivered to production on schedule.

• Receive, inspect and book materials into stock using the company's ERP system.

• Store and manage inventory in designated locations whilst maintaining full traceability.

• Issue parts and consumables to workshop personnel.

• Carry out routine cycle counts and stock audits to ensure inventory accuracy.

• Investigate and resolve stock discrepancies.

• Support packing, shipping and dispatch activities for customer orders.

• Identifizieren und markieren Sie unverzüglich alle Unstimmigkeiten in Bezug auf Umfang, Preis, Menge, Zahlungsbedingungen, Lieferbedingungen oder Vertragsbedingungen vor der Buchung der Bestellung.

• Überprüfung und Interpretation von Kundenverträgen, Ermittlung potenzieller wirtschaftlicher und operativer Risiken und Übermittlung von Bedenken an die Verkaufs- und Ausschreibungsteams zur Lösung.

• Besitzen Sie fundierte Kenntnisse über Incoterms, Zahlungsbedingungen, anwendbare Steuern, Abgaben und gesetzliche Compliance-Anforderungen.

• Bestellbuchungen für Pumpen und Ersatzteile genau bearbeiten mit der Verpflichtung zur Null-Fehler-Ausführung.

• Koordinieren und führen Sie interne Kick-Off-Meetings mit relevanten Stakeholdern für Pumpenaufträge und kritische / hochwertige Ersatzteilbestellungen durch.

• Erstellen und pflegen Sie Bestellbuchungsaufzeichnungen, einschließlich der Generierung von Bestellcodes und Kundenstammcodes, wann immer dies erforderlich ist.

• Bereiten, überprüfen und senden Sie Bestellbestätigungen an Kunden mit etablierten Standard-Checklisten und Verfahren.

• Führen Sie regelmäßige Besprechungen mit den Verkaufs- und Ausschreibungsteams durch und erstellen Sie zweiwöchentliche Status- und Leistungsberichte.

• Behalten Sie hohe Kenntnisse in Microsoft Office-Anwendungen, insbesondere MS Excel, und zeigen Sie praktische Erfahrungen mit SAP.

• Demonstrieren Sie hervorragende schriftliche und mündliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten, während Sie mit internen und externen Stakeholdern interagieren.

• Besitzen Sie Kenntnisse über Pumpen, Kompressoren, Kupplungen und verwandte rotierende Geräte; solche Erfahrungen werden als deutlicher Vorteil angesehen.
