Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary

Engineering position is responsible for designing and developing mechanical systems and components. This role applies engineering knowledge to support the planning, testing, and implementation of mechanical and electromechanical systems.
This job profile is intended for experienced professionals who apply practical knowledge of a job area and work independently with general supervision. Recruiting for a Mechanical or Electrical Engineer (both job descriptions available)

Mechanical Engineer Position Summary:
The individual with this position will have to coordinate between the machine shop, quotation department and the customer. This position is mainly an on-site position but might involve up to 10% field service work. This engineering position will entail a dual role with hands-on tasks along with office responsibilities. It is expected that the individual will need training as part of the on-boarding process and Sulzer will accommodate.

Job requirements
- Preferred 3 years’ experience in rotating equipment repairs
- The preferred experience is in rotating equipment repairs, but acceptable experience includes
o Rotating equipment manufacturing
o Rotating equipment package design and assembly
o Vibration analysis
o Field Service-Overhauls
- Proficient with CAD software: AutoDesk or Solidworks
- Preferred Knowhow of the following topics
o Rolling element bearings, sleeve babbitt bearings
o Oil seals and their functionality
o Vibration spectrums and how to interpret them
o Alignment
- Proficient in the usage of micrometers
- Familiarity with seal and bearing clearances to shafts is preferred if not it is expected this topic is learnt by the engineer as part of on-the-job training.
Role
- The mechanical engineer will need to bridge the communication to the customers on the mechanical portion of the repair.
- The mechanical engineer will need to be involved on the discovery side of the inspections to assist in developing an accurate workscope.
- Should be proficient in CAD software to document design changes and create drawings to be shared with the customers.
- This role will require the individual to be hands-on and involved in the day-to day operations.
- The role will require performing or confirming precise measurements using micrometers and calipers.
Mandatory Attributes
- The individual must be self-motivated and must be prepared for on-the-job training.
- The individual must take responsibility of their assigned task and finish it in a timely manner.
Qualifications
- Undergraduate/Graduate Degree mechanical engineering or related field

Electrical Engineer Position Summary:
The individual with this position will have to split their time in-between the engineering team objectives, field service, field service reports and shop engineering support. This engineering position will entail a dual role with hands-on-responsibilities along with other engineering tasks. It is expected that the individual will need training as part of on-boarding process and Sulzer will accommodate.
Job Requirements
- Preferred 0 – 4 years’ experience in the following field of electrical engineering.
o Electric motor, generators repairs and design.
o Transformer repair and design
o Switch gear design and diagnostics
o Power Semiconductors
- Proficient in basic power theory,
- Knowhow in the following topics
o Operations of induction motors
o Operations of synchronous motors
o Transformer principle
o Operation of semiconductors.
o Winding Insulation Tests
Role
- The electrical engineer will be responsible to perform on-site field service preventive maintenance and troubleshooting on electromechanical equipment.
- They will also be responsible to provide the reports for the job performed to the customer in a timely m

• Experience in root cause analysis and implementing corrective actions
• The ability to interpret data from sensors and diagnostic tools to identify and resolve faults

• A collaborative mindset with excellent communication skills and attention to detail What we offer you

Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role At Sulzer GT Aero, we are a recognised global leader in the maintenance, repair and overhaul (MRO) of aero‑derivative gas turbines. Our Netherley, Aberdeenshire facility is a centre of excellence, supporting customers worldwide with innovative, responsive and reliable solutions that keep critical equipment running. With continued investment and growth across the business, this is an exciting opportunity to join a high‑performing team and play a key role in supporting our spares and repairs operations. We are looking for a Spares & Repairs Coordinator to support the effective handling of customer requests for spare parts and component repairs. In this role, you will work closely with customers, suppliers and internal teams to ensure enquiries are processed efficiently, quotations are prepared accurately, and orders are progressed smoothly from initial enquiry through to completion. You will be a vital part of the end‑to‑end process, helping deliver the high standards of service that Sulzer is known for globally. What you’ll be doing:
• Act as a first point of contact for customer spares and repairs enquiries, responding promptly and professionally
• Support the review of customer requirements with internal teams and external suppliers to confirm feasibility, lead times and costs
• Prepare accurate quotations for spares and repairs and issue them to customers in line with internal processes
• Coordinate orders from receipt through to completion, liaising with internal departments, suppliers and customers throughout
• Provide regular updates to customers, ensuring orders and repair activities are tracked and delivered on time
• Maintain accurate records within ERP and CRM systems, supporting reporting on order status, lead times and performance
• Assist with sales and tender activities where required, including preparing supporting information for spares and repairs opportunities What you bring:
• Experience in a spares, repairs, aftermarket, coordination or customer support role within an engineering or industrial environment
• Experience using ERP and CRM systems (Microsoft Dynamics 365 and Salesforce experience is desirable)
• Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities effectively
• Good communication skills, confident working with customers, suppliers and internal stakeholders
• Commercial awareness with an understanding of quotations, pricing and cost control
• A proactive, detail‑focused and solutions‑driven approach, with the ability to perform well in a fast‑paced environment What we offer you Joining Sulzer GT Aero means becoming part of a business with a strong reputation in the gas turbine sector, a clear growth strategy and a collaborative working culture. In return, we offer:
• Competitive base salary with participation in the company‑wide bonus programme
• 33 days’ annual leave (inclusive of bank holidays)
• Free on‑site parking
• Access to discounts on everyday shopping, entertainment and lifestyle services
• Confidential support through our Employee Assistance Programme
• Ongoing learning and development opportunities through on‑the‑job training and Sulzer Learning Pathways Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary

The Senior Pump Mechanic is responsible for the inspection, disassembly, repair, reassembly, balancing, and testing of industrial pumps and rotating equipment in a high-quality service center environment. This role serves as a technical expert for complex repairs, including precision balancing of impellers and assembled rotors, ensuring all work meets OEM specifications, safety standards, and customer requirements. The Senior Pump Mechanic also supports mentoring junior mechanics and contributes to continuous improvement within the repair process. Key Responsibilities

• Perform complete teardown, inspection, and rebuild of centrifugal pumps, multistage pumps, vertical pumps, and other rotating equipment

• Diagnose mechanical issues including wear, imbalance, misalignment, and hydraulic performance problems

• Balance individual components such as impellers as well as fully assembled rotors to meet OEM and industry standards

• Assemble rotating elements including shafts, sleeves, bearings, and impellers with proper fits and tolerances

• Conduct hydrostatic testing on pump cases

• Measure and record tolerances using precision tools (micrometers, calipers, dial indicators, etc.)

• Interpret blueprints, technical drawings, and OEM specifications

• Restore pumps to OEM or engineered specifications

• Maintain a clean, organized, and safe work environment

• Follow all company safety policies, procedures, and regulatory requirements

• Ensure all repairs, assemblies, and balancing activities meet quality standards and customer expectations

• Participate in quality audits and continuous improvement initiatives

Qualifications

• 5–10+ years of experience in pump repair or rotating equipment maintenance

• Strong knowledge of centrifugal pumps and rotating assemblies

• Ability to read and interpret technical drawings and specifications

• Proficiency with precision measuring instruments

• Solid mechanical troubleshooting skills

• Demonstrate willingness and ability to cross-train in multiple work centers

What we offer you

• 15 days of paid time off and 12 company-paid holidays

• 401k plan with a 6% match

• Comprehensive health plan including medical, dental, vision, Life, short-term & long-term disability

• Health savings account matching

• Motivating wellness program

• Employee Assistance Program

• Paid paternal leave

• Gym reimbursement

Il Machine Operator è responsabile del funzionamento e del monitoraggio dei macchinari utilizzati nel processo di produzione. Questo ruolo assicura che le macchine funzionino in modo efficiente, i prodotti soddisfano gli standard di qualità e i protocolli di sicurezza sono seguiti.

About the role

Job Summary
The Applications Engineer is responsible for evaluating customer requirements and developing technical and commercial proposals for industrial equipment solutions. This role serves as a critical link between customers, sales teams, and internal engineering/manufacturing to ensure accurate, timely, and competitive responses to inquiries.
This position operates in a fast-paced, high-volume environment supporting distributors, OEMs, EPCs, and end users across a wide range of applications. Applications include Pulp and Paper, Biofuels, Foods, Chemical processing, Mining / Metals, Industrial wastewater, and Auxiliary equipment in other segments as needed.
The Applications Group is a dynamic organization with both junior and senior engineers who possess a wide range of experience and competencies. This is a great opportunity to contribute to a growing company and offers great mentorship opportunities to enhance professional development.
This role is designed as a foundational position with clear visibility into commercial strategy and customer engagement, offering a defined pathway into Accounts Management and outside sales roles. Key Responsibilities:
Proposal & Technical Evaluation

• Review customer RFQs, specifications, and datasheets to determine appropriate product selection

• Perform pumping equipment sizing, selection, and configuration

• Generate detailed quotations including scope, pricing, and lead time
Customer & Sales Support

• Serve as a technical resource for internal sales teams and external customers

• Support distribution network with product selection, troubleshooting, and application guidance

• Participate in distributor and customer calls, visits, and training as needed

• Support sales efforts by contributing to technical sales strategy, participating in customer discussions, and developing an understanding of commercial drivers behind winning opportunities
Cross-Functional Coordination

• Work closely with the Project Management team to define documentation packages, testing requirements, and customer deliverables early in the quotation phase to ensure accurate scope, compliance, and execution readiness.

• Collaborate with manufacturing, engineering, and supply chain to confirm feasibility, lead times, and cost

• Work with global teams when required to support international or specialized opportunities

• Ensure alignment between customer expectations and internal capabilities
Quote and Opportunity Management

Sulzer est une entreprise d'ingénierie de premier plan avec un fier héritage d'innovation. Rejoignez notre équipe mondiale pour développer votre expertise et développer des solutions innovantes qui permettent une société prospère et plus durable.

Sur le rôle

Résumé de l'emploi
L'ingénieur des applications est chargé d'évaluer les besoins des clients et de développer des propositions techniques et commerciales pour les solutions d'équipement industriel. Ce rôle sert de lien essentiel entre les clients, les équipes de vente et l'ingénierie et la fabrication internes pour assurer des réponses exactes, opportunes et concurrentielles aux demandes de renseignements.
Cette position fonctionne dans un environnement rapide et volumineux qui soutient les distributeurs, les OEM, les EPC et les utilisateurs finaux dans un large éventail d'applications. Les applications comprennent la pâte et le papier, les biocarburants, les aliments, le traitement chimique, les mines / métaux, les eaux usées industrielles et l'équipement auxiliaire dans d'autres segments au besoin.
Le Groupe des applications est une organisation dynamique avec des ingénieurs juniors et seniors qui possèdent un large éventail d'expérience et de compétences. C'est une excellente occasion de contribuer à une entreprise en pleine croissance et offre de grandes possibilités de mentorat pour améliorer le perfectionnement professionnel.
Ce rôle est conçu comme une position de base avec une visibilité claire dans la stratégie commerciale et l'engagement des clients, offrant une voie définie vers la gestion des comptes et les rôles de vente externes. Principales responsabilités :
Proposition et évaluation technique

• Examiner les QDP, les spécifications et les fiches techniques des clients pour déterminer la sélection appropriée des produits

• Effectuer le calibrage, la sélection et la configuration du matériel de pompage

• Générer des devis détaillés incluant la portée, les prix et les délais
Assistance client et ventes

• Servir de ressource technique pour les équipes de vente internes et les clients externes

• Support réseau de distribution avec sélection de produits, dépannage et conseils d'application

• Participer aux appels, visites et formation des distributeurs et des clients au besoin

• Appuyer les efforts de vente en contribuant à la stratégie de vente technique, en participant aux discussions avec les clients et en développant une compréhension des moteurs commerciaux derrière les occasions de gagner
Coordination interfonctionnelle

• Collaborer étroitement avec l'équipe de gestion de projet pour définir les documents, les exigences d'essai et les produits livrables des clients au début de la phase de soumission afin d'assurer la portée exacte, la conformité et la préparation à l'exécution.

• Collaborer avec la fabrication, l'ingénierie et la chaîne d'approvisionnement pour confirmer la faisabilité, les délais et les coûts

• Collaborer avec les équipes mondiales lorsque cela est nécessaire pour appuyer les possibilités internationales ou spécialisées

• Assurer l'alignement entre les attentes des clients et les capacités internes
Gestion des citations et des possibilités

• Gérer simultanément plusieurs RFQ dans un environnement à volume élevé

• Tenir des registres exacts des possibilités, des devis et des communications dans Salesforce (système CRM)
Amélioration continue et soutien de l'équipe

• Identifier les possibilités d'améliorer l'efficacité, l'exactitude et la normalisation des citations

• Appuyer l'élaboration d'outils, de modèles et de documents

• Aider à former les nouveaux membres de l'équipe et partager les connaissances sur les applications

Responsabilités secondaires :

• Exécuter d'autres fonctions selon l'affectation.

Responsabilités en matière de surveillance

• Aucune

Qualifications

• Requis
• Baccalauréat en génie mécanique, génie chimique ou domaine connexe.

• 0-5 ans d'expérience en ingénierie (industriel, process, applications, pompes et hydraulique)

• Fortes compétences en analyse et en résolution de problèmes

• Capacité de gérer plusieurs priorités dans des délais serrés

• Excellentes compétences en communication (écrites et verbales)

• Volonté de voyager au besoin

descriptionByLocale.en:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

We are seeking a highly motivated and commercially minded Strategic Projects Manager to drive critical strategic initiatives across our global services organization. This is a high-impact role working closely with senior leadership to identify growth opportunities, lead transformational projects, support strategic decision-making, and enhance business performance across multiple regions.

The successful candidate will combine strong analytical capabilities, business acumen, and project management expertise to deliver initiatives that accelerate growth, improve operational effectiveness, and strengthen our competitive position in the market.

• Lead and drive cross functional and global strategic projects to ensure that high performance levels are attained

• Lead projects to support growth plans across all the regions of Services: projects include (but not limited to): footprint expansion, market assessment, partnerships, digitalization projects, operational excellence programs, etc.

• Benchmark and report on competitor’s business models and major moves

• Conduct regular peer firm analysis (League table)

• Participate and support the management team in the annual strategic planning and budgeting process

• Summarize industry M&A transactions by region and industry

• Provide support in leading M&A processes across the Division from ideation to closing

• Support in drafting of Board and Executive committee documents

Requirements

• Proven experience in strategy, business transformation, corporate development, management consulting, project management, or a similar strategic role.

• Demonstrated success leading cross-functional projects in a complex global environment.

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English; additional languages are advantageous.

• Strong understanding of business financials, investment evaluation, and commercial performance metrics.

• Experience creating executive-level presentations and strategic recommendations.

• Strategic thinker with the ability to translate data into actionable business insights, High levels of accountability, integrity, and drive for results.

• Ability to synthesize complex information and communicate key conclusions effectively.

• Collaborative stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence across regions and functions.

• QlikView/Qlik Sens experience is a plus

• Excellent Excel and PowerPoint skills

What we offer you

• A competitive salary as well as participation in the variable remuneration system based on personal and financial objectives.

• Meal vouchers.

• Access to a voluntary flexible compensation scheme allowing employees to optimize their salary package (e.g. health insurance, transport, childcare)

• Offices location: Nuevos Ministerios

• A high-impact global role with visibility across the organisation.

• The opportunity to shape and expand a fast-growing global services business.

• A collaborative and supportive environment focused on innovation and continuous improvement.

• Strong career development opportunities in a dynamic, evolving market.

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Sulzer est une entreprise d'ingénierie de premier plan avec un fier héritage d'innovation. Rejoignez notre équipe mondiale pour développer votre expertise et développer des solutions innovantes qui permettent une société prospère et plus durable. Sur le rôle Nous sommes à la recherche d'un gestionnaire de projets stratégiques hautement motivé et d'esprit commercial pour diriger des initiatives stratégiques critiques dans notre organisation mondiale de services. Il s'agit d'un rôle à fort impact qui travaille en étroite collaboration avec les cadres supérieurs pour cerner les possibilités de croissance, diriger des projets de transformation, appuyer la prise de décisions stratégiques et améliorer le rendement des entreprises dans plusieurs régions. Le candidat retenu combinera de solides capacités d'analyse, un sens des affaires et une expertise en gestion de projet pour réaliser des initiatives qui accélèrent la croissance, améliorent l'efficacité opérationnelle et renforcent notre position concurrentielle sur le marché.
• Diriger et piloter des projets stratégiques transfonctionnels et mondiaux pour garantir des niveaux de performance élevés
• Diriger les projets à l'appui des plans de croissance dans toutes les régions des Services : les projets comprennent (mais sans s'y limiter) : expansion de l'empreinte, évaluation du marché, partenariats, projets de numérisation, programmes d'excellence opérationnelle, etc.
• Benchmark et rapport sur les modèles d'affaires concurrents et les grands mouvements
• Effectuer régulièrement une analyse par les pairs (tableau League)
• Participer et appuyer l'équipe de gestion dans le processus annuel de planification stratégique et de budgétisation
• Résumer les transactions de fusions-acquisitions par région et par industrie
• Fournir un appui pour diriger les processus de fusion-acquisition dans l'ensemble de la Division, de l'idée à la clôture
• Appui à la rédaction des documents du Conseil et du Comité exécutif Exigences
• Expérience éprouvée dans les domaines de la stratégie, de la transformation opérationnelle, du développement de l'entreprise, du conseil en gestion, de la gestion de projet ou d'un rôle stratégique semblable.
• Succès démontré menant des projets interfonctionnels dans un environnement mondial complexe.
• Excellentes compétences en communication orale et écrite en anglais; d'autres langues sont avantageuses.
• Bonne compréhension des finances des entreprises, de l'évaluation des investissements et des indicateurs de rendement commercial.
• Expérience de la création de présentations et de recommandations stratégiques au niveau des cadres.
• Un penseur stratégique ayant la capacité de traduire les données en données opérationnelles exploitables, des niveaux élevés de responsabilisation, d'intégrité et de recherche de résultats.
• Capacité de synthétiser l'information complexe et de communiquer efficacement les principales conclusions.
• Compétences de gestion des intervenants en collaboration avec la capacité d'influencer les régions et les fonctions.
• L'expérience QlikView/Qlik Sens est un plus
• Excellentes compétences Excel et PowerPoint Ce que nous vous offrons
• Un salaire compétitif ainsi que la participation au système de rémunération variable fondé sur des objectifs personnels et financiers.
• Des bons de repas.
• Accès à un système volontaire de rémunération flexible permettant aux salariés d'optimiser leur salaire (par exemple assurance maladie, transport, garde d'enfants)
• Lieu des bureaux: Nuevos Ministerios
• Un rôle mondial à fort impact avec visibilité dans l'ensemble de l'organisation.
• L'occasion de façonner et de développer une entreprise mondiale de services en croissance rapide.
• Un environnement de collaboration et de soutien axé sur l'innovation et l'amélioration continue.
• De solides possibilités de carrière dans un marché dynamique et en évolution. Sulzer est un employeur à chances égales. Nous croyons en la force d'un effectif diversifié et sommes déterminés à offrir un milieu de travail inclusif. Nous sommes fiers d'être reconnus comme l'un des meilleurs employeurs 2026 au Brésil, au Canada, en Chine, en Finlande, en Allemagne, en Irlande, au Mexique, en Suisse, en Afrique du Sud, au Royaume-Uni et aux États-Unis.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Designs and delivers hands on mechanical training courses (1–2 weeks) that build foundational and advanced turbomachinery skills, guiding new hires through core concepts, job book exercises, and real-world inspection and assembly practices while evaluating their proficiency. Develops and continuously improves training curricula, materials, and programs to address skill gaps, enhance safety and productivity, and ensure effective onboarding and ongoing workforce upskilling. Responsibilities
• Leading novice mechanical training courses
• Helping to develop the next generation of mechanical talent within our organization
• Guiding groups through the critical job book exercises
• Teaching refined mechanical skills throughout the disassembly, inspection and reassembly stages of an overall
• Verifying an employee’s ability to apply measurement methods to real world inspection scenarios
• Guide new hires through basic terminology and turbomachinery overview
• Identify current and future training needs and create a curriculum to facilitate that training
• Refining and developing mechanical training materials
• Advancing the modules that have already been created
• Building out adjacent training modules for other equipment types
• Developing training aides for specialized tasks.
• Leading periodic advance mechanical upskilling training efforts
• Supporting aspects of new hire shop orientation
• Supporting occasional outage Production Supervision responsibilities/oversight
• Search for gaps in training content and materials that need updating to generate higher productivity and safety among staff
• Researching new training supplies and materials that can enhance Sulzer’s training procedures while providing value to employees
• Communicating with management, trainers, and team members to ensure that all training needs are met
• Conducting technical orientation programs and arranging on-the-job training for new hires as needed
• Resolving any specific problems and tailoring training programs as necessary
• Provide documentation of employees performance during training to supervision and upper management including aptitude, attitude, and academic performance.
• Maintain records from all training classes. Qualifications:
• Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering, Education, or similar related disciplines and/or a combination of training, experience, and education.
• 5 or more years of technical training experience in an industrial and/or manufacturing setting
• Significant experience creating technical training curriculums and programs
• Ability to plan, manage time, and multitask effectively
• Advanced database and computer skills
• Excellent verbal and written communication skills
• Advanced record-keeping skills
• Good decision-making, problem-solving, collaboration and teamwork skills
• Leadership and motivational skills are a plus What we offer you
• 15 days of paid time off and 12 company-paid holidays
• 401k plan with a 6% match
• Comprehensive health plan including medical, dental, vision, Life, short-term & long-term disability
• Motivating wellness program
• Employee Assistance Program
• Paid paternal leave
• Gym re-imbursement
• New onsite cafeteria, all meals subsidized (La Porte Service Center) Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer è una società di ingegneria leader con un patrimonio orgoglioso di innovazione. Unisciti al nostro team globale per accrescere le tue competenze e sviluppare soluzioni innovative che consentano una società prospera e più sostenibile.

Informazioni sul ruolo

In qualità di tecnico del servizio sul campo (m/f/d), sei un punto di contatto centrale per i nostri clienti nel settore e garantisci un funzionamento affidabile dei nostri impianti di trattamento acque e acque reflue. Si assume la responsabilità per le operazioni di servizio, la manutenzione e la messa in servizio direttamente sul sito e contribuiscono in modo significativo all'alta qualità del servizio della nostra azienda. Attendere con ansia una variegata attività con un sacco di responsabilità tecnica, contatto diretto con i clienti e attrezzature di lavoro modernamente attrezzate. I loro compiti

• Garantire una sequenza di servizio fluida, conveniente e orientata al cliente

• Attuazione delle operazioni di servizio negli impianti di trattamento delle acque e delle acque reflue

• Sostituzione di parti di ricambio e usura, nonché l'esecuzione di riparazioni, lavori di ristrutturazione e manutenzione direttamente presso il sito del cliente

• Analisi e correzione di guasti tecnici

• Lavoro di officina e assemblaggio

• Costruzione e smantellamento e messa in servizio dei nostri impianti di prova

• Preparazione di relazioni analitiche e relazioni tecniche di base dettagliate

• Supporto dei nostri clienti, compresa l'implementazione della formazione dei clienti

Il tuo profilo

• Formazione tecnica completa, ad esempio in ingegneria meccanica, manutenzione, ingegneria idrica o qualifica equivalente

• La conoscenza nella saldatura E e TIG è vantaggiosa

• Patente di guida nella categoria B (ex classe 3)

• Alta disponibilità a viaggiare nel contesto delle attività di servizio esterno

• Metodo di lavoro autonomo, strutturato e conveniente

• Lavoro di squadra, indipendenza e flessibilità

• Forte comunicazione e forza di ragionamento

• Conoscenza molto buona del tedesco in parola e scrittura, conoscenza dell'inglese desiderabile

• Conoscenza di base di MS Word e Excel e l'esperienza nel trattare con Salesforce

Cosa ti offriamo

• Una posizione sicura in un'azienda moderna e orientata al futuro

• Un ambiente di lavoro piacevole e collegiale

• Conoscenze intensive e formazione regolare

• Alta responsabilità personale e varie attività

• Prestazioni sociali interessanti, ad esempio pensioni professionali e assicurazioni dirette

• Veicolo aziendale (auto da laboratorio), telefono cellulare aziendale e taccuino aziendale

• Possibilità di utilizzo direttamente dal luogo di residenza

• Varie ulteriori opportunità di formazione

Sulzer è un datore di lavoro pari opportunità. Crediamo nella forza di una forza lavoro diversificata e ci impegniamo ad offrire un ambiente di lavoro inclusivo.

Siamo orgogliosi di essere riconosciuti come Top Employer 2026 in Brasile, Canada, Cina, Finlandia, Germania, Irlanda, Messico, Svizzera, Sudafrica, Regno Unito e Stati Uniti.
descriptionByLocale.en:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

As a field service technician (m/f/d), you are a central point of contact for our customers in the field and ensure reliable operation of our water and wastewater treatment plants. You assume responsibility for service operations, maintenance and commissioning directly on site and contribute significantly to the high service quality of our company. Look forward to a varied activity with a lot of technical responsibility, direct customer contact and modernly equipped work equipment. Their tasks

• Ensuring a smooth, cost-conscious and customer-oriented service sequence

• Implementation of service operations at water and wastewater treatment plants

• Replacement of spare and wear parts as well as carrying out repairs, renovations and maintenance work directly at the customer's site

• Analysis and correction of technical failures

• Workshop and assembly work

• Construction and dismantling as well as commissioning of our test facilities

• Preparation of analytical reports and detailed basic technical reports

• Support of our customers including implementation of customer training

Your profile

• Completed technical training, e.g. in mechanical engineering, maintenance, water engineering or equivalent qualification

• Knowledge in E and TIG welding is advantageous

• Driving licence in category B (formerly class 3)

• High willingness to travel in the context of external service activities

• Self-responsible, structured and cost-conscious working method

• Teamwork, independence and flexibility

• Strong communication and reasoning strength

• Very good knowledge of German in word and writing, knowledge of English desirable

• Basic knowledge of MS Word and Excel as well as experience in dealing with Salesforce

What we offer you

• A secure position in a modern and future-oriented company

• A pleasant and collegial working atmosphere

• Intensive familiarisation and regular training

• High personal responsibility and varied tasks

• Attractive social benefits, e.g. occupational pensions and direct insurance

• Company vehicle (workshop car), company mobile phone and company notebook

• Possibility of use directly from the place of residence

• Various further and further training opportunities

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

About the role

Als Field Service Techniker (m/w/d) sind Sie ein zentraler Ansprechpartner für unsere Kunden im Außendienst und sorgen für einen zuverlässigen Betrieb unserer Anlagen zur Wasser- und Abwasseraufbereitung. Sie übernehmen eigenverantwortlich Serviceeinsätze, Wartungen und Inbetriebnahmen direkt vor Ort und tragen maßgeblich zur hohen Servicequalität unseres Unternehmens bei. Freuen Sie sich auf eine abwechslungsreiche Tätigkeit mit viel technischer Verantwortung, direktem Kundenkontakt und modern ausgestatteten Arbeitsmitteln. Ihre Aufgaben

• Sicherstellung eines reibungslosen, kostenbewussten und kundenorientierten Serviceablaufs

• Durchführung von Serviceeinsätzen an Anlagen zur Aufbereitung von Wasser und Abwasser

• Austausch von Ersatz- und Verschleißteilen sowie Durchführung von Reparaturen, Sanierungen und Wartungsarbeiten direkt beim Kunden vor Ort

• Analyse und Behebung technischer Störungen

• Durchführung von Werkstatt- und Montagearbeiten

• Auf- und Abbau sowie Inbetriebnahme unserer Versuchsanlagen

• Erstellung von Analyseberichten sowie ausführlichen technischen Basisberichten

• Betreuung unserer Kunden inklusive Durchführung von Kundenschulungen

Ihr Profil

• Abgeschlossene technische Ausbildung, z. B. im Maschinenbau, in der Instandhaltung, Wassertechnik oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation

• Kenntnisse im E- und WIG-Schweißen von Vorteil

• Führerschein der Klasse B (ehemals Klasse 3)

• Hohe Reisebereitschaft im Rahmen der Außendiensttätigkeit

• Eigenverantwortliche, strukturierte und kostenbewusste Arbeitsweise

• Teamfähigkeit, Selbstständigkeit sowie Flexibilität

• Ausgeprägte Kommunikations- und Argumentationsstärke

• Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift, Englischkenntnisse wünschenswert

• Grundkenntnisse in MS Word und Excel sowie Erfahrung im Umgang mit Salesforce von Vorteil

What we offer you

• Eine sichere Position in einem modernen und zukunftsorientierten Unternehmen

• Ein angenehmes und kollegiales Betriebsklima

• Eine intensive Einarbeitung sowie regelmäßige Schulungen

• Hohe Eigenverantwortung und abwechslungsreiche Aufgaben

• Attraktive Sozialleistungen, z. B. betriebliche Altersvorsorge und Direktversicherungen

• Firmenfahrzeug (Werkstattwagen), Firmenhandy und Firmennotebook

• Einsatzmöglichkeit direkt vom Wohnort aus

• Vielfältige Weiter- und Fortbildungsmöglichkeiten

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

Sulzer est une entreprise d'ingénierie de premier plan avec un fier héritage d'innovation. Rejoignez notre équipe mondiale pour développer votre expertise et développer des solutions innovantes qui permettent une société prospère et plus durable.

Sur le rôle

En tant que technicien de service sur le terrain (m/f/d), vous êtes un point de contact central pour nos clients sur le terrain et assurer un fonctionnement fiable de nos stations de traitement de l'eau et des eaux usées. Vous assumez la responsabilité des opérations de service, de maintenance et de mise en service directement sur le site et contribuez de façon significative à la qualité de service élevée de notre entreprise. Nous nous réjouissons d'une activité variée avec beaucoup de responsabilité technique, de contact direct avec le client et d'équipement de travail moderne. Leurs tâches

• Assurer une séquence de service en douceur, soucieuse des coûts et orientée vers le client

• Mise en œuvre des opérations de service dans les stations de traitement des eaux et des eaux usées

• Remplacement des pièces de rechange et d'usure ainsi que des travaux de réparation, de rénovation et d'entretien directement sur le site du client

• Analyse et correction des défaillances techniques

• Travaux d ' atelier et de montage

• Construction et démontage ainsi que mise en service de nos installations d'essai

• Élaboration de rapports analytiques et de rapports techniques de base détaillés

• Soutien de nos clients y compris la mise en œuvre de la formation des clients

Votre profil

• Formation technique complétée, p.ex. en génie mécanique, entretien, génie de l'eau ou qualification équivalente

• La connaissance du soudage E et TIG est avantageuse

• Permis de conduire dans la catégorie B (anciennement classe 3)

• Une grande volonté de voyager dans le cadre des activités de services externes

• Méthode de travail autoresponsable, structurée et soucieuse des coûts

• Travail d'équipe, indépendance et flexibilité

• Forte force de communication et de raisonnement

• Très bonne connaissance de l'allemand en paroles et en écriture, connaissance de l'anglais souhaitable

• Connaissance de base de MS Word et Excel ainsi que l'expérience dans le traitement de Salesforce

Ce que nous vous offrons

• Une position sûre dans une entreprise moderne et tournée vers l'avenir

• Une atmosphère de travail agréable et collégiale

• Familiarisation intensive et formation régulière

• Haute responsabilité personnelle et tâches variées

• Prestations sociales attractives, par exemple pensions professionnelles et assurance directe

• Véhicule d'entreprise (voiture d'atelier), téléphone portable d'entreprise et portable d'entreprise

• Possibilité d'utilisation directement depuis le lieu de résidence

• Différentes possibilités de formation continue

Sulzer est un employeur à chances égales. Nous croyons en la force d'une main-d'oeuvre diversifiée et sommes déterminés à offrir un milieu de travail inclusif.

Nous sommes fiers d'être reconnus comme l'un des meilleurs employeurs 2026 au Brésil, au Canada, en Chine, en Finlande, en Allemagne, en Irlande, au Mexique, en Suisse, en Afrique du Sud, au Royaume-Uni et aux États-Unis.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role We are looking for a Service Centre Manager to lead our Ipswich and Southampton Service Centres. This is a pivotal, multi-site leadership role shaping the future of our UK operations, combining strategic oversight, operational excellence, and cultural transformation. Our Southampton and Ipswich sites bring together skilled specialists delivering overhaul, repair, and upgrade services for pumps, turbines, compressors, and other rotating machinery. Working with major global energy companies, utilities, and industrial operators, we’re focused on reliability, innovation, and customer success. Your main tasks and responsibilities:
• Own the P&L for both the Southampton and Ipswich Service Centres, delivering expected returns while maintaining exceptional safety and customer satisfaction.
• Lead and role model strong health and safety behaviours, embedding a positive, proactive safety culture across both locations.
• Develop a future‑ready organisation, ensuring capability, workforce planning, and talent management are effectively aligned across the two sites.
• Execute business growth plans, identifying and realising market and product opportunities while effectively managing risk.
• Build, coach, and develop high‑performing management teams at both sites, ensuring consistency in standards, behaviours, and operational practices.
• Monitor, analyse, and report on performance, using key metrics to drive accountability and continuous improvement.
• Collaborate closely with Sales and Commercial teams to align operational capacity with customer requirements (SIOP).
• Embed compliance and operational excellence, ensuring both sites consistently follow best practices.
• Communicate strategy, progress, and results clearly, both within and across the wider regional operations organisation. To succeed in this role, you will need:
• Proven experience leading people in an operational environment, ideally across multiple sites in an Industrial Engineering environment
• Experience in business management, P&L ownership, and aftermarket or service-based environments.
• A track record of driving transformation, growth, or organisational change.
• Strong understanding of health, safety, and environmental requirements.
• LEAN/Continuous Improvement experience (desirable).
• NEBOSH qualification (desirable). What we offer you
• A competitive basic salary
• An annual bonus based on a combination of company performance and your individual contribution
• Private Medical Insurance
• Car / Car Allowance
• 33 days annual leave.
• Defined pension contributions.
• Confidential support via Employee Assistance Programmes.
• Discounted personal car leasing for you, your family, and friends.
• Long Service Awards celebrating your commitment.
• Continuous learning opportunities through Sulzer Learning Pathways.
• As a Bronze Award holder of the MoD Defence Employer Recognition Scheme, we welcome and support veterans, reservists and Cadet Adult Volunteers with policies for training, camps and deployment, plus a growing internal military network. Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role We’re looking for a Senior Project Manager to lead the execution of complex, long‑term customer contracts (e.g., LTSA / framework agreements) and high‑risk projects. You’ll be the key link between our customers and internal teams—bringing people together, keeping delivery on track, and building strong, long‑term partnerships. In this role, you’ll lead cross‑functional teams in a matrix environment, communicate confidently with senior customer stakeholders, and spot opportunities to grow the business. Main accountabilities and tasks
• Ensure contractual execution within cost, time, quality and Sulzer PM standards
• Manage financial performance of customer contracts, including cost control, forecasting and invoicing aligned with as‑sold budgets and milestones
• Act as primary customer interface: contract updates, issue resolution, claims, variations and addenda negotiations
• Present contract progress to senior management on a regular basis
• Create and maintain customer, contract and project data, proposals, TOA calculations, purchase orders and scope releases in the Business Management System
• Coordinate project handovers and communication between customers, execution centers and operations
• Lead and manage project teams within a matrix organization
• Ensure full contractual compliance, handle NCRs and customer complaints
• Develop business insights, business cases and support continuous improvement initiatives
• Support customer visits, ensure safety inductions, PPE compliance and ESH requirements
• Promote quality improvements, safety awareness and identify risks and improvement opportunities, escalating with recommended solutions What we're looking for:
• 9+ years of experience in project and contract management, preferably in complex and international environments
• Experience with industrial rotating equipment
• Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering preferred; project management background is a plus
• Recognized project management certification (e.g. PRINCE2, PMI, PM²) or equivalent degree
• Strong experience in contract and commercial management, including legal aspects
• Confident communication and negotiation skills at senior customer management level
• Proven ability to lead cross‑functional teams in a matrix organization
• Strong communication skills; proactive, well‑organized and solution‑driven people manager
• Fluent English required
• Willingness to travel 25–50% worldwide What we offer you
• 8% holiday allowance and up to 40 days of annual leave
• A solid pension scheme with attractive employer contribution
• Travel allowance for commuting (EUR 0.23/km, tax-free)
• Free coffee, tea and water , plus access to an on-site canteen with fresh and affordable meals
• Free parking on-site
• Employee benefit programs such as Bike leasing with tax advantages and Gym contribution
• A staff association offering social activities and seasonal gifts
• Training and development opportunities aligned with your role and personal development plan Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

• Customer oriented behaviour
• Organizational and time management skills
• Ability to act independently and proactively
• Flexibility and ability to adapt to change
• Attention to detail and understanding of the importance of quality
• Analytical mind, capacity to understand problems and solve them

• Solid understanding of modern web development technologies, architecture, and best practices.

Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Job Summary The HR Sr. Officer is responsible for delivering HR services and supporting day-to-day HR operations. This role assists in recruitment, onboarding, and employee support, ensuring compliance with policies and procedures. This job profile is intended for experienced professionals who apply practical knowledge of a job area and work independently with general supervision. The HR Representative provides hands-on operational and administrative support to the HRBP team, ensuring efficient execution of core HR processes. This role focuses on reducing transactional workload, improving data accuracy, and supporting payroll and HR systems processes so HRBPs can focus on strategic business initiatives. Key Responsibilities
• Act as day to day HR Support for assigned employee base
• Act as the primary support resource for HRBPs, assisting with day-to-day operational tasks
• Prepare and execute HR transactions in Workday and other systems (e.g., job changes, compensation updates, transfers)
• Draft communications and documentation to support business and HR initiatives
• Ensure timely follow-up on HR action items and requests
• Serve as a liaison between HRBPs and Payroll to support accurate and timely processing
• Validate data changes between HRIS (e.g., Workday) and payroll systems (e.g., ADP) to ensure alignment
• Reduce manual rework by leveraging reporting and system tools to capture employee changes
• Identify discrepancies and escalate issues proactively for resolution
• Support efforts to streamline payroll-related processes and minimize duplicate tracking
• Run and analyze standard reports (e.g., change reports, headcount, audit reports)
• Monitor data integrity across HR systems and address inconsistencies
• Support audits and compliance checks related to employee data and payroll
• Respond to employee and manager inquiries related to HR processes, pay, benefits, and data
• Provide guidance on system use (e.g., Workday self-service)

Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role The Equipment Service Technician provides first level customer support for rental units deployed in the field. You will test, diagnose, troubleshoot, repair, and debug electro-mechanical processing equipment and related systems. You must be able to communication and to work closely with Engineering, Project Management, and other Field Technicians on complex problems and assume responsibilities for continued customer satisfaction. This position requires frequent travel to customer sites to assist with installation, start-up, servicing/repairing Wastewater Treatment Equipment (WWTE) and related sub-systems, and Operator training. Principle Duties and Responsibilities:
• Assist the Service Technician at FRC2 with the refurbishment of rental units.
• Able and willing to travel 50% to 60% of the time to perform service-related tasks at customer sites.
• Troubleshoot a variety of Industrial WWTE and resolve mechanical, electrical, and performance issues.
• Assist customers on the phone and/or in the field with troubleshooting equipment.
• Prepare detailed reports related to site visits, equipment problems/concerns/recommendations.
• Adhere to safety policies and use of safety equipment.
• Adhere to Corporate credit card and travel procedures.
• Position requires the ability to work extensive hours outdoors in sometimes less than ideal situations (adverse weather, noise, and possibly wet conditions)
• Physical Demand – Move and/or lift up to 50lbs, constant movement – standing, climbing, and walking.
• FRC is a Drug-Free Workplace, Employment subject to passing a drug test. Education
• 2 years of technical trade or equivalent experience.
• Course work or prior verifiable work experience with installing, troubleshooting and/or repairing electrical/pneumatic/automated/industrial equipment.
• Must have mechanical aptitude with ability to use various hand/power tools to install/maintain equipment.
• Knowledge of electrical components and understanding of electrical current flow with ability to identify and troubleshoot the same. Requirements:
• Able and willing to travel a minimum 50% - 60% of the time.
• Able and willing to learn and apply required customer service skills.
• Able to learn, produce, and submit accurate service and expense reports in a timely manner.
• Prefer experience in mechanical and electrical repair on industrial wastewater equipment.
• Prefer knowledge of automated machine controls.
• Able to read and follow blueprints, machine drawings, and electrical drawings.
• Proficient in the use of a laptop computer and Microsoft Office suite.
• Able to use a variety of common power and hand tools.
• Able to work safely and efficiently according to industry standards.
• Valid driver’s license.
• Strong troubleshooting ability – The ability to look at the overall picture and determine source of problem/issue.
• Ability to qualify for a US passport. Working Conditions
• Requires about 50% - 60% travel and may include non-traditional work hours.
• Ready and willing to assist the service technician at the FRC 2 facility when not travelling.
• Industrial Wastewater Treatment facility which can be cold or hot and damp environment.
• Use of personal protection devices (ear plugs, hard hat, and eye protection).
• When not traveling, work may need to be completed from hotels, and/or office. What we offer you
• 12 Paid Holidays
• 15 Paid Time Off (PTO) Days
• Medical, dental, vision, life & disability insurance
• 401k with 6% company match
• Employee Assistance Program
• Employee Wellness Program
• Bonus Programs Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are

Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Job Summary The Tendering Engineer is responsible for providing technical support to sales teams and conducting technical analysis of product configurations to determine customer-specific pricing. This job profile is intended for early-career professionals who apply broad theoretical knowledge and require the ability to investigate and analyze problems. Solutions are typically discussed/verified with a more senior member. JOB SUMMARY: The Tendering & Purchasing Specialist is responsible for managing the end‑to‑end tendering, sourcing, and purchasing activities for materials, components, and services used in the manufacture of safety‑related and non‑safety‑related nuclear power plant parts. This role ensures compliance with stringent nuclear quality standards, regulatory requirements, and company procedures while achieving cost, quality, and delivery objectives. The ideal candidate must have the ability to interpret Bills of Materials (BOMs) and technical drawings to accurately estimate costs and prepare proposals. This role requires close collaboration with sales, engineering, procurement, and finance teams to develop winning submissions and support business growth. PRINCIPAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES: · Prepare and manage RFQs, tenders, and purchase orders · Evaluate supplier offers for commercial, technical, and quality compliance · Negotiate pricing, lead times, and terms · Ensure adherence to nuclear quality standards and documentation requirements · Coordinate with engineering, quality, and production teams · Track orders, expedite deliveries, and resolve supplier issues SECONDARY DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:
• Keep department manager apprised of future opportunities.
• Advise management of changes in current order and tender status.
• Actively involved with standardization and continuous improvement processes.
• Maintain quote and order files.
• Adheres to company and department policies, procedures, and standards
• Supports, cooperates with, and participates in company-wide LEAN and QESH Management System which includes following all safety, health and environmental policies and procedures.
• Performs other duties as assigned. EDUCATION, KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS & ABILITIES:
• Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business, Supply Chain, a related field, or relative work experience.
• Minimum 1 year of experience in tendering, purchasing, cost estimation, or bid management in a manufacturing or industrial environment.
• Proficiency in reading and interpreting BOMs and technical drawings.
• Strong understanding of manufacturing processes, materials, and cost structures.
• Experience with ERP systems (SAP), SalesForce and Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint) preferred but not required.
• Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills.
• Strong communication and negotiation abilities.
• High attention to detail and ability to meet tight deadlines. What we offer you Country Benefits:
• 15 days of paid time off and 12 company-paid holidays
• 401k plan with a 6% match
• Comprehensive health plan including medical, dental, vision, Life, short-term & long-term disability
• Health savings account matching
• Motivating wellness program
• Employee Assistance Program
• Paid paternal leave
• Gym reimbursement Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role The Environmental, Safety & Health (ESH) Supervisor is responsible for leading safety initiatives, compliance programs, and environmental standards across multiple field service locations. This role provides direct supervision of safety processes, supports environmental compliance, and ensures field crews operate safely and in alignment with regulatory and customer requirements. Partnering with operations, HR, and corporate EHS to drive a proactive safety culture, oversee training and compliance systems, and provide hands-on job site support to protect people, equipment, and the environment. • Supervise and guide ESH activities across Houston, New Orleans, and field service operations.
• Lead implementation of safety programs, SSE initiatives, and environmental compliance efforts.
• Ensure consistent execution of OSHA, DOT, ISO, and customer safety standards.
• Work with project managers, site supervisors, and contractors to integrate safety into operations and project planning.
• Conduct monthly safety meetings with supervisors and oversee annual safety goal setting, incentive programs, and continuous improvement projects. Environmental Compliance
• Ensure compliance with environmental regulations, permitting, and reporting requirements.
• Oversee hazardous waste management, spill kit inspections, and air/noise/chemical monitoring
• Support facility audits and ensure emergency environmental response plans are in place and tested. Safety Training & Records Management
• Manage new hire safety onboarding and orientation in partnership with HR and Medical.
• Oversee training compliance through TrainingToday, 360Training, and other platforms.
• Ensure OSHA 30, confined space, fall protection, rigging, and site-specific training are current.
• Coordinate external training such as NCCCO, NCCER, CSHO, and Safe Bolting - tracking completion rates against annual targets. Field Safety Leadership
• Conduct site visits for high-risk or large-scale jobs, near misses, or incidents.
• Participate in pre-job planning with operations and supervisors to evaluate scope, risks, and safety requirements.
• Develop, implement, and distribute Safety Execution Plans (SEPs) for each project, tailored to customer requirements and site-specific risks.
• Communicate plans to supervisors, crews, and subcontractors before mobilization.
• Provide onsite support for Daily Safety Meetings/Toolbox Talks, JSAs, WIP reports, PPE checks, inspections, and safety coaching.
• Inspect tool units and field equipment regularly to identify tools or equipment that may have slipped through initial inspections, ensuring unsafe items are removed from service immediately.
• Lead or support incident investigations, root cause analysis, and corrective action tracking.
• Partner with Field Service Supervisors to ensure lockout/tagout (LOTO), lift plans, and job permits meet standards. Express any concern to the Supervisor and plan for any improvements.
• Support medical response and injury management in coordination with Prime GS and external providers. Compliance Systems & Reporting
• Ensure subcontractors and vendors follow site-specific safety plans and meet compliance requirements set by the customer.
• Conduct site audits, verify qualifications, and equipment maintenance/inspection records. (forklift, overhead crane, rigging, etc.).
• Oversee contractor compliance platforms (ISNetworld, Avetta, NCMS, Veriforce).
• Manage OSHA logs, DOT compliance, certificates of insurance, ISO requirements, and EMR reporting.
• Coordinate internal and external audits; oversee documentation and corrective action closeouts.

About the role Job Summary The Sr. Tendering Engineer is responsible for providing technical support to sales teams and conducting technical analysis of product configurations to determine customer-specific pricing. This job profile is intended for experienced professionals who apply practical knowledge of a job area and work independently with general supervision. Position Summary We are seeking a detail-oriented and technically proficient Tendering Engineer to support proposal development for equipment and services supplied to nuclear power plants. The ideal candidate will have 3–5 years of experience working with industrial pumps or strong pump application knowledge, and a solid understanding of tendering processes in highly regulated environments. This role involves preparing competitive, compliant proposals, coordinating across engineering, procurement, and project teams, and ensuring strict adherence to nuclear industry standards and customer specifications. Key Responsibilities
• Review and analyze RFQs and customer specifications related to nuclear pump systems
• Prepare technical proposals for pumps and related parts
• Interpret datasheets, and technical drawings to ensure accurate scope definition
• Collaborate with sales, engineering, purchasing, quality, and project management teams to develop compliant bids
• Conduct cost estimation, including materials, labor, manufacturing, and third-party components
• Ensure compliance with nuclear standards (e.g., ASME, RCC-M, ISO, QA requirements)
• Identify risks and opportunities within tender documents and propose mitigation strategies
• Support post-bid clarification meetings and customer discussions
• Maintain tender documentation, bid logs, and lessons learned
• Contribute to continuous improvement of proposal processes and tools Qualifications & Experience Required:
• 3–5 years of experience in pump systems, rotating equipment, or fluid handling systems
• Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business, Supply Chain, a related field, or relative work experience.
• Proven experience in technical tendering, proposals, or applications engineering
• Strong knowledge of Nuclear pumps
• Ability to read and interpret technical specifications, drawings, cross sections, and datasheets Preferred:
• Experience supplying equipment to nuclear, power generation, or highly regulated industries
• Familiarity with nuclear quality standards and documentation requirements
• Exposure to ERP/CRM systems and costing tools such as SAP and Salesforce Technical Skills
• Pump selection, sizing, and application knowledge
• Understanding of materials, hydraulics, and system integration
• Costing and commercial awareness
• Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint)
• Ability to work with technical and commercial documentation
• High attention to detail and ability to meet tight deadlines. What we offer you

Unisciti al nostro team globale per accrescere le tue competenze e sviluppare soluzioni innovative che consentano una società prospera e più sostenibile. Questo ruolo assicura che le metodologie ingegneristiche soddisfino gli standard scientifici e industriali e supporta l'organizzazione nel raggiungimento degli obiettivi tecnici, funzionali e di costo. Responsabilità del lavoro
• Guidare il team di ingegnere di produzione per finire il lavoro quotidiano, come la creazione di routing, la ripresa dei problemi, progettazione degli strumenti, implementazione magra, miglioramento della qualità e riduzione dei costi.
• Identificare i requisiti di ordine e rilasciare a diverse funzioni.
• Problemi meccanici di tiro e Root causa analisi.
• Strumenti di progettazione/selezione/preparazione per diversi ordini e prodotti.
• Lavorare con un team diverso per risolvere i problemi di produzione e fornire problemi di applicazione pompa RRCA relativi al workshop.
• Sostenere il team di test per risolvere problemi di vibrazione, tenuta e guasto dei cuscinetti con l'analisi della causa radice.
• Creazione di routine secondo il tipo di prodotto diverso, requisito tecnico e specifiche del cliente.

• Almeno 5-8 anni di esperienza lavorativa nell'industria meccanica, l'industria della pompa è preferita.

• 11 giorni festivi e massimo 15 giorni di ferie annuali.

• Premi di servizio lunghi.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Sulzer has a proud heritage of over 180 years in engineering excellence, specialising in pumps, agitators, compressors, and critical rotating equipment across industries. At our Sutton-in-Ashfield Service Centre, we lead the way in delivering world-class electro-mechanical repairs and overhauls for the UK Rail Sector – ensuring the reliability and safety of the trains that keep our country moving. A key part of this is precision winding. From traction motors to auxiliary systems, expertly rewound motors are essential for keeping fleets operational, efficient, and on schedule. Every coil, every turn matters and that’s where our skilled team makes the difference. We are looking for an experienced Mechnaical Fitter to join us, helping maintain the highest standards in motor rewinds and repairs for our rail customers. Job Responsibilities
• Dismantle, rewind, reassemble, and test single-phase and three-phase AC motors, small DC motors, and associated equipment including pumps and gearboxes
• Carry out incoming inspections for damage and evidence of electrical malfunctions to set procedures
• Prepare and inspect all reusable parts for rewinding
• Operate specialised winding and testing equipment such as winding machines, surge testers, and core-loss testers
• Complete all job documentation, including photographs, accurately and on time Job Qualifications
• Recognised electrical engineering or electrical machine repair & rewinds apprenticeship (or equivalent)
• Proven experience dismantling, rewinding, assembling, and testing AC/DC motors
• Experience with a wide range of mechanical and electrical rotating equipment
• Ability to read and interpret mechanical drawings
• Strong attention to detail, organisational skills, and commitment to quality What we offer you
• A competitive basic salary
• Paid overtime opportunities
• Annual companywide bonus
• 33 days annual leave.
• Defined pension contributions.
• Access to Medicash, helping you cover everyday health costs like dental, optical, and physiotherapy, plus a range of wellbeing perks.
• Confidential support via Employee Assistance Programmes.
• Discounted personal car leasing for you, your family, and friends.
• Long Service Awards celebrating your commitment.
• Continuous learning opportunities through Sulzer Learning Pathways.
• We’re proud to support those who’ve served. Sulzer is a Bronze Award holder under the MoD’s Defence Employer Recognition Scheme, meaning we actively welcome and support ex-military personnel and reservists in building successful careers with us. Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer è una società di ingegneria leader con un patrimonio orgoglioso di innovazione. Unisciti al nostro team globale per accrescere le tue competenze e sviluppare soluzioni innovative che consentano una società prospera e più sostenibile. Informazioni sul ruolo Il Gruppo IT Head è responsabile della definizione e dell'esecuzione della strategia IT per il Gruppo, garantendo l'allineamento con le priorità aziendali e obiettivi di trasformazione digitale a lungo termine. Il ruolo guida molteplici funzioni IT, supervisiona la governance tecnologica e garantisce infrastrutture e sistemi sicuri, scalabili e moderni che supportano le operazioni globali. Questo profilo di lavoro è destinato a dirigenti senior che partecipano a metà a lungo termine (3-5 anni) sviluppo di strategia per la loro attività o area funzionale. Responsabile per l'esecuzione di strategia e direzione operativa di un'impresa o di una funzione. Lavora a stretto contatto con la leadership esecutivo di gruppo su questioni di importanza strategica per l'organizzazione. Di solito gestisce più squadre. Nell'ambito del nostro viaggio di trasformazione, Sulzer sta cercando un leader strategico, dinamico e pratico IT Sales & Marketing che guiderà iniziative critiche come l'armonizzazione delle piattaforme di vendita globali. Questo ruolo rappresenta una posizione di leadership chiave all'interno di uno dei domini IT più business-critical, consentendo direttamente l'eccellenza commerciale e l'accelerazione della crescita dei ricavi dotando i team di vendita con capacità scalabili, data-driven e integrate allineate alle ambizioni di crescita di Sulzer. Principali responsabilità
• Definire e guidare la visione e la strategia globale IT Sales & Marketing allineati con le priorità di eccellenza commerciale di Sulzer.
• Fornire insieme al vostro team alcune delle iniziative IT più critiche e programmi di trasformazione, consentendo direttamente ai nostri team di vendita di affari di eseguire la loro strategia di crescita e accelerare la generazione di ricavi.
• Guidare e guidare con successo il consolidamento, l'armonizzazione e la modernizzazione del panorama CRM globale, tra cui la piena migrazione a Salesforce per migliorare significativamente l'eccellenza e le prestazioni di vendita.
• Condurre l'ammodernamento delle capacità CPQ per accelerare e migliorare i processi di conversione degli ordini, sfruttando al contempo le piattaforme di marketing digitale e di e-commerce di nuova generazione per sbloccare nuovi flussi di entrate e aumentare in modo sostenibile la crescita delle vendite.
• Partner con leadership di vendita, marketing, gestione dei prodotti, e divisional b usiness p artners per modellare le roadmap e priorizzare la domanda di business.
• Assicurare l'allineamento delle soluzioni tecnologiche con la strategia commerciale e di marketing, gli obiettivi dell'esperienza utente e gli standard di integrità dei dati.
• Promuovere la collaborazione e una cultura ad alte prestazioni nel team Sales Excellence IT
• I dentificare con i vostri quadri le aree di miglioramento, consolidamento e standardizzazione.
• Sviluppare ulteriormente un team ad alte prestazioni: L ead, mentore, e sviluppare un team interfunzionale e multiculturale di professionisti IT >10 in diverse geografie , per garantire continuamente l'implementazione e il ciclo di vita delle applicazioni di vendita.
• Gestisci fornitori esterni e integratori di sistema per fornire progetti e servizi di supporto in linea con le aspettative di budget e qualità.
• Proprio ed evolve il panorama delle applicazioni IT di vendita globale di Sulzer tra cui Salesforce CRM, Microsoft Dynamics CRM, CPQ (Configure-Price-Quote) strumenti e strumenti di progettazione ingegneristica per la selezione e la configurazione dei prodotti.
• Controllare la governance del sistema, l'accesso dell'utente, la sicurezza dei dati e la conformità con le politiche aziendali IT e sulla privacy dei dati.
• Resta aggiornato sulle tendenze del settore e sulle tecnologie emergenti che guidano l'innovazione in tutte le divisioni Sulzer . Ciò può includere l'implementazione di nuovi strumenti o tecnologie, l'aggiornamento dei sistemi esistenti, o l'esplorazione di nuove soluzioni per generare più valore aziendale. descriptionByLocale.de:
Sulzer ist ein führendes Ingenieurunternehmen mit einem stolzen Erbe an Innovationen. Schließen Sie sich unserem globalen Team an, um Ihr Fachwissen zu erweitern und innovative Lösungen zu entwickeln, die eine wohlhabende und nachhaltigere Gesellschaft ermöglichen. Über die Rolle Der Gruppen-IT-Leiter ist für die Definition und Umsetzung der IT-Strategie für den Konzern verantwortlich, um die Ausrichtung auf die Geschäftsprioritäten und die langfristigen digitalen Transformationsziele sicherzustellen. Die Rolle leitet mehrere IT-Funktionen, überwacht die Technologie-Governance und gewährleistet eine sichere, skalierbare und moderne Infrastruktur und Systeme, die den globalen Betrieb unterstützen. Dieses Stellenprofil richtet sich an Führungskräfte, die sich an der mittel- bis langfristigen (3-5 Jahre) Strategieentwicklung für ihr Unternehmen oder ihren Funktionsbereich beteiligen. Verantwortlich für die Ausführung der Strategie und die operative Leitung eines Unternehmens oder einer Funktion. Arbeitet eng mit der Gruppenleitung in Angelegenheiten von strategischer Bedeutung für die Organisation zusammen. Verwaltet typischerweise mehrere Teams. Als Teil unserer Transformationsreise sucht Sulzer einen strategischen, dynamischen und praxisorientierten IT-Vertriebs- und Marketingführer, der wichtige Initiativen wie die Harmonisierung globaler Vertriebsplattformen vorantreiben wird. Diese Rolle stellt eine wichtige Führungsposition in einem der geschäftskritischsten IT-Bereiche dar, die direkt kommerzielle Exzellenz ermöglicht und das Umsatzwachstum beschleunigt, indem Vertriebsteams mit skalierbaren, datengesteuerten und integrierten Fähigkeiten ausgestattet werden, die auf die Wachstumsambitionen von Sulzer ausgerichtet sind. Wichtigste Zuständigkeiten
• Definieren und vorantreiben Sie die globale Vision und Strategie von IT Sales & Marketing, die auf die kommerziellen Exzellenzprioritäten von Sulzer ausgerichtet ist.
• Liefern Sie gemeinsam mit Ihrem Team einige der wichtigsten IT-Initiativen und Transformationsprogramme, damit unsere Vertriebsteams ihre Wachstumsstrategie umsetzen und die Umsatzgenerierung beschleunigen können.
• Die Konsolidierung, Harmonisierung und Modernisierung der globalen CRM-Landschaft vorantreiben und erfolgreich steuern, einschließlich der vollständigen Migration zu Salesforce, um die Vertriebsqualität und -leistung deutlich zu verbessern.
• Führen Sie die Modernisierung der CPQ-Fähigkeiten an, um Auftragskonvertierungsprozesse zu beschleunigen und zu verbessern, während Sie digitales Marketing und E-Commerce-Plattformen der nächsten Generation nutzen, um neue Einnahmequellen zu erschließen und das Umsatzwachstum nachhaltig zu steigern.
• Partnerschaft mit Sales Leadership, Marketing, Produktmanagement und Divisional b Usiness p Artners, um Roadmaps zu gestalten und die Geschäftsnachfrage zu priorisieren.
• Stellen Sie sicher, dass Technologielösungen mit der Geschäfts- und Marketingstrategie, den Zielen der Benutzererfahrung und den Datenintegritätsstandards übereinstimmen.
• Förderung der Zusammenarbeit und einer Hochleistungskultur innerhalb des Sales Excellence IT-Teams
• Ich verneint mit Ihren Frameworks die Bereiche für Verbesserung, Konsolidierung und Standardisierung.
• Entwickeln Sie ein leistungsstarkes Team: L ead, Mentor und entwickeln Sie ein funktionsübergreifendes, multikulturelles Team von > 10 IT-Experten in mehreren Regionen, um eine erfolgreiche Implementierung und den Lebenszyklus von Vertriebsanwendungen sicherzustellen.
• Verwalten Sie externe Anbieter und Systemintegratoren, um Projekte und Support-Services gemäß den Budget- und Qualitätserwartungen bereitzustellen.
• Eigene und Weiterentwicklung der globalen Sales IT-Applikationslandschaft von Sulzer, einschließlich Salesforce CRM, Microsoft Dynamics CRM, CPQ-Tools (Configure-Price-Quote) und Engineering-Design-Tools für Produktauswahl und -konfiguration.
• Überwachung der System-Governance, des Benutzerzugriffs, der Datensicherheit und der Einhaltung der Unternehmens-IT- und Datenschutzrichtlinien.
• Bleiben Sie auf dem Laufenden über Branchentrends und neue Technologien, die Innovationen in allen Sulzer-Divisionen vorantreiben. Um erfolgreich zu sein, benötigen Sie:
