descriptionByLocale.fr:
Sulzer est une entreprise d'ingénierie de premier plan avec un fier héritage d'innovation. Rejoignez notre équipe mondiale pour développer votre expertise et développer des solutions innovantes qui permettent une société prospère et plus durable. Sur le rôle Le chef de groupe IT est responsable de la définition et de l'exécution de la stratégie informatique pour le groupe, en assurant l'alignement sur les priorités opérationnelles et les objectifs de transformation numérique à long terme. Ce rôle dirige plusieurs fonctions informatiques, supervise la gouvernance technologique et assure la sécurité, l'évolutivité et la modernisation des infrastructures et des systèmes qui soutiennent les opérations mondiales. Ce profil d'emploi est destiné aux cadres supérieurs qui participent à l'élaboration de la stratégie à moyen et à long terme (3-5 ans) pour leur secteur d'activité ou leur secteur fonctionnel. Responsable de l'exécution de la stratégie et de la direction opérationnelle d'une entreprise ou d'une fonction. Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les dirigeants de groupe sur des questions d'importance stratégique pour l'organisation. Il gère généralement plusieurs équipes. Dans le cadre de notre parcours de transformation, Sulzer recherche un leader stratégique, dynamique et pratique dans le domaine des ventes et du marketing IT qui pilotera des initiatives cruciales telles que l'harmonisation des plateformes de vente mondiales. Ce rôle représente une position de leader clé dans l'un des domaines informatiques les plus critiques pour les entreprises, permettant directement l'excellence commerciale et accélérant la croissance des revenus en équipant les équipes de vente de capacités évolutives, axées sur les données et intégrées, alignées sur les ambitions de croissance de Sulzer. Principales responsabilités
• Définir et piloter la vision et la stratégie globale IT Sales & Marketing alignées sur les priorités d'excellence commerciale de Sulzer.
• Offrez avec votre équipe quelques-unes des initiatives informatiques et des programmes de transformation les plus critiques, permettant directement à nos équipes commerciales d'exécuter leur stratégie de croissance et d'accélérer la production de revenus.
• Diriger et diriger avec succès la consolidation, l'harmonisation et la modernisation du paysage mondial de la CRM, y compris la pleine migration vers Salesforce pour améliorer significativement l'excellence et la performance des ventes.
• Diriger la modernisation des capacités du CPQ pour accélérer et améliorer les processus de conversion des commandes, tout en tirant parti du marketing numérique et des plateformes de commerce électronique de la prochaine génération pour débloquer de nouveaux flux de revenus et stimuler durablement la croissance des ventes.
• Partenaire avec le leadership des ventes, le marketing, la gestion de produits, et la division d'utilisation p artners pour façonner les feuilles de route et prioriser la demande des entreprises.
• Assurer l'harmonisation des solutions technologiques avec la stratégie commerciale et commerciale, les objectifs de l'expérience utilisateur et les normes d'intégrité des données.
• Favoriser la collaboration et une culture de haute performance au sein de l'équipe d'excellence en TI des ventes
• J'ai dentifié avec vos cadres les domaines d'amélioration, de consolidation et de normalisation.
• Développer davantage une équipe de haute performance : L ead, mentor, et développer une équipe multifonctionnelle et multiculturelle de >10 professionnels de l'informatique sur plusieurs géographies, afin d'assurer la mise en œuvre réussie s et le cycle de vie des applications de vente.
• Gérer les fournisseurs externes et les intégrateurs de systèmes pour fournir des projets et des services d'appui conformes aux attentes budgétaires et de qualité.
• Propre et évoluer le paysage mondial des applications de Sulzer, y compris Salesforce CRM, Microsoft Dynamics CRM, les outils CPQ (Configure-Price-Quote) et les outils de conception technique pour la sélection et la configuration des produits.
• Superviser la gouvernance du système, l'accès des utilisateurs, la sécurité des données et le respect des politiques ministérielles en matière de TI et de confidentialité des données.
• Restez informé des tendances de l'industrie et des nouvelles technologies qui stimulent l'innovation dans toutes les divisions de Sulzer. Il peut s'agir de mettre en oeuvre de nouveaux outils ou technologies, de moderniser les systèmes existants ou d'explorer de nouvelles solutions pour générer davantage de valeur commerciale. Pour réussir, vous avez besoin :
• > 15 ans
• Expérimenté avec Salesforce, Microsoft CRM, Appel d'offres, Tarification, Outils de Configuration Produit etc.

Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Job Summary The Painter is responsible for working with production to prepare finished pumps for the customer. Responsibilities
• Manage material movement through the department which aligns with the most immediate needs of internal customers to meet On-Time-Delivery (OTD) performance metrics.
• Operate overhead and manual floor lifting equipment to maneuver, load, and unload items onto and off of the paint line that exceed 50lbs.
• Utilize pre-coating agents, mix and match colors and textures according to specifications, and fill or level materials as required.
• Follow compound specifications for mixing of paints and painting techniques.
• Apply paint and any additional finishes according to sales order and work instructions.
• Read and interpret drawings, technical specifications and material data sheets.
• Maintain accurate and complete records as required.
• Perform quality inspections as described in quality plans and work instructions.
• Follow quality procedures according to ISO 9001.
• Commitment to following all work instructions, policies, and posted signs or instructions regarding safety, including but not limited to, proper use of required PPE at all times. Requirements
• High school diploma or equivalent
• 1+ years of industrial or automotive painting experience
• Ability to wear a respirator
• Ability to read, write, and communicate in English
• Reliable transportation
• Ability to pass 7-year criminal history background check
• Ability to pass a hair follicle drug screen What we offer you
• 401k plan with a 6% match
• Comprehensive health plan including medical, dental, vision, Life, short-term & long-term disability
• 12 paid holidays
• 15 days of PTO
• Health savings account matching
• Motivating wellness program
• Employee Assistance Program
• Paid paternal leave Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

Kom werken bij het Sulzer Turbo Services, onderdeel van Sulzer Services, een van 's werelds meest geavanceerde onafhankelijke aanbieders van reparatie, revisie en onderhoud binnen de turbine-industrie. Vanuit Venlo (Lomm) of op locatie, bieden wij onze klanten wereldwijd solide, klantgerichte en flexibele ondersteuning voor hun compressoren, stoom- en gasturbines. Sluit je aan bij onze trotse en hoogopgeleide internationale crew als Constructiewerker Rotorshop Mechanic (BBL opleiding). Je werkt 4 dagen per week op onze locatie in Lomm en 1 dag per week ga je naar school. In deze functie ben je verantwoordelijk voor:
• Nauwkeurige demontage/inspectie/probleemoplossing/reparatie/montage van diverse roterende apparatuur (gasturbines, stoomturbines en compressoren) volgens Sulzer-specificaties
• Gebruik van handgereedschap, hydraulische spanapparatuur, takels, krikken, winkelhaken, linialen, micrometers, schietloden en speciaal gereedschap voor de uitvoering van de werkzaamheden Om in deze functie te slagen, moet je:
• Een proactieve houding hebben en leergierig zijn
• Teamplayer zijn die zich thuis voelt in een dynamische wereld en graag het werk van een rotorshop mechanic wilt leren
• Flexibel zijn en open houding hebben

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Job Summary A winder disassembles, repairs, rewinds, and reassembles electric motors, and generators. Pasadena, Texas ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:
• Read job cards to determine; job status, work authorization/limitations, estimate, description of problems and/or expected serviceability.
• Test electro-mechanical equipment to troubleshoot known or suspected problems using various methods (ac or de).
• Disassemble electro-mechanical equipment noting parts identifications, configuration and condition.
• Clean electro-mechanical equipment assemblies as needed using various methods and steps, including but not limited to: parts washer/steamers, caustic tanks, glass beaders, etc.
• Measure for or note proper replacement parts. Correctly requisition needed items from storekeeper, as approved by supervisor.
• Replace or repair worn or defective mechanical or electro-mechanical assemblies, including but not limited to: bearings, brushes, brush holders, motors leads gears seals, impellers, mechanical switches, brakes clutches, clutch rotors, tachs, fans, end shield,, etc.
• Retest reassembled electro-mechanical equipment for proper output and operation.
• Complete required paperwork for each job accurately and on a timely basis.
• Operate specialized repair and testing equipment and other equipment as needed
• Observe all safety procedures and use proper protective gear (especially eye and car protection).
• Lift, tighten, adjust and/or secure heavy objects in order to perform work duties.
• Keep work area neat and clean as directed by supervisor.
• Assisted other mechanics or other shop personnel in skilled or –non-skilled duties as directed by supervisor or shop manager.
• Perform other skilled or not-skilled duties as directed by supervisor QUALIFICATIONS:
• High school diploma or equivalent
• Basic mechanical aptitude PHYSICAL DEMANDS
• While performing duties of this job, would occasionally be required to stand, walk, sit, reach with hands and arms, climb or balance, stoop or kneel, talk and hear, and use fingers and hands to feel objects.
• Ability to lift and/or move up to 50 pounds The above is intended to describe the general content of, and requirements for, the performance of this job. It is not to be construed as an exhaustive statement of duties, responsibilities, or requirements. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role We are looking for a RTR Accountant to join our Accounting team in Spain to help us take our Record to Report (RTR) area to the next level. As an Accountant, you will collaborate with multiple countries and engage with a diverse array of areas stakeholders, including Accounting, Reporting, Analytics, Country Finance Heads, Global Process Owners (GPOs), and external parties such as auditors and tax authorities. Key responsabilities:
• Serve as a member of the RTR team in the CoE, providing support on ad hoc topics and accounting issues
• Support with financial booking activities, ensuring accuracy and compliance with International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) and Sulzer regulations
• Manage clearing, including reconciliations and adjustments, to maintain accurate financial records
• Utilize advanced knowledge of ERP systems to streamline accounting processes
• Support the Global Process Owner (GPO) with system implementations
• Maintain and update the chart of accounts and hierarchies, ensuring it reflects the current business structure and reporting requirements
• Collaborate closely with local Finance Teams in countries and Finance Shared Services teams / Business Process Outsourcing (BPO) provider
• Coordinate with other departments and the Finance Shared Services teams to ensure all financial transactions are properly accounted for and reflected in the general ledger
• Supports the period end close, including closing the accounts receivable/payable subledger and reconcile with the general ledger; close general ledger, open new financial period, close Asset Accounting (AA)
• Support with the preparation of journal entries, balance sheet reconciliations and variance analysis
• Contribute to the continuous improvement of the RTR process, leveraging technology and best practices; maintain policies, procedures and templates
• Ensure financial internal controls are in place and followed for the processes performed by this role
• Do all technical Year End Closing activities such as balance carry forward, number range creations, close of AA
• Support Intercompany reconciliation process in Coprocess and Tagetik (fix variances) You need to succeed:
• University degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration or related field
• Minimum of 2-3 years of experience in Accounting with a strong focus on general ledger and financial reporting
• CPA, ACCA, CMA or equivalent certification preferred
• Strong analytical, problem-solving and management skills
• Excellent attention to detail and commitment to accuracy and integrity in financial reporting
• Proven ability to manage multiple priorities in a deadline-driven environment
• Strong communication skills for delivering key insights to senior leadership
• Proficient in ERP systems (relevant to your business unit; SAP, Microsoft Dynamics 365 or iScala) and accounting software
• Strong MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint) skills
• Experience with Tagetik, Coprocess and Qlik Sense is a plus
• Proficiency in English and French What we offer you
• A permanent contract.
• A competitive salary as well as participation in the variable remuneration system based on personal and financial objectives.
• Restaurant tickets.
• Be part of an experienced, international team.
• A good vibe working environment.
• Enjoy great office facilities and a perfect location in Madrid Nuevos Ministerios, making your work experience both comfortable and convenient.
• Other fringe benefits. International applicants are welcome to apply. No visa or w

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Job Summary The Mechanical Engineer is responsible for researching, planning, designing, and developing mechanical products and systems. This includes instruments, controls, engines, and machines used in energy production, transmission, and measurement. This job profile is intended for early-career professionals who apply broad theoretical knowledge and require the ability to investigate and analyze problems. Solutions are typically discussed/verified with a more senior member. The Product Engineer reports to Team Leader ORE. Responsibilities:
• Management of the assigned mechanical design projects from Sales order review stage to handover to production.
• Undertake responsibility for order related design, processing and supporting activities for the assigned product range.
• Review of the customer project design specifications, communication with Sales/Tendering team to transform the customer requirements into product through order related engineering.
• Preparation of the customer facing documents as Pump Cross Section drawings, Pump General Arrangement drawings, P&ID drawings, Wiring diagram etc in 2D or 3D.
• Review and approval of buyout component drawings & documents related to Motor, Coupling, Mechanical Seal & Systems, ARC Valves, Gear box, VFD, Turbine etc.
• Review of the Instruments requirement & co-ordination with Instrumentation team.
• Preparation, check & release of the Bill Of Material (BOM) in SAP ERP.
• Communicate with Customers & sub-suppliers as necessary.
• Support & coordinate with different teams of Operations, Purchase, Sales, Quality & Testing during the complete cycle of the order execution.
• Provide engineering support to pump site commissioning team until successful operation of the equipment supplied.
• Proactively engage & support company initiatives designed to promote a culture of safe working, environmental protection and continual improvement. Qualification, Experience and Knowledge requirement
• Bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering from reputed institute.
• 4-8 years of experience in Centrifugal Pump design field & API standards.
• Must have hands on experience on AutoCAD design software. Experience in Inventor, NX & Team center will be an added advantage.
• Conversant with the use of the SAP ERP tool.
• Independent and proactive with good communication & interpersonal skills.
• Managed and executed multiple tasks while taking direction from several sources.
• High sense of ownership, strong work ethic, focused on details and results oriented. What we offer you 22 vacation days + 9 days Casual leave + 8 days Sick Leave + 13 days Festival holidays Defined contribution pension scheme Hospitalization insurance benefit On-site car parking Subsidized cafeteria Long service award Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Are you passionate about developing early talent and supporting people at the start of their careers? We’re looking for a highly organised, people‑focused Early Careers Coordinator to join our team on a maternity cover basis, based in Leeds.
• Start date: June (to allow for handover)
• Contract: Fixed-term, 14 months
• Reporting to: Learning & Development Manager This role plays a key part in delivering a positive experience for our graduates and apprentices across Sulzer’s UK operations. It’s ideal for someone who enjoys responsibility, autonomy and being the central point of coordination for early careers programmes. What you’ll be doing
• Coordinating and supporting Sulzer’s early careers programmes, including graduates and apprentices
• Acting as a key point of contact for early careers participants, providing guidance and support throughout their journey
• Managing programme activities such as inductions, rotations, development milestones and key events
• Maintaining accurate early careers records and tracking progression and outcomes
• Building strong relationships with stakeholders across the business to ensure a smooth and consistent early careers experience
• Working closely with the Learning & Development Manager and the Leeds‑based L&D team to ensure programmes run effectively About you
• Highly organised with strong attention to detail
• Confident managing your own workload, diary and priorities
• A clear, professional communicator who enjoys working with people
• Comfortable using HR or learning systems (experience with learning platforms is a plus) Location, travel & flexibility
• Leeds will be your primary working location, with hybrid working available (office and home)
• Some UK travel required, primarily to Birmingham, with occasional travel to Aberdeen and other UK locations
• Planned travel only, with occasional overnight stays – no last‑minute “drop‑everything” requests
• Full UK driving licence required What we offer you
• Competitive base salary.
• Flexitime policy supporting a balanced and flexible approach to working hours.
• 33 days annual leave .
• Defined pension contribution.
• Medicash healthcare plan, helping cover everyday costs such as dental, optical and physiotherapy, plus a range of wellbeing benefits.
• Employee Assistance Programme, offering confidential support when you need it.
• Wide range of discounts on shopping, entertainment and lifestyle, with access to apply for Costco membership.
• Continuous learning and development through Sulzer Learning Pathways.
• Modern working environment – Our Leeds site is undergoing a significant renovation, creating a refreshed, high‑quality and modern workspace.
• Onsite facilities – Enjoy a 24/7 gym, subsidised canteen, vending machines, and an active Sports & Social Club.
• Support for veterans, reservists and cadet adult volunteers – Sulzer is a Bronze Award holder under the MoD’s Defence Employer Recognition Scheme and actively welcomes ex‑military personnel. Why join us?
• A meaningful role shaping the experience of future talent
• High levels of autonomy and trust in how you manage your time
• Supportive, collaborative L&D team with a structured handover
• Opportunity to gain broad exposure across learning and development activities About Sulzer Sulzer is a global engineering company specialising in fluid engineering and chemical processing solutions for industries that are essential to everyday life, including energy, water and manufacturing. Headquartered in Switzerland, we employ around 13,500 people worldwide across 160 locations, generating CHF 3.5 billion in annual turnover. Our technologies help customers improve energy efficiency, reduce emissions and support the transition to

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role This role sits at the intersection of enterprise architecture, data governance, and business transformation. The Lead Architect – Data Quality works with business and IT leaders to redesign end-to-end processes and data flows so that high-quality data becomes the default outcome rather than a downstream correction effort. The position plays a central role in large-scale change initiatives (e.g., ERP modernization, MDM rollout, customer and material master harmonization, PLM integrations), providing a unique opportunity to create lasting architectural impact across Sulzer. Key Responsibilities
• Lead the design of enterprise data quality architecture and ensure preventive controls are embedded into processes and systems by default.
• Define and evolve enterprise data models, standards, critical data elements, and validation rules across priority domains (e.g., Customer, Material, Product).
• Drive root-cause elimination initiatives by redesigning processes, system interactions, and data ownership models.
• Define data quality KPIs and maturity tracking; monitor trends, risks, and progress and report transparently to governance bodies and management.
• Act as a key architectural contributor to data-related transformation programs (ERP, CRM, PLM, MDM, integration, analytics).
• Partner closely with Enterprise Architecture and IT leadership to shape future-state data and integration architecture decisions.
• Establish escalation mechanisms aligned with the enterprise data governance framework and enable consistent decision-making across Legal Entities.
• Contribute to evaluation and selection of data quality, governance, and MDM technologies and help define target-state capabilities. Candidate Profile
• University degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field.
• Minimum 5+ years of experience in data architecture, data quality, data governance, or related enterprise transformation roles.
• Strong understanding of data quality management and controls, enterprise data flows, integrations, and end-to-end business processes.
• Proven ability to perform root-cause analysis beyond symptoms and drive structural remediation.
• Strong conceptual thinking combined with pragmatic execution and delivery focus.
• Excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills in English Preferred Qualifications
• Experience in a global industrial, engineering, or manufacturing environment.
• Hands-on exposure to enterprise application landscapes (SAP-centric environments such as S/4HANA/MDG, CRM, PLM, MDM).
• Experience working closely with Enterprise Architects or IT architecture teams.
• Relevant certification in data management, data governance, or architecture.
• Familiarity with modern integration patterns and data platforms (API-led integration, event-driven patterns, data lakes/warehouses) is a plus. Success Measures
• Recurring data quality issues are reduced through structural, preventive solutions.
• Data quality controls are embedded into business processes and system designs.
• Clear ownership and accountability for data quality issues are established and followed.
• Business and IT teams align on systemic data quality remediation rather than manual fixes.
• Enterprise data architecture decisions consistently reflect data quality and governance requirements What we offer you
• A permanent contract.
• A competitive salary as well as participation in the variable remuneration system based on personal and financial objectives.
• Restaurant tickets
• Be part of an experienced, international team.
• A good vibe working environment.
• Enjoy great office facilities and a perfect location in Madrid Nuevos Ministerios , making

Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role A mechanic is a professional who repairs and maintains machinery and parts. A mechanic's duties include inspecting, diagnosing, and fixing faults, conducting safety checks, and keeping records of the work done. A mechanic uses manual tools and technological devices to perform the tasks. A mechanic also communicates with customers and coworkers to establish timeframe and cost of each project. Mechanic/Technician-Night Shift Sulzer offers you a wealth of opportunities to drive your career into the direction that you want, depending on your skills and interests. We invite you to apply if you are ready to take the next step. Your main tasks and responsibilities:
• Assemble machines utilizing the specified assembly checklist
• Disassemble and inspect machines utilizing the specified disassembly and inspection checklist
• Complete all documentation pertaining to the work assignment
• Communicate mechanical issues found during inspection to the appropriate Department Supervisor
• Work closely and clearly communicate with the other departments, Mechanical personnel, Supervisor and Lead Man To succeed in this role, you will need:
• Must be able to work overtime when necessary
• Must be able to use precision measuring instruments
• Must have experience working with turbo machinery repair
• Must have the required tools to perform their expected tasks What we offer you
• 11 Paid Holidays
• 15 Paid Time off (PTO) Days
• Medical, dental, vision, life, and disability
• 401k with 6% company match
• Employee Assistance Program
• Employee Wellness Program
• Bonus Programs
• New onsite cafeteria, all meals subsidized (La Porte Service Center) Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Join Sulzer’s transformation journey as a lead IT Project Manager and play a pivotal role in delivering high-impact IT initiatives. You’ll have the opportunity to manage a diverse project portfolio, collaborate with cross-functional teams, and contribute to the modernization of our IT landscape by identifying opportunities for leveraging technology to drive business growth, improve processes and enhance productivity. This is a unique chance to drive meaningful change and develop your career in a dynamic, global environment. Your main tasks and responsibilities: Portfolio & Project Management
• Lead and guide overall execution of multiple IT Projects , ensuring alignment with Sulzer’s strategic priorities.
• Monitor project progress, manage risks, and ensure timely delivery , budget adherence and manage interdepen dencies between projects.
• Maintain project documentation, status reports, and dashboards for leadership and stakeholders. Governance & Methodology
• Apply and promote consistent project management methodologies, tools, and reporting standards.
• Ensure compliance with governance frameworks and contribute to process improvement initiatives. Stakeholder Management
• Build strong relationships with business leaders and IT stakeholders to ensure project objectives meet business needs , leading the IT project Steering Committees.
• Act as a key point of contact for project-related communication and issue resolution .
• Proactively engage in business partnering, acting as a trusted advisor to business divisions and supporting the identification, prioritization, and management of IT demand s to maximize value delivery. Demand Management
• Lead the demand management process by capturing, evaluating, and prioritizing business requirements, ensuring alignment with Sulzer’s strategic objectives and resource availability.
• Facilitate transparent decision-making on project selection and resource allocation. Vendor & Financial Management
• Support vendor selection, contract management, and performance tracking for project-related services.
• Assist in project budgeting, forecasting, and financial performance tracking. Operational Excellence
• Drive efficiency in project delivery and resource allocation.
• Champion continuous improvement and simplification across project processes and tools. Sulzer Core Ambition Program
• Actively contribute to the SulzerCore Ambition Program by ensuring that all project and portfolio activities support the organizations goals and strategic ambitions. Team Collaboration & Development
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams and contribute to a culture of accountability and excellence.
• Mentor junior project managers or team members as needed.
• Drive efficiency across IT operations, including resource allocation, vendor management, and performance tracking.
• Champion continuous improvement and simplification across the IT landscape, including consolidation of tools and platforms. OneSulzer Culture
• Promote and embody the OneSulzer mindset by fostering collaboration with an “ Entrepreneurial sp irit and teamwork ” , challenging the status quo, and supporting a unified, “Customer focus” culture across all divisions and teams. Desired Experience & Qualifications
• 9+ years of professional experience in IT and business/industry environments
• At least 5 years of experience in team management and leadership roles
• Strong experience with project methods and methodologies
• Solid knowledge of operating models (Ops Models)

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Job Summary The Sr. Manufacturing Quality Inspector is responsible for auditing, monitoring, and determining the quality of manufacturing processes and outputs. This role ensures compliance with internal and regulatory standards and supports the timely delivery of quality products. This job profile is intended for support-level staff that generally works autonomously and only requires closer supervision in non-routine situations. SUMMARY: Performs receipt and in-process dimensional and visual inspection of machined and fabricated parts, purchased items and finished assemblies. Create and record inspection results on appropriate inspection report using Microsoft Excel and Word. Reviews sub-contractor procedures and reports; and maintains department records and procedures for current code requirements. Position functions independently with occasional guidance from the Quality Assurance Manager. ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS: % OF TIME 60% Performs dimensional and visual inspection of machined and fabricated parts, purchased items and finished assemblies in accordance with appropriate specifications. 10% Monitors for compliance to processes and procedures. 10% Communicate with manufacturing personnel concerning priority of inspection. 10% Perform surveillance activities at Supplier facilities to determine compliance and acceptability of equipment/process being supplied. 10% Interfaces with 3rd party and Customer inspectors as required. SECONDARY RESPONSIBILIES
• Supports, cooperates with, and participates in EHS Management System, including following safety, health and environmental policies and procedures.
• Sulzer procedure review and implementation assistance.
• Adheres to company and department policies, procedures, and standards
• Regular and reliable attendance with flexible work habits and schedule.
• Performs other duties as necessary SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES: None QUALIFICATIONS AND SKILLS:
• ASNT Certification for NDE Level I or Level II for PT, MT, UT and/or VT, preferred.
• Proficient in Microsoft and SAP applications
• Ability to read and interpret drawings, procedures, and specifications, define problems, collect data, establish facts, and draw valid conclusions
• Understanding appropriate application of inspection techniques
• Working knowledge of ASME, ASTM, AWS and other relative codes, preferred.
• Good written and oral communication, organizational skills, and ability to perform basic math.
• High School Diploma required. What we offer you
• 12 Paid Holidays
• 15 Paid Time Off (PTO) Days
• Medical, dental, vision, life & disability
• 401K with 6% company match
• Employee Assistance Program
• Employee Wellness Program
• New onsite cafeteria, all meals subsidized (La Porte Service Center) Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

Sulzer è una società di ingegneria leader con un patrimonio orgoglioso di innovazione. Unisciti al nostro team globale per accrescere le tue competenze e sviluppare soluzioni innovative che consentano una società prospera e più sostenibile. Informazioni sul ruolo Come Bid & Tendering Specialist sei un giocatore chiave nel tradurre i requisiti del cliente e le valutazioni del sito in costi di progetto dettagliati e precisi. Siete essenziali per garantire che le offerte per i servizi di attrezzature Steam Turbine & Compressor siano competitive, tecnicamente precise e commercialmente solide. Sarete responsabili dello sviluppo di proposte per progetti complessi, garantendo l'allineamento tra fattibilità tecnica, efficienza dei costi e successo commerciale. Role Location: Any Sulzer location. I vostri compiti principali e responsabilità:
• Garantire un'accurata definizione di portata tecnica e gestione del rischio per complessi progetti di servizio Steam Turbine & Compressor (ad esempio ispezioni, riparazioni, fornitura di parti, soluzioni multi-train, ritiri, aggiornamenti e modifiche)
• Preparare la stima dei costi end-to-end e le quotazioni commerciali per progetti Steam Turbine & Compressor basati su specifiche tecniche
• Coinvolgere e collaborare con successo con i clienti e i partner esterni (ad esempio venditori / subappaltatori) e con gli stakeholder interni
• Sostenere le attività post-tender, assicurando una transizione regolare dall'offerta all'esecuzione, compresa la validazione del campo e la briefing del progetto
• Contribuisci all'approvvigionamento e all'efficienza dei costi lavorando a stretto contatto con i fornitori per garantire prezzi ottimali, tempi di consegna e qualità per parti e servizi correlati
• Migliorare costantemente i metodi di stima dei costi per migliorare l'accuratezza e l'efficienza nelle strategie dei prezzi Per avere successo in questo ruolo, avrete bisogno di:
• Qualifica riconosciuta in ingegneria meccanica o disciplina correlata. Siamo anche aperti a considerare gli ingegneri di vendita o gli ingegneri di progetto con proposte / offerta / esperienza di offerta che stanno cercando un nuovo percorso di carriera.
• Forte esperienza nei servizi rotanti di attrezzature, bonifica di officina e processi di riparazione. Espulsione essenziale con Turbina a vapore / apparecchiature di compressione multistadio.
• Familiarità con catene di fornitura di servizio e riparazione.
• Competenze analitiche e mentalità commerciale
• Personalità attiva e orientata alla soluzione con forti capacità interpersonali Cosa ti offriamo
• Possibilità di avere un impatto significativo in una zona in rapida crescita del nostro business.
• Ambiente di lavoro collaborativo e di supporto con un focus sull'innovazione e l'eccellenza.
• Pacchetto di stipendio competitivo con benefici attraenti, regime pensionistico e programmi di assistenza ai dipendenti
• Opportunità emozionanti per la crescita e il progresso professionale in un settore dinamico ed in evoluzione Sulzer è un datore di lavoro pari opportunità. Crediamo nella forza di una forza lavoro diversificata e ci impegniamo ad offrire un ambiente di lavoro inclusivo. Siamo orgogliosi di essere riconosciuti come Top Employer 2026 in Brasile, Canada, Cina, Finlandia, Germania, Irlanda, Messico, Svizzera, Sud Africa, Regno Unito e Stati Uniti.

About the role Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. As Bid & Tendering Specialist you are a key player in translating client requirements and site assessments into detailed, accurate project costings. You are essential in ensuring that tenders for Steam Turbine & Compressor equipment services are competitive, technically precise, and commercially sound. You will be responsible for developing proposals for complex projects, ensuring alignment between technical feasibility, cost efficiency, and commercial success. Role Location: Any Sulzer location. Your main tasks and responsibilities:
• Ensuring thorough technical scope definition and risk management for complex Steam Turbine & Compressor service projects (e.g. inspections, repairs, parts supply, multi-train solutions, rerates, upgrades and modifications)
• Prepare end-to-end cost estimation and commercial quotations for Steam Turbine & Compressor projects based on technical specifications
• Engage and collaborate successfully with clients and external partners (e.g. vendors / subcontractors) as well internal stakeholders
• Support post-tender activities, ensuring smooth transition from bid to execution, including scope validation and project briefing
• Contribute to procurement and cost efficiency by working closely with suppliers to secure optimal pricing, lead times and quality for related parts and services
• Continuously improve cost estimation methods to improve accuracy and efficiency in pricing strategies To succeed in this role, you will need:
• Recognised qualification in mechanical engineering or a related discipline. We are also open to considering Sales Engineers or Project Engineers with proposals/ bid / tendering experience who are seeking a new career path.
• Strong experience in rotating equipment services, workshop reclamation, and repair processes. Essential expereince with Steam Turbine / Multistage Compression equipment.
• Familiarity with service and repair supply chains.
• Thorough analytical skills and commercial mindset
• Proactive, solution-oriented personality with strong interpersonal skills What we offer you
• Chance to make a significant impact in a rapidly growing area of our business.

Sur le rôle En tant que spécialiste de la soumission et de l'appel d'offres, vous êtes un acteur clé dans la traduction des exigences des clients et des évaluations du site en coûts détaillés et précis du projet. Vous êtes essentiel pour garantir que les appels d'offres pour les services d'équipement de turbine à vapeur et compresseur sont compétitifs, techniquement précis et commercialement sains. Lieu du rôle : n'importe quel emplacement de Sulzer. Vos principales tâches et responsabilités:
• Assurer une définition technique approfondie et une gestion des risques pour les projets complexes de service de turbine à vapeur et de compresseur (p. ex. inspections, réparations, fourniture de pièces, solutions multi-trains, réapprovisionnements, mises à niveau et modifications)
• Préparer une estimation des coûts de bout en bout et des devis commerciaux pour les projets de turbine à vapeur et de compresseur sur la base de spécifications techniques
• Engager et collaborer avec succès avec les clients et les partenaires externes (p. ex. fournisseurs/sous-traitants) ainsi qu'avec les intervenants internes
• Appuyer les activités postérieures à l ' appel d ' offres, en assurant une transition sans heurts entre la soumission et l ' exécution, y compris la validation de la portée et l ' exposé des projets
• Contribuer à l'approvisionnement et à l'efficacité des coûts en travaillant en étroite collaboration avec les fournisseurs pour obtenir des prix, des délais et une qualité optimaux pour les pièces et services connexes
• Améliorer continuellement les méthodes d'estimation des coûts pour améliorer l'exactitude et l'efficacité des stratégies de tarification Pour réussir dans ce rôle, vous devrez :
• Qualification reconnue en génie mécanique ou dans une discipline connexe. Nous sommes également ouverts à considérer les ingénieurs de vente ou les ingénieurs de projet avec des propositions / soumission / expérience d'appel d'offres qui cherchent un nouveau cheminement de carrière.
• Forte expérience dans les services d'équipement rotatif, la remise en état des ateliers et les processus de réparation. Experience essentielle avec turbine à vapeur / équipement de compression multistage.
• Connaissance des chaînes d'approvisionnement de service et de réparation.
• Compétences analytiques approfondies et esprit commercial
• Personnalité proactive, orientée vers la solution, dotée de solides compétences interpersonnelles Ce que nous vous offrons
• La chance d'avoir un impact significatif dans un secteur en croissance rapide de notre entreprise.
• Un environnement de travail coopératif et favorable axé sur l'innovation et l'excellence.
• Ensemble de salaires concurrentiels comportant des prestations attrayantes, un régime de retraite et des programmes d'aide aux employés
• Possibilités de croissance et d'avancement professionnels dans une industrie dynamique et en évolution Sulzer est un employeur à chances égales. Nous croyons en la force d'un effectif diversifié et sommes déterminés à offrir un milieu de travail inclusif. Nous sommes fiers d'être reconnus comme l'un des meilleurs employeurs 2026 au Brésil, au Canada, en Chine, en Finlande, en Allemagne, en Irlande, au Mexique, en Suisse, en Afrique du Sud, au Royaume-Uni et aux États-Unis.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Job Summary The Operations / Manufacturing / Production Supervisor is responsible for overseeing daily production or service center activities, ensuring that processes run smoothly, efficiently, and safely. This role supervises professional-level staff and ensures adherence to quality standards and production or service schedules. This job profile is intended for People Managers of 4+ professional-level roles. Job Description:
• Pre-commissioning and commissioning of installed, repaired or overhauled rotating equipment.
• If required supervise and assist with the DIRA of rotating equipment and associated auxiliary equipment according to technical drawings and specifications.
• Systematic trouble shooting, root cause analysis and rectification on mechanical, electrical and instrumentation component and systems with consideration on quality, time and cost.
• Lead for start up and testing of new installations/erections or overhauled units of rotating equipment including mechanical part, electrical part, instruments and control system
• Monitor field sequence activities based on agreed scope and schedule and report regularly to office.
• Ensure that all findings and work is clearly reported in writing.
• Work assignment could be at shop or field service depends on customer projects request
• Communicate with customer or third party on site as RES representative
• Ensures that all works and activities are done in line with the ISO procedures, as well as the HSE and company regulations.
• Preventing accident, conduct walk thru and observation.
• Campaign using Stop Work Authority to their subordinate when any unsafe Act and condition then record by using observation card.
• Review HIRADC effectiveness. Ensure working area safe for everyone.
• Coordinate with Project OPC, Sales, Engineering and workshop Requirements:
• Diploma’s or Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering
• Preferably with minimum 5 years experience working on repairing rotating equipment
• Have experience in the OEM will be an advantage
• Have knowledge on repair or overhaul turbine generators
• Fluent in English
• Team player
• Well organized and structured
• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
• Pro-active and self-motivated minset
• Multi-tasking
• Must have experience in installation, maintenance and troubleshooting of rotating equipment
• Willingness to travel and work on project sites. What we offer you Career Opportunities Saving Plan Medical Benefit Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Job Summary The Tendering Engineer is responsible for providing technical support to sales teams and conducting technical analysis of product configurations to determine customer-specific pricing. This job profile is intended for early-career professionals who apply broad theoretical knowledge and require the ability to investigate and analyze problems. Solutions are typically discussed/verified with a more senior member. On time Submission of tenders
• Techno commercially optimum and competitive offers
• On time submission and closure of technical clarifications, Technical bid clarification meeting as required
• Clear handover of the project to project team after order, attending ORM
• Close project open points if any and attend customer KOM if required
• Analyze RFQs, tenders, and bid documents for centrifugal pumps (API 610, ISO, ANSI, API 610 / ISO 5199 / ISO 2858 / client specs)
• horizontal/vertical, multistage, etc.)
• Basic Knowledge for Bought out items like, Mechanical Seal & Seal Plan, Motors, Lube Oil System
• Prepare commercial offers , BOQ-based pricing, and option sheets.
• Co-ordinate with Procurement for bought‑out items, factory for delivery timelines & Sales for commercial terms and margins.
• Provide pre‑bid clarifications and participate in technical discussions
• Support sales teams during during Negotiations & Pre- Bid technical Justifications
• Enquiry and evaluation of subcontractor offers as well as corresponding expediting
• Review quote received and challenge as necessary internal as well as external stakeholders to ensure a competitive proposal is submitted meeting Sales / market expectation What we offer you
• 22 vacation days + 9 days Casual leave + 8 days Sick Leave + 13 days Festival holidays
• Defined contribution pension scheme
• Hospitalization insurance benefit
• On-site car parking
• Subsidized cafeteria

Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role To establish and maintain financial and management procedures for Sulzer entities in Libya ensuring compliance with all internal standards, controls and implementing best practice whilst meeting internal customer satisfaction goals and the company’s overall corporate strategy 1. Lead the legal entity as a Finance business partner / LE Finance head. 2. Plan, develop and implement Finance strategy ensuring that it meets overall corporate needs and departmental KPI. 3. Support business partner in developing entity’s strategies by providing recommendations to strategically enhance financial performance and business opportunities. 4. Responsible for end-to-end accounting for the legal entity including the banking transactions. 5. Responsible for compliance and Internal Control Systems (ICS) for legal entity. 6. Responsible for reviewing contracts with legal & doing Financial due diligence reviews for all agents (If any). 7. Responsible for monthly forecasts, monthly reporting, annual budgets, Internal and External audits for legal entity. 8. Analyse financial results, identify and communicate deviations from forecasts with recommendations for solutions and improvements. 9. Responsible for Accounts Receivable & collections. 10. Review and analysis of the Operating Cashflow & forecasting 11. Responsible for tracking Work in Progress, backlog, order wise profitability and monthly regular reconciliation of WIP Vs backlog. 12. Participate and drive the continuous improvement of financial processes, business processes and ERP systems. Provide ad-hoc financial analysis and reporting support to senior management Qualifications/Experience:
• CA/ACCA/CPA/CIMA or equivalent qualification.
• SAP experience
• 7+ years relevant experience
• Treasury Management experience
• Advanced Excel skills
• General computer skills Competencies:
• Communication skills
• Team working skills
• Organisation skills
• Ability to act independently
• Flexibility and ability to adapt to change
• Attention to detail What we offer you To be discussed as part of the interview process Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. descriptionByLocale.de:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Sulzer ist ein führendes Engineering-Unternehmen mit einer reichen Innovationstradition. Werden Sie Teil unseres globalen Teams, um Ihre Expertise zu erweitern und innovative Lösungen zu entwickeln, die eine wohlhabende und nachhaltigere Gesellschaft ermöglichen.

Sulzer Chemtech fertigt Stoffaustauschkomponenten für die chemische und petrochemische Industrie. Produktionsmitarbeiter im Bereich «Biege-, Laser- und Stanzmaschinen» sind verantwortlich die Fertigung von Bauteilen für unsere Verteiler, Böden, und anderen Kolonneneinbauten.

Sulzer bietet Ihnen eine Vielfalt von Möglichkeiten, Ihre Karriere in die von Ihnen gewünschte Richtung zu lenken, je nach Ihren Fähigkeiten und Interessen. Wir laden Sie ein, sich zu bewerben, wenn Sie bereit sind, den nächsten Schritt zu tun.

Karrierechance: Mitarbeiter/in für die Herstellung von strukturierten Packungen (m/w/d) bei Sulzer Chemtech in Essen. Aufgaben und Verantwortlichkeiten:

• Herstellen von strukturierten Packungen nach Vorgaben und Zeitplänen

• Arbeitsplätze: Stanzen und Nuten, Biegen, Schneiden, Montieren, Qualitätskontrolle, Verpacken

• Arbeiten an automatischen und halbautomatischen Produktionslinien mit maßgeschneiderten Produktionsanlagen

• Arbeit im Schichtbetrieb

• Durchführung von Einstellungen und Anpassungen von Maschinen zur Gewährleistung von Geschwindigkeit und Qualität der Produktionsleistung

• Mitwirkung bei der Durchführung von Projekten an allen Arbeitsplätzen in der strukturierten Verpackungswerkstatt

• Meldung von Nichtkonformitäten und Abweichungen von den Produktionsplänen an den Vorarbeiter der Verpackungswerkstatt

• Beitrag zu kontinuierlichen Verbesserungsmaßnahmen in Zusammenarbeit mit der Qualitätsabteilung

• Arbeit in Übereinstimmung mit allen relevanten Richtlinien, Prozessen und Standardarbeitsanweisungen

• Arbeit in Übereinstimmung mit den Richtlinien für Umwelt, Sicherheit und Gesundheit

• Andere produktionsbezogene Aufgaben und Projekte nach Zuweisung.

Anforderungen:

• Handwerkliche / Technische Ausbildung, Werkstattausbildung

• Mindestens 3-5 Jahre Berufserfahrung in diesen Bereichen

• Expertise: Kenntnisse der Fertigungsverfahren Schneiden, Stanzen, Biegen und Schweißen von Blechen

• Affinität zu aufmerksamer und qualitätsorientierter Zusammenarbeit mit Menschen unterschiedlicher Herkunft und Nationalität

• Verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse

What we offer you

Wir bieten:

• Attraktive Vergütung

• Unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag

• 30 Tage Urlaub

• JobRad

• Kostenlose Parkplätze auf dem Betriebsgelände

• Betriebliche Sonderleistungen (z.B. Altersvorsorge, Familienservice-Hotline)

Für diese Stelle können wir keine Unterstützung zum Erhalt eines Visums oder einer Arbeitserlaubnis bieten.

Sulzer ist ein Arbeitgeber, der Chancengleichheit und Gleichbehandlung fördert. Wir setzen uns für personelle Vielfalt ein.
83 % unserer Mitarbeitenden empfehlen Sulzer als guten Arbeitgeber und wir sind stolz darauf, in Brasilien, China, Deutschland, der Schweiz, dem Vereinigten Königreich und den Vereinigten Staaten als Top-Arbeitgeber 2024 ausgezeichnet zu sein. Kommen Sie und nehmen Sie an unserer Geschichte teil!

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

About the role Job Summary To provide hands-on technical assistance in the repair and maintenance of various equipment in the workshop or at the customer sites. Main tasks and responsibilities
• Overhaul and repair of Various type of Turbine, gear boxes, pumps, compressors, and associated other equipment such auxiliary
• Installs rotating equipment including those requiring non-standard installation procedures. Make necessary alignment/adjustment to ensure correct operation.
• Removes & dismantles equipment with maintenance problems; cleans & lubricate; repairs/replace faulty components; reassembles units and checks for efficient operation. Performs preventive & breakdown maintenance jobs.
• Uses a variety of testing equipment to diagnose trouble in proper sequence. Also, uses tools such as hydraulic press, pullers, electric drills, grinders, heating torch as well as precision tools such as micrometer, caliper gauges & dial gauges for test-checking or repair work.
• Performs/ensures maintenance work in accordance with instructions, drawings and codes of practice. Competencies and behaviour required (What strengths needed?
• Requirement: minimum vocational high background: Automotive and Machining.
• Possess General Knowledge of mechanical and overall maintenance. Familiar with measuring tools, and general tools.
• Familiar with Assembly drawing, symbols and legend.
• Familiar with relevant standard such as API, NEMA, codes, and rules of thumbs
• Behaviour requirement: Achievement Orientation, communication for result, teamwork, active learning, business awareness, problem solving and analytical thinking Qualifications/Experience and Knowledge Required
• Fresh Graduate are welcome., 1–2-year experience in machinist role or automotive mechanic is preferred
• Production Knowledge: Precision Measuring tools/instrument such as Dial Gage, OD micrometres, ID micrometre, Callipers etc and math calculation.
• Familiar with Computer. Familiar with Drawing Software is a Plus. Hand Sketches is preferable.
• Proficient in English Language verbal and in written-Having certificate in English communication such as TOEIC is a plus.

Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Job Summary The Warranty Manager is responsible for the end‑to‑end management of complex warranty claims, acting as the primary interface between customers and internal stakeholders while applying advanced technical, commercial, and organizational expertise to ensure timely, compliant, and cost‑effective resolution, maintain customer satisfaction, prevent escalation, and protect the company’s commercial and reputational interests. Key Responsibilities Warranty Claims & Process Management
• Manage warranty claims as technical projects or standardized end-to-end processes from claim initiation through successful resolution and closure.
• Develop and maintain claim resolution plans, schedules, cost estimates, and closure criteria.
• Control and monitor claim progress against contractual obligations, internal policies, and agreed service levels (SLAs).
• Ensure full traceability, documentation integrity, and compliance throughout the warranty lifecycle. Customer & Stakeholder Interface
• Act as the single point of contact between the customer and internal stakeholders for all warranty-related matters.
• Maintain close, structured, and transparent communication with customers to manage expectations and avoid escalation.
• Coordinate internally with Engineering, Quality, Production, Supply Chain, Procurement, Finance, Legal, and Service teams to enable timely and aligned resolutions.
• Facilitate technical and commercial discussions to achieve balanced, win–win outcomes within contractual and financial boundaries. Warranty Cost Control & Financial Discipline
• Control and monitor warranty claim expenditures to ensure alignment with the approved and allocated budget.
• Track actual warranty costs versus provisions and budgets, identifying variances proactively.
• Implement cost containment and optimization measures without compromising resolution effectiveness or customer satisfaction.
• Coordinate with Finance and relevant stakeholders to ensure accurate cost allocation, forecasting, and reporting.
• Support recovery actions from suppliers, sub-vendors, or third parties, where applicable, to minimize net warranty exposure. Technical Analysis & Problem Resolution
• Lead technical investigations and root cause analysis for complex or recurring warranty issues.
• Validate corrective and preventive actions (CAPA) to ensure sustainable resolution and risk reduction.
• Escalate critical technical, quality, or commercial risks with clear impact assessment and recommendations. Customer Satisfaction & Feedback Management
• Ensure customer satisfaction throughout the warranty claim lifecycle by delivering timely, high-quality, and transparent claim resolution.
• Own customer feedback related to warranty claims, including collection, analysis, response, and closure.
• Address customer concerns proactively to prevent dissatisfaction and preserve long-term customer relationships.
• Translate customer feedback into improvement actions in coordination with Engineering, Quality, and Service teams. Performance Management & Continuous Improvement
• Ensure warranty activities align with departmental KPIs, including Warranty Cost Control & Financial Discipline.
• Monitor performance indicators such as claim cycle time, escalation rate, customer satisfaction, and recurrence trends.
• Identify systemic issues and contribute to process, design, or quality improvements to reduce future warranty exposure.
• Capture and communicate lessons learned to relevant stakeholders and governance forums. Leadership & Capability Development
• Provide technical and process guidance to junior professionals involved in warranty claim execution.
• Review work outputs for accuracy, quality, and compliance with standar

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Join our Process Solutions team and play a central part in the success of our licensed technologies. We are looking for an experienced leader to manage and grow our global aftermarket business. This business supplies essential solvents and catalysts to our customers in the refining, petrochemical, biofuels, and chemical recycling sectors. This role is key to providing our customers with valuable, long-term solutions. You will be responsible for the success of this business line, shaping its strategy and driving its growth. The role can be based in a number of locations: Winterthur/Allschwil, Singapore, Shanghai, Houston, or fully remote. Key roles and contributions:
• Define and execute a winning strategy for our solvent and catalyst business, creating synergy with Sulzer's licensed technologies.
• Make our product offerings stronger through smart pricing, effective market positioning, and good supplier partnerships.
• Oversee our solvent and catalyst products from development to end-of-life, including driving new innovations.
• Work closely with our technology and process solution teams to increase aftermarket sales.
• Keep track of industry trends, competitors, and new opportunities for business growth.
• Collaborate across departments to ensure our products and services meet customer needs. To succeed in this role, you will need:
• A bachelor’s degree in chemical engineering, chemistry, or a similar field.
• 10-15 years of experience in the refining, petrochemical, or chemical processing industries.
• A strong background in selling catalysts, solvents, or other industrial chemicals to these markets.
• Proven success in growing an aftermarket business for industrial products.
• A good understanding of process technologies, product portfolio management, and how solvents and catalysts are used.
• Experience with extraction technologies (such as BTX extraction) is a major plus.
• Excellent skills in strategic thinking, communication, negotiation, and leadership.
• Fluency in English is required. Other languages are an asset. What we offer you
• Attractive compensation and vacation plan
• Excellent social benefits
• Global development opportunities
• A collaborative, diverse and innovation-driven culture
• Employee Assistance Program
• Long service awards Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Job Summary The Group ESG Sr. Analyst is responsible for supporting ESG data management, reporting, and analysis. This role contributes to ESG initiatives by providing insights, tracking performance, and assisting in stakeholder communications. This job profile is intended for experienced professionals who apply practical knowledge of a job area and work independently with general supervision. The ESG Integration Manager plays a central role in integrating sustainability into Flow’s business processes in line with the Corporate ESG strategy. The position leads the deployment of ESG initiatives across Business Units and Legal Entities, supports the achievement of environmental targets, ensures robust ESG data and reporting, and promotes best practices, governance, and compliance. This role actively contributes to building a strong ESG culture across the organization. Main responsibilities:
• Deploy Flow sustainability roadmap in alignment with Corporate ESG strategy and Flow priorities
• Govern ESG within the division through the Sustainability Council
• Maintain and further develop ESG frameworks and lead implementation efforts
• Report, lead, prioritize, drive, and coordinate the division ESH related actions
• Actively manage ESG KPIs and ensure data integrity and availability
• Meet corporate environmental targets and track improvement projects reviews via project funnel
• Management and administration of the Flow Ideation platform in collaboration with other nominated colleagues and participation in the Flow Innovation Council.
• Propose necessary actions to achieve goal fulfillment and correct deviations
• Support as needed the non-financial reporting preparation
• Develop training material on safety awareness and environmental attention
• Communicate Sustainability targets, best practice and achievements
• Ensure compliance to ISO 14001, stay up to date on ESG regulation and legislation requirements
• Environment: coordinate the actions plans to reduce the environmental load as part of ESG program What you need to succeed:
• 5+ years of experience in Sustainability / ESG / ESH functions, gained in an in‑house or consulting environment, ideally with exposure to industrial or manufacturing sectors.
• Strong expertise in ESG project management, including sustainability KPIs, frameworks, governance, and reporting; solid understanding of global ESG trends and regulations.
• Proven knowledge of environmental management systems and processes, including ISO 14001 (internal auditor); experience with CSRD‑related data is a plus.
• Degree in Sustainability Management, Environmental Sciences, Engineering, or Business; Lean Six Sigma Black Belt certification desired; SAP knowledge is an advantage.
• Excellent communication and leadership skills, fluent in English, with the ability to engage diverse stakeholders, lead workshops, and work effectively in global, cross‑functional teams. What we offer you
• A permanent contract.
• A competitive salary as well as participation in the variable remuneration system based on personal and financial objectives.
• Restaurant tickets
• Be part of an experienced, international team.
• A good vibe working environment.
• Enjoy great office facilities and a perfect location in Madrid Nuevos Ministerios , making your work experience both comfortable and convenient.
• Other fringe benefits Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

You will be responsible for repairing and maintaining Sulzer Pumps’ and all other manufacturers’ pumping equipment while strictly adhering to customer, OEM and industry standard specifications. • Setting and operating dynamic balancing equipment

• Attention to detail

• Pump repair experience preferred
• Ability to work with limited supervision
• Ability to travel to and work at customer sites

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role If you love administration and thrive on being part of a growing, energetic business, we’d love to welcome you to our team. Our Sulzer Brisbane Service Centre is fast‑paced, collaborative and on an exciting growth journey, and we’re looking for an experienced admin professional to grow with us and make a real impact. Your main tasks and responsibilities
• General office admin including but not limited to reception activities, personnel queries e.g. travel and expenses and team coordination.
• Job package creation and admin including PO’s and Invoicing. This includes ensuring that all materials are accurately booked from stock to each job.
• System admin for materials and stock management. You will take control of the stock and be responsible for adequate supply. It is imperative that you effectively liaise with warehouse staff, drivers, suppliers and internal management by email and phone tenaciously.
• Accounts payable and receivable tasks - processing suppliers' invoices and customers for payment of invoices.
• General filing (manual and digital), data entry including payroll and reviewing wage reports to ensure 100% accuracy in a timely manner.
• Weekly on hand stock checks from list to ensure workshop consumables are consistently topped up, liaise with Management on levels to be ordered.
• Provide administration assistance to the Leadership Team as required.
• Ensure all work is carried out in accordance with legislative requirements, Company policies and procedures. What you bring to Sulzer
• 5+ Years' experience in Office Administration with purchasing and stores know how.
• You combine meticulous clerical skills with the practical mindset of a logistics professional.
• Reliability, friendly attitude and ability to liaise with blue collar to senior management personnel.
• Attention to detail.
• Strong computer skills with Microsoft suite, Microsoft Dynamics or equivalent SAP/ERP systems.
• Strong communication skills.
• Sound ability to adapt in shared duties.
• High level skills in time management. What we offer you
• Be part of a fun, energetic and collaborative team.
• Annual salary reviews
• Employee Assistance Program
• On-site parking
• Work for a global organisation that values innovation, excellence and a commitment to the most important part of our business - our people and our customers. Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Job Summary Join our Sulzer Turbo Services team, part of Sulzer Services, which is one of the world's most advanced independent providers of repair, overhaul, and maintenance within the turbine industry. From Venlo (Lomm) or on site, we provide our customers worldwide with solid, customer-oriented, and flexible support for their Compressors, Steam and Gas Turbines. Please join our proud and highly skilled international crew as a Technical Field Advisor.This job profile is intended for experienced professionals who apply practical knowledge of a job area and work independently with general supervision. In this role you will be accountable for:
• Providing mechanical on-site technical direction and supervision during maintenance events (inspections, revisions, commissioning) of customer owned Power Generation Facilities utilizing Gas Turbines manufactured by Siemens, Ansaldo, Alstom, General Electric and MHI.
• Ensuring accurate installation, trouble shooting, maintenance and diagnostics of gas turbines and other rotating equipment according to Sulzer specifications
• Managing site activities like planning, integration and monitoring of resources and technical assistance based on agreed contractual work scope
• Supervising contract employees, manpower by providing directions, instructions, monitor quality and progress during gas turbine overhauls
• Ensuring all field activities are carried out safely complying with Sulzer’s QESH guidelines and procedures
• Reporting of all required job documentation (protocols, inspection reports, as –built drawings, work instructions, daily progress, defects and non-conformity etc.) properly and timely To succeed in this role, you will need:
• A vocational degree as a Technician
• 10 + years hands-on gas turbine experience and proven track record of executing overhaul projects
• Very good English language skills
• A proactive, flexible, and problem-solving attitude
• Excellent interpersonal and communication skills What we offer you
• A more than competitive salary
• A generous number of holidays (40)
• A solid pension scheme
• Training opportunities Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Start your career at Sulzer’s Falkirk Service Centre, the specialist hub for high‑voltage testing, repair and refurbishment of large industrial equipment. This is where complex, heavy‑duty engineering comes to life - and as an apprentice, you’ll work alongside expert engineers and project managers, learning hands‑on skills and knowledge that help power major industries across the UK and beyond. Our Project Manager Apprenticeship gives you real life experience, exposure to a variety of business projects and the chance to build solid technical skills in a professional engineering environment. Key Responsibilities
• Provide day-to-day administrative support to teams or managers
• Assist with creating and updating project plans, schedules, and timelines
• Communicate project updates to stakeholders and team members
• Maintain accurate records, databases, and filing systems
• Input and update information using internal systems and spreadsheets
• Act as a first point of contact for internal and external enquiries
• Communicate professionally via email, phone, and face-to-face
• Support customer or stakeholder queries and escalate where required
• Assist with improving administrative processes and ways of working
• Support business operations such as procurement, invoicing, or project management
• Help monitor KPIs and produce basic performance reports What We’re Looking For We welcome applicants who are enthusiastic about engineering and ready to learn. You’ll be a great fit if you have:
• 3 National 5’s (passes) , including Maths and English
• Motivation to learn and develop new skills
• Good time ‑ management and organisational ability
• A positive, flexible attitude and strong attention to detail
• Prior business administration or project management experience isn’t required - just curiosity, commitment, and a willingness to get involved. What we offer you
• Competitive apprentice pay that increases as you progress
• Mentoring and support from experienced professionals
• Opportunities to work with modern technology and innovative applications
• Sponsored education with pathways to higher qualifications
• Potential short placements at other UK sites
• Opportunities to work with teams or customers internationally
• Strong potential for a permanent role on successful completion
• Long ‑ term development and progression routes within Sulzer
• A UK-wide apprentice community of more than 80 peers
• 33 days’ holiday (including bank holidays)
• Company pension scheme What Will Your Time as an Apprentice Look Like? Year 1 – Full‑Time College You’ll spend your first year at college working towards a Level 2 or Level 3 engineering qualification. This gives you the foundation knowledge and core skills you’ll need before joining the team on-site. Years 2, 3 & 4 – On‑Site Development From your second year onwards, you’ll be based within our engineering teams. You’ll gain hands‑on experience, apply what you’ve learned, and continue your studies towards a Level 3 qualification and your final Apprenticeship Standard. Throughout this time you’ll receive regular mentoring, internal training, and opportunities to broaden your experience across different engineering tasks. Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.
