descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Sulzer Pump Solutions Ireland Ltd is part of our Water and Industry Business Unit which aspires to develop - among others - products and solutions that support water recycling in s sustainable energy efficient way. There are 270 people employed in the Sulzer Company based in Wexford. This role requires the capabilities to design, develop, code, test and debug software of our embedded devices and systems. A key responsibility will be to recommend new approaches, advising on industry standards, and will work closely with hardware specialists and programming teams. We are looking for a/an Embedded Electronic Software Development Engineer to join our FE_Products, Technology and Digitalization team in Ireland. Your main tasks and responsibilities:
• Technical responsibility for the design of our embedded software (firmware) for control, monitoring and connectivity solutions.
• Specify, design and document technical requirements, and define test plans as appropriate.
• Analyse and enhance efficiency, stability and scalability of our designs.
• Work closely with internal and external resources to ensure work is completed to specification.
• Evaluate and select software components that will be used in larger solutions.
• Manage technical updates to our existing product portfolio.
• Advise on opportunities to streamline our control, monitoring and connected solutions. To succeed in this role, you will need:
• Honours Degree in Electronic Engineering, Computer Science, or similar with 7+ years of experience in best practices software development, delivery, and deployment.
• In-depth knowledge of C programming languages.Experience in developing firmware for embedded applications.
• Knowledge of software architecture for connected industrial applications/solutions.
• Knowledge of embedded systems with IoT or M2M capability.
• Knowledge of industrial communications protocols (Modbus, CAN, OPC, DNP3,).
• Knowledge of Telecoms/Network communications protocols (TCP/IP, GPRS/3G/4G, Wireless, low energy protocols).
• Experience with version control software.
• Analytical skills for root cause determination.
• Experience of working in a multi-disciplinary and multinational team environment. What we offer you
• Annual Leave - Enjoy 26 days of holiday.
• Pension - Benefit from a defined contribution pension scheme.
• Flextime - Work Life Balance
• Long Service Awards - We acknowledge and celebrate your dedicated years of service.
• Employee Assistance Programme - Prioritise well-being with confidential support and guidance.
• Professional Growth and Development Opportunities - Access to continuous learning and development programs, providing employees with valuable opportunities for skill enhancement and career progression.
• Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer è una società di ingegneria leader con un patrimonio orgoglioso di innovazione. Unisciti al nostro team globale per accrescere le tue competenze e sviluppare soluzioni innovative che consentano una società prospera e più sostenibile. Informazioni sul ruolo Siamo alla ricerca di un tecnico/tecnico di laboratorio per unire il nostro team di applicazioni e tecnologie in Allschwil. In questo ruolo emozionante si pianifica ed eseguirà le prove dei clienti, nonché il supporto attivo sui progetti di ricerca e sviluppo interni (R&D). Condurrai diversi lavori pratici nel campo R&D per migliorare la sostenibilità nell'industria chimica e sviluppare le tecnologie future. I vostri compiti principali e responsabilità:
• Analisi della caratterizzazione mediante tecniche chiave, tra cui: cromatografia a gas (GC) con campionamento a testa e liquido accoppiato a rilevatori di MS, FID e TCD; spettroscopia ottica a emissione plasmatica ad alte prestazioni (ICP-OES); spettrofotometria UV-Viss; spettrofotometria a scansione differenziale
• Responsabile del supporto analitico, garantendo l'implementazione e l'ottimizzazione dei metodi e dell'operabilità dei dispositivi corrispondenti durante le prove (compresa la preparazione degli strumenti, la calibrazione esterna, la preparazione dei campioni e le misurazioni di routine)
• Pianificazione, esecuzione, valutazione e rendicontazione delle prove del cliente (scala del banco a scala pilota).
• Supporto nell'esecuzione di prove interne ed esterne per lo sviluppo e l'ottimizzazione delle tecnologie Sulzer;
• Lavoro in stretta collaborazione con gli stakeholder aziendali interni;
• Assicurare e rispettare adeguate misure di ESH e "buona pratica di laboratorio" durante il commercio quotidiano. Contribuire attivamente alla gestione dei cambiamenti e delle valutazioni dei rischi. Rispetta le norme di sicurezza e le procedure di qualità, segnala le mancanze, gli incidenti e gli incidenti. Considerare gli aspetti LEAN al lavoro.
• Suggerire e implementare miglioramenti nel laboratorio analitico;
• Supporto e partecipazione alla distribuzione della strategia di digitalizzazione Technology & Innovation (T&I). Per avere successo in questo ruolo, avrete bisogno di:
• Diploma di laboratorio / tecnico chimico (apprendistato, diploma tecnico)
• 3-5 anni di esperienza in un ruolo simile
• Ottimo inglese. Tedesco e francese sono un bene
• Buona conoscenza tecnica nella chimica analitica è essenziale
• Altamente competente con vari strumenti e tecniche come GC (MS, FID e TCD), HPLC (UV e RI), ICP-OES, spettrofotometro UV-VIS, titolazione e misura di proprietà fisiche come densità e viscosità
• Consapevolezza per la gestione sicura di sostanze chimiche, materiali e attrezzature potenzialmente pericolosi
• Grande giocatore di squadra, forti capacità di comunicazione, forte capacità organizzativa, molto indipendente, flessibile, affidabile, orientata al cliente e adattabile. Cosa ti offriamo
• Compensazione attraente e piano di vacanza
• Ottimi benefici sociali
• Opportunità di sviluppo globali
• Una cultura innovativa, vibrante e agile
• Parcheggio gratuito e accesso ai mezzi pubblici
• Programma di assistenza ai dipendenti
• Premi di servizio lunghi Sulzer è un datore di lavoro pari opportunità. Crediamo nella forza di una forza lavoro diversificata e ci impegniamo ad offrire un ambiente di lavoro inclusivo. Siamo orgogliosi di essere riconosciuti come Top Employer 2026 in Brasile, Canada, Cina, Finlandia, Germania, Irlanda, Messico, Svizzera, Sud Africa, Regno Unito e Stati Uniti.
descriptionByLocale.en:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role We are looking for a Laboratory Technician / Chemical Technician to join our Applications & Technologies team in Allschwil. In this exciting role you will plan and execute customer trials as well as actively support on internal research and development (R&D) projects. You will conduct diverse practical lab work in the R&D field to improve sustainability in the chemical industry and develop future technologies. Your main tasks and responsibilities:
• Characterization analysis using key techniques, including: gas chromatography (GC) with headspace and liquid sampling coupled to MS, FID, and TCD detectors; high-performance liquid chromatography (HPLC) with UV and refractive index (RI) detection; inductively coupled plasma optical emission spectroscopy (ICP-OES); UV–Vis spectrophotometry; differential scanning calorimetry (DSC); optical microscopy; X‑ray powder diffraction (XRPD); Raman spectroscopy; as well as classical methods such as titration, water content determination, density, and viscosity measurements.
• Responsible for analytical support, ensuring the implementation and optimization of methods and operability of corresponding devices during trials (including instrument preparation, external calibration, sample preparation and routine measurements)
• Planning, execution, evaluation and reporting of customer trials (bench scale to pilot scale).
• Support in execution of internal and external trials for the development and optimization of Sulzer technologies;
• Work in close co-operation with internal company stakeholders;
• Ensure and respect appropriate ESH measures and "good laboratory practice" during daily business. Actively contribute to management of change and risk assessments. Respect safety regulations and quality procedures, report near misses, incidents and accidents. Consider LEAN aspects at work.
• Suggest and implement improvements in the analytical laboratory;
• Support and participate in the deployment of Technology & Innovation (T&I) Digitalization strategy. To succeed in this role, you will need:
• Diploma lab/ chemical technician (apprenticeship, technical degree)
• 3-5 years of experience in a similar role
• Excellent English. German and French are an asset
• Good technical knowledge in analytical chemistry is essential
• Highly proficient with various instruments and techniques such as GC (MS, FID and TCD), HPLC (UV and RI), ICP-OES, UV-VIS spectrophotometer, titration and measurement of physical properties such as density and viscosity
• Awareness for safe handling of chemicals, potentially hazardous materials and equipment
• Great team player, strong communication skills, strong organization ability, very independent, flexible, trustworthy, customer oriented and adaptable. What we offer you
• Attractive compensation and vacation plan
• Excellent social benefits
• Global development opportunities
• An innovative, vibrant and agile culture
• Free parking space and accessibility with public transportation
• Employee Assistance Program
• Long service awards Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

Sulzer ist ein führendes Ingenieurunternehmen mit einem stolzen Innovationserbe. Begleiten Sie unser globales Team, um Ihr Know-how zu erweitern und innovative Lösungen zu entwickeln, die eine erfolgreiche und nachhaltigere Gesellschaft ermöglichen. Über die Rolle Wir suchen einen Labortechniker / Chemische Techniker, der unserem Applications & Technologies Team in Allschwil beitritt. In dieser spannenden Rolle planen und führen Sie Kundenversuche sowie aktiv Unterstützung bei internen Forschungs- und Entwicklungsprojekten (F&D). Sie werden verschiedene praktische Laborarbeiten im Bereich FuE durchführen, um die Nachhaltigkeit in der chemischen Industrie zu verbessern und zukünftige Technologien zu entwickeln. Ihre Hauptaufgaben und Aufgaben:
• Charakterisierungsanalyse mit Schlüsseltechniken, einschließlich: Gaschromatographie (GC) mit Kopf- und Flüssigkeitsprobenahme gekoppelt mit MS-, FID- und TCD-Detektoren; Hochleistungs-Flüssigchromatographie (HPLC) mit UV- und Brechungsindex (RI)-Detektion; induktiv gekoppelte plasmaoptische Emissionsspektroskopie (ICP-OES); UV-Vis-Spektrophotometrie; Differential Scanning Calorimetry (DSC); optische Mikroskopie als
• Verantwortlich für die analytische Unterstützung, die Durchführung und Optimierung von Methoden und die Bedienbarkeit entsprechender Geräte während der Versuche (einschließlich Instrumentenvorbereitung, externe Kalibrierung, Probenvorbereitung und Routinemessungen)
• Planung, Durchführung, Auswertung und Berichterstattung von Kundenstudien (Bench-Skala bis Pilot-Skala).
• Unterstützung bei der Durchführung interner und externer Versuche zur Entwicklung und Optimierung von Sulzer-Technologien;
• Arbeiten Sie in enger Zusammenarbeit mit internen Unternehmensgruppen;
• Gewährleistung und Einhaltung angemessener ESH-Maßnahmen und "guter Laborpraxis" während des täglichen Geschäfts. Aktiver Beitrag zur Verwaltung von Veränderungen und Risikobewertungen. Respektieren Sie Sicherheitsvorschriften und Qualitätsverfahren, melden Sie sich bei Misses, Vorfälle und Unfällen. Betrachten Sie LEAN-Aspekte bei der Arbeit.
• Verbesserung des analytischen Labors vorschlagen und umsetzen;
• Unterstützung und Teilnahme an der Einführung von Technologie & Innovation (T&I) Digitalisierungsstrategie. Um in dieser Rolle erfolgreich zu sein, benötigen Sie:
• Diplomlabor / Chemietechniker (Ausbildung, technischer Abschluss)
• 3-5 Jahre Erfahrung in einer ähnlichen Rolle
• Ausgezeichnetes Englisch. Deutsch und Französisch sind ein Vermögen
• Gute technische Kenntnisse in der analytischen Chemie ist unerlässlich
• Mit verschiedenen Instrumenten und Techniken wie GC (MS, FID und TCD), HPLC (UV und RI), ICP-OES, UV-VIS-Spektrophotometer, Titration und Messung physikalischer Eigenschaften wie Dichte und Viskosität
• Bewusstsein für eine sichere Handhabung von Chemikalien, potenziell gefährlichen Materialien und Geräten
• Großer Teamplayer, starke Kommunikationsfähigkeit, starke Organisationsfähigkeit, sehr unabhängig, flexibel, vertrauenswürdig, kundenorientiert und anpassungsfähig. Was wir Ihnen anbieten
• Attraktiver Ausgleichs- und Urlaubsplan

• Globale Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten

• Kostenlose Parkplätze und Zugänglichkeit mit öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln
• Mitarbeiterunterstützungsprogramm

Sulzer est une entreprise d'ingénierie de premier plan avec un fier héritage d'innovation. Rejoignez notre équipe mondiale pour développer votre expertise et développer des solutions innovantes qui permettent une société prospère et plus durable. Sur le rôle Nous sommes à la recherche d'un technicien de laboratoire / technicien en chimie pour rejoindre notre équipe Applications & Technologies à Allschwil. Dans ce rôle passionnant, vous planifierez et exécuterez des essais clients ainsi qu'un soutien actif pour des projets internes de recherche et développement (R-D). Vous effectuerez divers travaux pratiques de laboratoire dans le domaine de la R-D afin d'améliorer la durabilité de l'industrie chimique et de développer des technologies futures. Vos principales tâches et responsabilités:
• Analyse de caractérisation à l'aide de techniques clés, notamment : chromatographie en phase gazeuse (GC) avec spectroscopie optique d'émission de plasma couplée inductuellement (ICP-OES); spectrophotométrie UV-Vis; calorimétrie à balayage différentiel (DSC); microscopie optique; diffraction des rayons X; spectroscopie Raman; méthodes classiques telles que titrage, détermination de la teneur en eau, densité et mesures de viscosité.
• Responsable du soutien analytique, de la mise en œuvre et de l'optimisation des méthodes et du fonctionnement des dispositifs correspondants lors des essais (y compris la préparation des instruments, l'étalonnage externe, la préparation des échantillons et les mesures de routine)
• La planification, l'exécution, l'évaluation et l'établissement de rapports sur les essais de clients (échelle de banc à échelle pilote).
• Soutien à la réalisation d'essais internes et externes pour le développement et l'optimisation des technologies Sulzer;
• travailler en étroite collaboration avec les acteurs internes de l'entreprise;
• Assurer et respecter les mesures appropriées d'ESH et les "bonnes pratiques de laboratoire" dans les affaires quotidiennes. Contribuer activement à la gestion des changements et des évaluations des risques. Respecter la réglementation en matière de sécurité et les procédures de qualité, signaler les incidents et les accidents. Considérez les aspects LEAN au travail.
• Proposer et mettre en oeuvre des améliorations dans le laboratoire d'analyse;
• Soutenir et participer au déploiement de la stratégie de numérisation de la technologie et de l'innovation. Pour réussir dans ce rôle, vous devrez :
• Diplôme de laboratoire/technicien en chimie (apprentissage, diplôme technique)
• 3-5 ans d'expérience dans un rôle similaire
• Excellent anglais. L'allemand et le français sont un atout
• Une bonne connaissance technique de la chimie analytique est essentielle
• Très compétent avec divers instruments et techniques tels que GC (MS, FID et TCD), HPLC (UV et RI), ICP-OES, spectrophotomètre UV-VIS, titrage et mesure des propriétés physiques telles que la densité et la viscosité
• Sensibilisation à la manipulation sécuritaire des produits chimiques, des matières et du matériel potentiellement dangereux
• Grand joueur d'équipe, fortes compétences en communication, forte capacité d'organisation, très indépendante, flexible, digne de confiance, orientée client et adaptable. Ce que nous vous offrons
• Indemnité attrayante et plan de vacances
• Excellents avantages sociaux
• Possibilités de développement mondial
• Une culture innovante, dynamique et agile
• Parking gratuit et accessibilité avec les transports en commun
• Programme d'aide aux employés
• Prix de longue durée Sulzer est un employeur à chances égales. Nous croyons en la force d'un effectif diversifié et sommes déterminés à offrir un milieu de travail inclusif. Nous sommes fiers d'être reconnus comme l'un des meilleurs employeurs 2026 au Brésil, au Canada, en Chine, en Finlande, en Allemagne, en Irlande, au Mexique, en Suisse, en Afrique du Sud, au Royaume-Uni et aux États-Unis.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Job Summary The Mechanical Engineer is responsible for researching, planning, designing, and developing mechanical products and systems. This includes instruments, controls, engines, and machines used in energy production, transmission, and measurement. This job profile is intended for early-career professionals who apply broad theoretical knowledge and require the ability to investigate and analyze problems. Solutions are typically discussed/verified with a more senior member. This position operates within the Order Related Engineering (ORE) department and is responsible for comprehensive understanding project scope to determine the requirement for developing a Submittal Package. Submittal package includes mechanical design, General Arrangement (GA) drawings and the preparation of mechanical components specific to individual sales orders. The role involves compiling and coordinating the development of Submittal Packages in close collaboration with Motor Control Designers and the ORE Manager. Additionally, this position will manage the submittal approval process with customers, ensuring timely feedback and resolution. Upon approval, the position is accountable for generating fabrication drawings, creating part numbers within the ERP system, and releasing the finalized package to production. Furthermore, the position provides mechanical engineering expertise to Tendering by reviewing project specifications and offering recommendations. Principle Duties and Responsibilities:
• Review project scope and specifications and organize hand-off meetings as necessary to ensure alignment and clarity.
• Design mechanical components, assemblies, and general arrangement drawings specific to sales orders using Autodesk Inventor and maintain associated files within the Autodesk Vault management system.
• Create and manage submittal packages through the customer approval process, ensuring timely and accurate release.
• Update and maintain sales order workflows within the Visual ERP system.
• Review and verify mechanical drawings and bills of materials (BOMs) prepared by other team members within the ORE department to ensure accuracy and compliance.
• Conduct mechanical specification reviews to support tendering activities, as assigned by the ORE Manager.
• Provide mechanical engineering support to other departments as directed by the ORE Manager.
• Assist Production and field service technicians by offering mechanical support during fabrication and product installation.
• Perform additional duties and participate in special projects as assigned. Education & Experience: Required: Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering with 2+ years of experience. Desired: Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering and project management professional certification (PMP) with 2+ years of experience. Skills: Required: CAD Experience in 3D modeling and drafting ERP System Experience. Ability to use technology and analysis tools (Excel, Outlook, web, databases). Desired: Autodesk Inventor Knowledge of ASME Y 14.5M 2018 standards. Decision Authority: Accountability: Position is accountable for ensuring the accuracy and OTD of submittal package, fabrication drawings and Visual BOM updates. This position is also accountable to maintain compliance with company standards and its safety policies. Responsibility: This position is responsible for making decisions related to mechanical design, drawing creation, BOM verification and co-ordination between different departments. Also responsible for managing the customer submittal approval process and supporting Operations. Delegation: This position may delegate tasks such as Drawing checks and BOM verification to other team members within the ORE department, under the guidan

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Job Summary The Mechanical Engineer is responsible for researching, planning, designing, and developing mechanical products and systems. This includes instruments, controls, engines, and machines used in energy production, transmission, and measurement. This job profile is intended for early-career professionals who apply broad theoretical knowledge and require the ability to investigate and analyze problems. Solutions are typically discussed/verified with a more senior member. Sulzer is offering a unique opportunity for early-career engineers to jumpstart their professional journey through a dynamic two-year rotational program. This immersive experience provides direct exposure across key departments within Sulzer’s Services Division, with the goal of permanent department placement upon program completion. Position Summary: The Rotational Engineer program is a two-year rotational program designed to attract, develop, and retain high-potential, transformative engineers through best-in-industry rotational experience and professional development. This program supports the Services Division in the Americas by leading hands-on and strategic initiatives that enhance commercial and operational excellence. Acts as a bridge between engineering, commercial, and operations – designing and implementing shop-floor solutions, automation, supporting technical documentation, collaborating with vendors, and driving continuous improvement. Participants will rotate through four specialized areas, focusing on sales, operations, or engineering, each lasting six months:
• Steam Turbines and Compressor: Overhauls and assembly, rotor and component repairs, reverse engineering and parts manufacturing, performance rerates, performance qualification tests, custom engineering solutions, and field service
• Gas Turbine (Industrial and Aeroderivative): Overhauls and assembly, rotor and component repairs, metallurgical evaluations, performance testing, and field service
• Pumps: Overhauls and assembly, rotor and component repairs, reverse engineering and parts manufacturing, performance optimization, retrofits, hydraulic testing, and field service
• Electro-Mechanical Services: Overhauls and repairs of motors and generators, generator rewind, high voltage coil manufacturing, engineering services, and field services Rotations I & II : Carefully selected to match your current skills and future ambitions, ensuring a personalized and enriching start to the program. Rotations III & IV : You take the wheel—choose from a range of opportunities across departments to deepen expertise, explore new interests, and shape your unique path. Candidates will be considered for all hiring Service Center locations which include but not limited to the following cities: Houston, TX, Margate, FL, Chattanooga, TN, Barboursville, WV, Los Angeles, CA, Joliet, IL, Aurora, CO, Baton Rouge, LA, Piedmont, SC, Odessa, TX, Mobile, AL, Salt Lake City, UT, Phoenix, AZ, Gillette, WY, Colton, CA, and Orange, TX. All candidates must be willing to relocate to any of these locations, or other Sulzer sites while in the program. Sulzer provides a locally adjusted housing allowance and mileage reimbursement to next rotation location, along with five business days of transfer time (excluding home-based placements). Functions
• Participate or lead job tasks, production duties, and process improvement initiatives identified and assigned by Supervisor.
• Design, develop, implement, or upgrade drawings, work instructions, procedures, technical documentation, tooling and fixturing improvements.
• Collaborate with internal teams and external vendors to source and qualify solutions.
• Balance immediate troubleshooting support with long-term strategic projects. Skills

Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Job Summary The Operations / Manufacturing / Production Officer is responsible for supporting daily production or service operations by coordinating schedules, monitoring progress, and ensuring compliance with quality and safety standards. This job profile is intended for early-career professionals who apply broad theoretical knowledge and require the ability to investigate and analyse problems. Solutions are typically discussed/verified with a more senior member. Job Description: Packaging Shift Engineer Position Title Packaging Shift Engineer Function Operations – Packaging Work Center Reporting To Packaging Manager Experience Requirement 5–7 years of experience in Packaging / Production operations with shift-handling responsibility Key Responsibilities 1. Production & Shift Operations
• Plan and execute packaging activities as per monthly production plans and inspection schedules.
• Deploy manpower effectively based on shift workload and packaging requirements.
• Monitor production orders, confirm job execution, and ensure on‑time package completion.
• Plan activities considering space availability and readiness for upcoming orders.
• Coordinate piping, wiring, and overall package readiness as per drawings and customer requirements. 2. Manpower Supervision & Workforce Management
• Supervise operators and technicians during shift operations.
• Provide on‑the‑job technical guidance and resolve shop‑floor issues.
• Conduct toolbox talks at the beginning of each shift.
• Motivate the workforce to maintain high standards of productivity, discipline, safety, and quality. 3. Quality Assurance & NCR Management
• Offer completed jobs to Quality Control and support inspection activities.
• Attend inspections and close all punch points for package readiness.
• Raise and manage NCRs (internal & external) and ensure effective corrective and preventive actions.
• Implement in‑house rework solutions to minimize outsourcing and delays.
• Drive adherence to Zero NCR targets for the packaging department.
• undefined 4. Subcontracting & In‑Process Activities
• Plan, coordinate, and follow up on subcontracted activities, including:
• Blasting & Painting
• Piping fabrication and hydro testing
• Radiography Testing (RT)
• Pump Insulation
• Ensure subcontracted work meets quality, safety, and delivery commitments. 5. Materials, Consumables & Cross‑Functional Coordination
• Identify shortages in materials and consumables.
• Coordinate with Stores, Warehouse, Purchase, Planning teams for timely availability.
• Prepare consumable requirement forecasts and follow up for procurement.
• Coordinate maintenance activities during breakdowns to minimize downtime.
• Ensure calibrated tools and gauges are submitted to QC as per schedule. 6. Productivity & Performance Monitoring
• Maintain and review JCP (Job Capacity Planning) monthly.
• Ensure effective and optimal manpower utilization.
• Monitor execution of paperless production systems.
• Ensure accurate confirmation of production hours and SAP entries.
• undefined 7. Lean Manufacturing & Continuous Improvement
• Implement and sustain Lean Manufacturing practices, including:
• 5S
• Kaizen
• Continuous Improvement initiatives
• Submit Kaizen proposals monthly and motivate employees to contribute improvement ideas.
• Conduct and participate in periodic 5S audits.
• Drive digital and paperless systems across packaging operations. 8. Training & Skill Development
• Identify training needs and conduct skill development programs for shop‑floor personnel.
• Support capability building to improve safety, quality, and productivity. 9. Safety, Health & Environment (ESH)
• Ensure strict adherence to safety policies and PPE usage.

Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Job Summary The Operations / Manufacturing / Production Officer is responsible for supporting daily production or service operations by coordinating schedules, monitoring progress, and ensuring compliance with quality and safety standards. This job profile is intended for early-career professionals who apply broad theoretical knowledge and require the ability to investigate and analyse problems. Solutions are typically discussed/verified with a more senior member. Job Description: Packaging Shift Engineer Position Title Packaging Shift Engineer Function Operations – Packaging Work Center Reporting To Packaging Manager Experience Requirement 5–7 years of experience in Packaging / Production operations with shift-handling responsibility Key Responsibilities 1. Production & Shift Operations
• Plan and execute packaging activities as per monthly production plans and inspection schedules.
• Deploy manpower effectively based on shift workload and packaging requirements.
• Monitor production orders, confirm job execution, and ensure on‑time package completion.
• Plan activities considering space availability and readiness for upcoming orders.
• Coordinate piping, wiring, and overall package readiness as per drawings and customer requirements. 2. Manpower Supervision & Workforce Management
• Supervise operators and technicians during shift operations.
• Provide on‑the‑job technical guidance and resolve shop‑floor issues.
• Conduct toolbox talks at the beginning of each shift.
• Motivate the workforce to maintain high standards of productivity, discipline, safety, and quality. 3. Quality Assurance & NCR Management
• Offer completed jobs to Quality Control and support inspection activities.
• Attend inspections and close all punch points for package readiness.
• Raise and manage NCRs (internal & external) and ensure effective corrective and preventive actions.
• Implement in‑house rework solutions to minimize outsourcing and delays.
• Drive adherence to Zero NCR targets for the packaging department.
• undefined 4. Subcontracting & In‑Process Activities
• Plan, coordinate, and follow up on subcontracted activities, including:
• Blasting & Painting
• Piping fabrication and hydro testing
• Radiography Testing (RT)
• Pump Insulation
• Ensure subcontracted work meets quality, safety, and delivery commitments. 5. Materials, Consumables & Cross‑Functional Coordination
• Identify shortages in materials and consumables.
• Coordinate with Stores, Warehouse, Purchase, Planning teams for timely availability.
• Prepare consumable requirement forecasts and follow up for procurement.
• Coordinate maintenance activities during breakdowns to minimize downtime.
• Ensure calibrated tools and gauges are submitted to QC as per schedule. 6. Productivity & Performance Monitoring
• Maintain and review JCP (Job Capacity Planning) monthly.
• Ensure effective and optimal manpower utilization.
• Monitor execution of paperless production systems.
• Ensure accurate confirmation of production hours and SAP entries.

• Submit Kaizen proposals monthly and motivate employees to contribute improvement ideas.
• Conduct and participate in periodic 5S audits.

• Proven ability to understand and interpret engineering drawings and illustrated parts catalogues
• Working knowledge of industrial or power gas turbines and associated components
• A minimum of NC in Mechanical Engineering or equivalent; HNC is preferred (or suitable proven experience in lieu of formal qualifications)
• Strong organisational skills and ability to work collaboratively with workshop and quality teams What we offer you
• Enjoy a better work-life balance with our 9-day fortnight, giving you a three-day weekend every other week
• Competitive base salary

• On-site parking

Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Your main tasks and responsibilities:
• Provide 2nd‑level IT support, both on‑site and remotely, for all users of Sulzer Ltd, primarily within the assigned region and, if required, across other regions
• Monitor and maintain the entire local IT infrastructure, including desktop and mobile Windows devices, MFPs, company‑specific hardware and software, user and access management, servers, network components, etc.
• Install and configure end‑user devices, including mobile phones
• Handle hardware procurement and inventory management
• Receive, analyze, and resolve incidents and service requests within 2nd‑level support using standard IT tools
• Escalate incidents and service requests to 3rd‑level support, external local service providers, or management when required

• Successfully completed IT education or training
• Several years of professional experience in 2nd‑ and/or 3rd‑level IT support
• Experience in VIP support is an advantage (preferably in a comparable corporate environment)
• Broad knowledge in network (Cisco), DDC (Hyper-V), AD, Exchange, SharePoint, OneDrive, Azure, Intune etc.
• ITIL and/or Microsoft certifications (Server / Client / Network) are an advantage
• Very good English skills and good German skills would be a strong advantage.
• Strong customer‑ and service‑oriented mindset
• Analytical, structured, and solution‑oriented approach
• Ability to work independently as well as in a team‑oriented environment
• Flexibility regarding tasks and working hours, and willingness to undertake occasional business travel
• Availability to work in shift hours (7am - 4pm / 9am - 6pm) What we offer you

descriptionByLocale.en:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role The HR Administration & Payroll Manager is responsible for leading and overseeing all HR administrative processes and end-to-end payroll operations for Switzerland. This role ensures full compliance with Swiss labor law, social security regulations, tax obligations, and internal policies. The position acts as the primary point of contact for HR operations, employee lifecycle administration, payroll accuracy, and HR system integrity. The role needs hands-on execution, ensuring efficient HR processes and high-quality service delivery to employees and managers. Your main tasks and responsibilities Payroll Management (Swiss Payroll)
• Oversee and execute monthly payroll for all Swiss employees, including variable pay, allowances, deductions, and absences.
• Manage payroll controls, reconciliations, audits, and reporting activities.
• Ensure correct calculation of taxes, social security contributions, pension fund deductions, and insurance premiums.
• Act as key contact for employees on payroll, benefits, and time management topics.
• Collaborate with Finance on payroll accounting, salary provision, and audit requirements.
• Manage year‑end activities (salary certificates, Withholding Tax year closing, social security reporting) HR Administration & Employee Lifecycle Management
• Act as a trusted HR advisor to managers and senior leaders based in Switzerland
• Manage and oversee all administrative HR processes for the entire employee lifecycle (hire to retire).
• Prepare employment contracts, amendments, reference letters, and other legal documents in accordance with Swiss law.
• Ensure accurate maintenance of employee records and digital personnel files.
• Manage onboarding and offboarding processes, including work permits (L, B, C) and liaison with authorities.
• Ensure timely registration and reporting to social security institutions (AHV/ALV/IV/EO), pension funds (BVG/LPP), accident insurance (UVG), KTG and family allowance offices.
• Support annual performance and compensation cycles from an administrative standpoint.
• Ensure compliance with internal policies, GDPR, and Swiss data protection regulations. HR Systems & Process Optimization
• Maintain and optimize HRIS and time‑tracking systems (e.g., SAP, Workday, Abacus, or similar).
• Ensure data accuracy and reliability for reporting and analytics.
• Drive process improvements and standardization across HR administration and payroll.
• Support implementation of new tools and digital HR solutions.
• Compliance, Policies & Governance.
• Ensure full compliance with Swiss labour law, collective labour agreements (if applicable), and company policies.
• Maintain HR governance frameworks and support HR audits.
• Keep up to date with regulatory changes and translate them into operational processes. To succeed in this role, you will need
• Degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.
• Several years of experience in HR administration and Swiss payroll (mandatory).
• Strong understanding of Swiss labour law, social security system, taxes, and employment compliance.
• Experience in multinational environments is an asset.
• Strong MS Office and HRIS proficiency; payroll system expertise required.
• Fluent in German and English.
• Working time: 80 - 100 %. No visa or work permit support can be provided for this role. Do you have a question about the role? Reach out to Alexi Donadoni at alexi.donadoni@sulzer.com. What we offer you
• 25 days holidays (exclusive of bank holidays) + service days
• Defined contribution pension scheme
• Employee Assistance Program/health care
• On-site car parking/public transport allowance
• Access to a wide range of discounts Sulzer is an equal opportunity em

Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Tendering Sr. Manager is responsible for managing senior-level professionals in the preparation of technical and commercial proposals. This role ensures the accuracy and competitiveness of tenders and supports strategic sales initiatives.
This job profile is intended for People Managers of more senior expert-level employees (P20–P40, M20). Purpose of the job:

Management of the company tender and sales support function in order to meet the
objectives of the company's overall business plans and strategies

Main tasks and responsibilities:
• 1. Deputizing for Regional Sales Director for SSA region where appropriate
• 2. Ensure application of Sulzer tools and policies, procedures, codes of conduct and
• best practice guidelines
• 3. Mentoring, directing, motivating, supervising, and monitoring the performance of all
• members of the allocated team in SSA region
• 4. Identify and initiate department training on a regular basis
• 5. Day to day review of enquiries in conjunction with the Regional Sales Director for SSA Region
• 6. Support, assist and initiate new client contract agreements as and when identified
• 7. Allocation of enquiries to the tendering resource ensuring optimum use of that
• resource in all groups.
• 8. Provide support during the pre-tender process starting from evaluating/assessing
• tenders, assessing risk factors to arrive at bid decisions, and estimating all the
• required material, equipment, and manpower needs to be able to arrive at reliable
• cost estimates for bidding spares, service to turnkey projects.
• 9. Study, analyze and evaluate tender documents and identify risk factors, ensure
• that technical terms comply with the relevant standards and coordinates with the
• Division Heads, and Regional Sales Director for the overall risk assessment and
• bid decision for SSA region
• 10. Overall responsibility to ensure that customer requirements are satisfied whilst
• meeting SSA targets
• 11. Overall responsibility to ensure that tenders for PPR, PSC, EMS, TS & FE meet
• company commercial guidelines and have the necessary sign off in accordance
• with the delegation of authority guidelines
• 12. Overall responsibility together with the Regional Sales Director for maintaining the
• profit margin on SSA tenders
• 13. Proactively engage with procurement to ensure competitive bidding is possible
• 14. Review and finalize project cost estimates as prepared by the Tendering Engineer
• in terms of the required material as per bill of quantities (BOQ), amount of work,
• material/ equipment/ and manpower requirements during the tendering phase; this
• includes all systems, products and services to client specifications/ requirements.
• 15. Finalize estimation of all direct and indirect costs and consolidate tender documents for management review and approval.
• 16. Ensure in conjunction with sales that the Preliminary eTOA and eTOA tool is
• utilized in line with the eTOA regulation requirements for tenders meeting this
• criteria
• 17. Overall responsibility to ensure that initiated projects meet company requirements
• in terms of selection, pricing, terms and conditions and lead time
• 18. Overall responsibility to ensure that Order Entry Documentation is completed in
• accordance with handover guidelines and procedures and company KPIs.
• 19. Ensure tender margins are accurate for order entry.
• 20. Overall responsibility to ensure that the sales team are adequately supported and
• that projects are launched in a timely and professional manner
• 21. Ensure that handover meetings with projects are effective and result in a smooth
• transition from pre to post order status
• 22. Provide all the necessary project clarifications/ information upon project award to
• the Project Manager as per the project budget; advises the Project Manager on
• contractual rights, re

Informazioni sul ruolo

Sintesi del lavoro
Il responsabile Tendering Sr. Manager è responsabile della gestione di professionisti di alto livello nella preparazione di proposte tecniche e commerciali. Questo ruolo garantisce l'accuratezza e la competitività delle offerte e sostiene iniziative strategiche di vendita.
Questo profilo di lavoro è destinato a People Managers di dipendenti più esperti (P20–P40, M20). Scopo del lavoro:

Gestione dell'offerta aziendale e della funzione di supporto vendite al fine di soddisfare la
obiettivi dei piani aziendali e delle strategie generali dell'azienda

Principali compiti e responsabilità:
• 1. Deputazione per il Direttore regionale delle vendite per la regione SSA, se del caso
• 2. Assicurare l'applicazione di strumenti e politiche, procedure, codici di condotta e
• migliori orientamenti di pratica
• 3. Mentoring, diretto, motivante, supervisione e monitoraggio delle prestazioni di tutti
• membri del team assegnato nella regione SSA
• 4. Identificare e avviare regolarmente la formazione del reparto
• 5. Riesame giornaliero delle richieste in collaborazione con il Direttore Regionale Vendite per la Regione SSA

• 7. Locazione delle richieste alla risorsa di gara assicurando un uso ottimale di tale
• risorse in tutti i gruppi.
• 8. Fornire supporto durante il processo pre-tender a partire dalla valutazione/valutazione
• le offerte, la valutazione dei fattori di rischio per arrivare a decisioni di offerta e la stima di tutti i fattori di rischio
• materiale necessario, attrezzature e manodopera devono essere in grado di arrivare ad affidabile
• stime dei costi per le offerte, servizio ai progetti chiavi in mano.
• 9. Studiare, analizzare e valutare i documenti teneri e identificare i fattori di rischio, garantire
• che i termini tecnici siano conformi alle norme e alle coordinate pertinenti
• Capo divisione e Direttore regionale delle vendite per la valutazione generale del rischio e
• decisione di offerta per la regione SSA
• 10. Responsabilità complessiva per garantire che i requisiti del cliente siano soddisfatti mentre
• soddisfare gli obiettivi SSA
• 11. Responsabilità complessiva per garantire che le offerte per PPR, PSC, EMS, TS & FE si incontrano
• le linee guida commerciali aziendali e hanno il segno necessario fuori in conformità
• con la delegazione degli orientamenti dell'autorità
• 12. Responsabilità complessiva insieme al Direttore Vendite Regionale per il mantenimento della
• margine di profitto sulle offerte SSA
• 13. Proattivamente impegnarsi con gli appalti per garantire l'offerta competitiva è possibile
• 14. Verificare e finalizzare le stime dei costi del progetto come preparate dall'Ingegnere di Tendering
• in termini di materiale richiesto per fattura di quantità (BOQ), quantità di lavoro,
• requisiti di materiale/attrezzatura e di manodopera durante la fase di appalto;
• comprende tutti i sistemi, i prodotti e i servizi alle specifiche/ esigenze del cliente.
• 15. Finalizzare la stima di tutti i costi diretti e indiretti e consolidare i documenti d'appalto per la revisione e l'approvazione della gestione.
• 16. Assicurarsi in combinazione con le vendite che lo strumento preliminare eTOA ed eTOA è
• utilizzato in linea con i requisiti di regolamentazione eTOA per le offerte che soddisfano questo
• criteri
• 17. Responsabilità complessiva di garantire che i progetti avviati soddisfino i requisiti aziendali
• in termini di selezione, prezzi, termini e condizioni e tempi di consegna
• 18. Responsabilità complessiva di garantire che la documentazione di ammissione dell'ordine sia completata in
• secondo le linee guida e le procedure di consegna e i KPI aziendali.
• 19. Assicurare margini di gara sono accurati per l'entrata dell'ordine.
• 20. Responsabilità complessiva per garantire che il team di vendita sia adeguatamente supportato e
• che i progetti siano avviati in modo tempestivo e professionale
• 21. Assicurarsi che le riunioni di consegna con i progetti siano efficaci e si traducano in modo uniforme
• passaggio da pre a post stato dell'ordine
• 22. Fornire tutte le necessarie precisazioni del progetto/informazioni sul premio del progetto a
• il Project Manager secondo il budget del progetto; consiglia il Project Manager su
• diritti contrattuali, re

You’ll help deliver innovative solutions for the maintenance, repair, and optimisation of rotating equipment across our full service portfolio. Your Main Responsibilities
• Lead and support a regional team of Sales Engineers in promoting Sulzer’s full portfolio of service solutions for rotating equipment - including inspection, overhaul, repair, upgrades, and replacement parts.
• Lead monthly order intake performance for the South UK region, taking full ownership of targets and consistently delivering in line with business forecasts and commitments.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Sulzer’s GT Aero business is entering an exciting new phase. As a key strategic area for Sulzer globally, we’re investing heavily in people, capability and long‑term development. Our Netherley, Stonehaven site specialises in aeroderivative gas turbine services, delivering repair, overhaul, field services, component manufacture and control‑system support. With one of the world’s largest inventories of turbine parts behind us, we’re positioned for significant growth. Now we’re looking for a Quality Manager who can help take us to the next level The Opportunity This is a chance to join at a pivotal moment. Our QA/QC systems are developing fast, and we want someone who can truly shape the future of quality at the site. As our Quality Manager, you will:
• Define and implement a site‑wide quality strategy for a growing aeroderivative services business.
• Strengthen and enhance QA/QC processes, ensuring they’re robust, efficient and fit for a high‑integrity engineering environment.
• Drive continuous improvement across operations, working closely with engineering, manufacturing, service teams and leadership.
• Act as the site’s quality expert, advising on standards, compliance, audits and certifications.
• Lay the foundations for a future quality function, helping harmonise processes and build capability as the team expands. About You You’ll thrive here if you’re someone who enjoys building, improving and owning quality systems. We’re looking for:
• Strong experience in QA/QC within rotating equipment, engineering, energy, or related environments.
• A hands‑on, solutions‑focused approach to quality management.
• Confidence in leading audits, managing compliance and driving standards.
• The ability to influence, collaborate and bring people with you through change.
• A mindset that sees challenge as opportunity and is motivated by making things better. What we offer you
• A competitive basic salary
• Annual personal bonus scheme based on company and personal performance
• Private Medical Insurance
• 33 days annual leave.
• Defined pension contributions.
• Access to Medicash helping you cover everyday health costs like dental optical and physiotherapy plus a range of wellbeing perks.
• Confidential support via Employee Assistance Programmes.
• Access to discounts on shopping entertainment lifestyle plus opportunity to apply for Costco membership.
• Discounted personal car leasing for you your family and friends.
• Long Service Awards celebrating your commitment.
• Continuous learning opportunities through Sulzer Learning Pathways.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role This role leads the Field Service & Engineering organization with full responsibility for the planning, execution, and documentation of field jobs, services, and projects. The position ensures delivery in line with defined scope, timelines, and budgets, while maintaining the highest standards of safety, efficiency, and quality. By leading the local center of competence, the role strengthens regional capabilities, reduces reliance on global mobilization, shortens response times, and ultimately enhances customer satisfaction and profitable service delivery. Key Responsibilities
• Lead global field service execution, including outages, overhauls, inspections, troubleshooting, and commissioning
• Own global service performance, covering safety, quality, schedule adherence, cost, margins, and customer satisfaction
• Drive the regionalization of field services by developing local skills, certifications, tools, and standardized execution practices
• Define and implement the regional field service operating model in line with global policies and standards
• Act as the primary customer interface during service execution and support Sales & Tendering with execution concepts, feasibility reviews, and cost inputs
• Lead and develop local and regional Field Service Engineers and Supervisors, fostering a strong safety culture and service mindset
• Plan and optimize regional resources, coordinating cross‑regional support only where specialized expertise or peak capacity is required
• Drive continuous improvement, standardization, and compliance with global EHS and quality requirements, while feeding field learnings back into global organizations Your Profile
• Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or a comparable technical discipline
• 10+ years of experience in field service or service operations within turbomachinery, power generation, or rotating equipment

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Job Summary Overall co-ordination, functional management, and leadership of all the Services Division’s sales activity needs of the Company's customers within Sub-Saharan African Region in order to meet the objectives of the company's overall business plans and strategies. Overall co-ordination, functional management, and leadership of all the Company’s tendering activities. Effective co-ordination with the Flow Division to align sales initiatives with the company’s objectives and ensure sustainable business growth. Main tasks and responsibilities 1. Sales Strategy Development and Execution: a. Develop and implement a comprehensive sales strategy to achieve business goals and revenue targets. b. Coordinate specific objectives of the Sales Strategy with regards to the assigned functional area, liaising with relevant departments of the company. c. Identify new market opportunities, trends, and emerging markets to drive business expansion. d. Set quarterly and annual sales goals, forecasts, and performance metrics. e. Effective client contact, relationship building, and management processes are in place (including acting on feedback from Customer Satisfaction Surveys) to positively influence the client and create a pre-disposition to view Sulzer as the preferred source of supply. f. Application of Sulzer sales and commercial policies, procedures, codes of conduct and best practice guidelines 2. Team Leadership and Management: a. Lead, coach, and mentor the sales team to ensure high performance and continuous development. b. Conduct performance evaluations, set clear KPIs, and provide actionable feedback. c. Collaborate with HR on recruiting, hiring, and onboarding new sales team members. 3. Revenue Growth and Client Relationship Management: a. Drive revenue growth by expanding the client base, maximizing customer retention, and improving client satisfaction. b. Build and nurture strong, long-lasting relationships with key clients, partners, and stakeholders. c. Lead negotiations, secure high-value deals, and manage complex sales cycles. 4. Collaboration and Cross-Functional Alignment: a. Work closely with marketing, product development, and customer service to align sales efforts with overall company objectives. b. Collaborate with the finance team to set accurate sales budgets and forecasts. c. Ensure consistent communication and alignment across the business on sales initiatives. d. Review tenders and manage tendering process with the Head of Tendering. e. Ensure that handover meetings and documentation are effective and result in a smooth transition from pre to post order status. 5. Market and Competitor Analysis: a. Monitor industry trends, competitor activities, and customer feedback to inform sales strategies. b. Conduct market research and analysis to identify new business opportunities and potential growth areas. 6. Reporting and Performance Tracking: a. Develop and present regular sales performance reports to senior management, highlighting key insights, challenges, and successes. b. Use data and analytics to track performance and optimize sales processes and approaches. c. Ensure the sales team leverages CRM systems effectively for pipeline management and tracking. 7. All other duties as relevant to the position. Qualifications/Experience and Knowledge Required
• Bachelor’s degree in business, Engineering or a related field (MBA preferred).
• Proven experience (8+ years) in sales management, with a strong track record of meeting or exceeding targets.
• Experience in rotating equipment industry is preferred.
• Strong background in managing high-performance sales teams.
• Exceptional leadership and team management skills.
• Strong strategic thinking and business acumen.
• Excellent neg

Overall co-ordination, functional management, and leadership of all the Company’s tendering activities. Sales Strategy Development and Execution: a. Develop and implement a comprehensive sales strategy to achieve business goals and revenue targets. b. Coordinate specific objectives of the Sales Strategy with regards to the assigned functional area, liaising with relevant departments of the company. c. Identify new market opportunities, trends, and emerging markets to drive business expansion. d. Set quarterly and annual sales goals, forecasts, and performance metrics. e. Effective client contact, relationship building, and management processes are in place (including acting on feedback from Customer Satisfaction Surveys) to positively influence the client and create a pre-disposition to view Sulzer as the preferred source of supply. f. • Strong strategic thinking and business acumen.

Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role The entry-level Internal Quality Auditor is responsible for the execution of day-to-day quality assurance activities. This includes setting operational objectives, ensuring adherence to quality standards, and resolving routine quality issues. Key Responsibilities:
• Implement and maintain QESH management systems in accordance with ISO 9001, ISO 14001, and ISO 45001.
• Ability and willingness to travel to Service Centers across the US 5-7 times per year.
• Conduct internal audits, inspections, and risk assessments across production areas.
• Lead incident investigations, identify root causes, and track corrective actions.
• Provide training and guidance to employees on QESH policies and safe work practices.
• Monitor and report on QESH KPIs, including non-conformities, near misses, and environmental metrics.
• Ensure compliance with OSHA, EPA, and other relevant regulatory requirements.
• Support continuous improvement initiatives and lean manufacturing efforts
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate QESH into daily operations.
• Maintain documentation and prepare for external audits and customer inspections.
• Ensure compliance with internal and regulatory quality standards.
• Investigate and resolve routine quality issues.
• Support audits and continuous improvement initiatives Requirements:
• Intermediate knowledge of MS Word MS Excel required
• Basic knowledge or MS SharePoint and MS PowerPoint preferred
• 1+ years of experience in Internal Quality Audits preferred but not required
• Knowledge of quality assurance practices and tools.
• Strong attention to detail and analytical thinking.
• Effective communication and documentation abilities.
• Familiarity with manufacturing environments.
• Experience in ISO 9001, ISO 14001, and ISO 45001 environments preferred What we offer you
• 12 Paid Holidays
• 15 Paid Time off (PTO) Days
• Medical, dental, vision, life, and disability
• 401k with 6% company match
• Employee Assistance Program
• Employee Wellness Program
• Bonus Programs. Based on company performance and individual performance.
• New onsite cafeteria, all meals subsidized (La Porte Service Center) Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. • Assicurare la pianificazione della domanda di personale sostenibile in stretto coordinamento con le aree specializzate nel quadro della strategia aziendale
• Accompagnamento del reclutamento mirato di specialisti e dirigenti incl. Supporto del processo di onboarding
• una stretta cooperazione con i dirigenti per quanto riguarda una vasta gamma di leggi sul lavoro e questioni di contrattazione collettiva e argomenti nel lavoro quotidiano
• consulenza e gestione dei dipendenti in tutte le questioni personali
• Sostenere i dirigenti nella gestione delle prestazioni
• Monitoraggio professionale dei processi di separazione e di fuoribordo
• Totale implementazione / partecipazione a progetti di personale locale / globale
• Cooperazione attiva nell'ulteriore sviluppo e ottimizzazione dei processi personali

• La forza di comunicazione nell'ambiente locale e globale (per questo sono necessarie competenze in tedesco e inglese)
• Iniziativa individuale e orientamento obiettivo nel ruolo delle persone di contatto indipendenti nel campo della cura
• Molto ben fondato HR-relevant know-how (legge sul lavoro, imposta / diritto SV), idealmente dall'ambiente industriale / servizio
• Competenze IT professionali (MS office, sistemi HR) e affinità IT
• Conoscenza speciale (ad esempio altre lingue straniere, conoscenza degli accordi metallici, Workday, SAP) sono un plus
• la volontà di viaggiare ai servizi (creazione ancora da definire - a seconda dell'area di cura) Cosa ti offriamo A Sulzer, si diventa parte di un team HR dedicato e motivato, che ha diverse sedi di produzione e servizio in tutta la Germania con un totale di circa 780 dipendenti. About the role Support in this varied task You are the contact persons of your support area in achieving our strategic and operational goals through professional HR-side support along the complete employee life cycle. Sulzer est une entreprise d'ingénierie de premier plan avec un fier héritage d'innovation. Rejoignez notre équipe mondiale pour développer votre expertise et développer des solutions innovantes qui permettent une société prospère et plus durable. A propos du rôle Soutien dans cette tâche variée Vous êtes les personnes-ressources de votre secteur de soutien pour atteindre nos objectifs stratégiques et opérationnels grâce au soutien professionnel côté RH tout au long du cycle de vie des employés. Dans le travail quotidien, cela comprend:
• Assurer une planification durable de la demande de personnel en étroite coordination avec les domaines spécialisés dans le cadre de la stratégie d'entreprise
• Soutenir le recrutement ciblé de spécialistes et de gestionnaires y compris. Soutien au processus d'embarquement
• coopération étroite avec les cadres en ce qui concerne un large éventail de questions et de thèmes liés au droit du travail et à la négociation collective dans le travail de tous les jours
• conseil et maintien des employés dans toutes les questions relatives au personnel
• soutien aux gestionnaires dans le domaine de la gestion des performances
• accompagnement professionnel des processus de séparation et de hors-bord
• Ggf. Mise en œuvre/participation à des projets de personnel locaux/mondiaux
• Coopération active dans le développement et l'optimisation des processus personnels
• Coopération productive et professionnelle avec d'autres parties prenantes internes et externes (y compris les comités d'entreprise, les syndicats, les demandeurs, la communauté des RH et les prestataires de services externes) Pour réussir à ce stade, vous devez apporter les éléments suivants:
• Curiosité, ouverture et empathie pour l'établissement rapide de contacts personnels et de réseaux professionnels
• Force de communication dans l'environnement local et mondial (les compétences linguistiques en allemand et en anglais sont nécessaires pour cela)
• L'initiative propre et l'orientation cible dans le rôle de personne de contact indépendante dans le domaine des soins
• Savoir-faire très bien fondé en matière de ressources humaines (droit du travail, droit fiscal / droit SV), idéalement de l'environnement industriel / service
• Compétences en TI professionnelles (bureau SM, systèmes RH), ainsi que l'affinité informatique
• Connaissances spéciales (par exemple, autres langues étrangères, connaissance des conventions collectives métallifères, jour de travail, SAP) sont un plus
• volonté de voyager (création à définir) Il fait partie d'une équipe de RH dévouée et motivée, qui soutient plusieurs sites de production et de services à travers l'Allemagne avec un total d'environ 780 employés. Dans cette tâche, vous pouvez profiter d'un haut degré d'espace de conception et de conditions-cadres attrayantes. Avez-vous des questions sur ce travail ? Contactez Nina Rufer (nina.rufer@sulzer.com). Nous sommes heureux de vous entendre ! Sulzer est un employeur à chances égales. Nous croyons en la force d'un effectif diversifié et sommes déterminés à offrir un milieu de travail inclusif. Nous sommes fiers d'être reconnus comme l'un des meilleurs employeurs 2026 au Brésil, au Canada, en Chine, en Finlande, en Allemagne, en Irlande, au Mexique, en Suisse, en Afrique du Sud, au Royaume-Uni et aux États-Unis.

About the role Job Summary The Admin Coordinator is responsible for independently handling administrative tasks and coordinating support activities. This role works autonomously and may guide other professional-level staff, especially in non-routine situations. This job profile is intended for professional-level staff that works autonomously and may coordinate the activities of other professional-level staff, especially in non-routine situations. PASADENA, TEXAS, USA Summary: The Estimating Coordinator provides essential support in the valuation and processing of incoming projects. Key responsibilities include maintaining data integrity within Microsoft Dynamics and facilitating clear communication between the company and its clients during the initial job intake phase. ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS: o Develop detailed repair estimates including labor, parts, and materials using internal systems and vendor quotes o Collaborate with service technicians, ASM’s and engineers to determine scope of work and timelines o Communicate clearly with clients regarding repair options, costs, and schedules o Coordinate with procurement and vendors to source parts and materials o Work with NPS group as needed to provide replacement options to our customers o Maintain accurate records of estimates, work orders, and customer communications o Ensure compliance with safety standards and industry regulations o Support preventative maintenance planning and rebuild programs o Assist in identifying cost-saving opportunities and process improvements Qualifications: · 2+ years of experience in estimating or service coordination within oil & gas or heavy industrial equipment preferred · Strong mechanical aptitude and understanding of oilfield machinery and systems preferred · Proficiency in estimating software and Microsoft Office Suite · Excellent communication and customer service skills · High attention to detail and ability to manage multiple projects · Familiarity with OSHA and industry safety standards · Technical certifications or vocational training in mechanical or industrial repair is a plus WORK ENVIRONMENT & PHYSICAL DEMANDS:
• While performing duties of this job, would occasionally be required to stand, walk, sit, reach with hands and arms, climb or balance, stoop or kneel, talk and hear, and use fingers and hands to feel objects.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Lean Manager is responsible for supporting the development and optimization of manufacturing processes. This role applies practical engineering knowledge to improve efficiency, quality, and safety in production environments.
This job profile is intended for experienced professionals who apply practical knowledge of a job area and work independently with general supervision.
• At factory level, use lean manufacturing principles to achieve operational business targets.

• Assist supervisor and managers with action plan to achieve company objectives.

• Support manufacturing improvements through tooling and equipment design and equipment specification development.

• Improve On Time Delivery and Lead Times though the implementation of continuous flow, layout optimization, pull-system and speed up flows by coaching and/or leading lean principles workshops.

• Contribute to Factory Improvement Plan.

• Review continuous improvement plans and cost-saving projections, challenging where necessary, and provide feedback that drives additional improvements.

• Support continuous failure analysis in cooperation with affected areas.

• Improve Root Cause Analysis knowledge and utilization within the organization.

• Prepare and submit performance reports as required.

• Support corporate initiatives as defined by the Management Team.

• All employees are required to comply with all work instructions, policies, and posted signs or instructions regarding safety, including but not limited to proper use of Personal Protective Equipment.

What we offer you

• Competitive Paid Time Off

• 12 Company Paid Holidays per year

• Annual Bonus Program

• Full Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits

• Company Paid Short Term and Long Term Disability, Company Paid Life Insurance

• 6% 401K or Roth Company Match with Immediate Vesting

• Company Paid Retirement Security Contributions following 1 year of employment

• Tuition Reimbursement/Educational Assistance

• Quarterly Gym Reimbursement

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Nous recherchons un/une Technicien(ne) Stand d’Essai pour rejoindre notre équipe. Vos principales tâches et responsabilités : 1. Procéder au montage des équipements mécaniques conformément aux plans établis et aux procédures applicables au sein de la plateforme d’essai. 2. Installer l’instrumentation nécessaire pour les essais. 3. Raccorder les circuits de puissance électrique simple. 4. S’assurer de la disponibilité du banc d’essai entre chaque essai. 5. Procéder au 1er niveau de maintenance des équipements du stand. 6. Travaux ponctuels à réaliser en espace confiné (Fosses, Ballons) 7. Travaux en hauteur occasionnels 8. Conduite de chariot élévateur et pontier/élingueur (CACES 3,4,5) 9. Travaux par point chaud (frettage/défrettage) 10. Manipulation de produits chimique (N1) Pour réussir dans ce poste, vous aurez besoin : Le technicien doit pouvoir travailler en autonomie avec des tierces personnes affectées de façon occasionnel au stand d’essais. Le technicien doit être force de proposition afin de garantir la qualité des essais Afin de garantir une présence pendant les essais, il est demandé au technicien d’essai une flexibilité sur les horaires de travail dans le respect du cadre législatif hebdomadaire. Compétences métier – technique
• Compétences en Machines tournantes (Pompes, Turbines, compresseurs) : pratique opérationnelle sur site (après une expérience en maintenance, mise en service, réparation)
• Compétences métrologie (utilisation des instruments de mesure)
• Compétences financières opérationnelles (suivi des budgets, respect des temps « gammes », commandes du matériel)
• Connaissances des règles HSE applicables au sein d’un atelier
• Expérience de travail dans SAP : réalisation des fiches de non-conformité, recherche d’informations pour l’ordonnancement de la charge, montage pompe, turbine, compresseur & moteur, validation factures, demandes d’achats)
• Anglais de base
• Connaissances Word, excel (niveau de base) Compétences spécifiques au nucléaire
• Culture sûreté Vous serez basé en Ile de France, dans les Yvelines, à Buchelay. Vous avez une question concernant ce poste ? Contactez Rick IMALET POGO (rick.imaletpogo@sulzer.com) et nous serons heureux de vous répondre! What we offer you
• Avantage 1 : Evoluer sur des projets dimensionnants et stratégiques pour le Groupe
• Avantage 2 : Buchelay : référence nucléaire au sein du Groupe SULZER
• Avantage 3 : Avantages d'une "PME" au sein d'un grand Groupe
• Avantage 4 : Accès au Comité Social et Economique (CSE)
• Avantage 5 : Carte Ticket restaurant - Mutuelle Avantageuse - Prime d'intéressement & Participation – RTT
• Et bien d'autres... Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

Manipulation de produits chimique (N1) Pour réussir dans ce poste, vous aurez besoin : Le technicien doit pouvoir travailler en autonomie avec des tierces personnes affectées de façon occasionnel au stand d’essais. • Compétences en Machines tournantes (Pompes, Turbines, compresseurs) : pratique opérationnelle sur site (après une expérience en maintenance, mise en service, réparation)
• Compétences métrologie (utilisation des instruments de mesure)
• Compétences financières opérationnelles (suivi des budgets, respect des temps « gammes », commandes du matériel)
• Connaissances des règles HSE applicables au sein d’un atelier
• Expérience de travail dans SAP : réalisation des fiches de non-conformité, recherche d’informations pour l’ordonnancement de la charge, montage pompe, turbine, compresseur & moteur, validation factures, demandes d’achats)

Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role This a Temporary 6 Months contract The Talent Acquisition specialist is responsible for supporting recruitment processes, including candidate sourcing, screening, and coordination. This role ensures a smooth hiring experience and contributes to the organization’s talent acquisition goals. Key Responsibilities
• Manage requisitions and candidate pipelines in Workday Create and maintain job requisitions in Workday, ensuring accuracy of job details, approvals, and status updates while actively managing candidates through each stage of the hiring workflow.
• Screen and assess candidates Review applications, conduct initial screenings, and evaluate candidates against role requirements, ensuring a consistent and high-quality shortlisting process.
• Coordinate interviews via Workday Schedule and manage interviews using Workday tools, partnering with hiring managers and ensuring a seamless and professional candidate experience.
• Maintain data accuracy and system integrity Ensure all candidate and requisition data in Workday is up to date, complete, and compliant with internal standards and audit requirements.
• Support recruitment reporting and analytics Generate and analyze recruitment reports (e.g., time-to-fill, pipeline health, source effectiveness) to support data-driven hiring decisions.
• Ensure compliance with policies and local regulations Follow standardized recruitment processes, maintain proper documentation, and ensure adherence to internal policies and applicable labor laws.
• Drive sourcing and talent pipeline initiatives Support proactive sourcing strategies using internal tools and external platforms, while maintaining candidate pipelines within Workday.
• Contribute to employer branding initiatives Support job posting optimization, candidate communications, and employer branding efforts to enhance the organization’s attraction strategy. Skills & Qualifications A Bachelors degree in Human resources or similar (or equivalent work experience) and at least 3–6 years of relevant experience recruiting in a similar industry (or equivalent skills) are minimally required to carry out the role. Demonstrated experience recruiting in in the Middle East, Caspian and North Africa regions. Technical hiring understanding Energy market knowledge Good understanding of recruitment processes. A project management mindset Strong organizational and communication skills. Familiarity with ATS platforms and sourcing tools. Be available for Full 6 months.
