Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Job Summary The Group IT Engineering Specialist is responsible for developing and maintaining software and cloud-based applications, ensuring performance, security, and scalability. This role supports project delivery and contributes to technical innovation. This job profile is intended for specialist professionals that apply advanced knowledge of a job area. Required to manage projects / processes independently with limited supervision. Typically coaches and reviews the work of lower level professionals. Purpose of the Job (summarized) To ensure the continued development and support of Application Integration portfolio within the business organisation. Ensuring that the business is kept at an efficient, functioning state regarding its integrated applications applications / processes. We need Integration Developer in our Sales Tools team, reporting to the AGM Sales Tools, Global Delivery Center within the Global IT Team. We are looking for a self-driven. Integration Developer Your job General Tasks:
• Develop and maintain Application Integration solutions (real-time / batch)
• Supporting and maintaining integration solutions and related components e.g. databases, queues
• Designing and modelling of databases, tables, stored procedures according to solution requirement
• Create / configure / fine tune / monitoring queues (MSMQ, Azure Service Bus queue, ActiveMQ)
• Scheduling and deployment
• Coordinate with different teams for fixing integration issues / new implementations
• Talend monitoring
• Monitoring, fixing non-working and broken jobs
• Monitoring the health of Talend remote engine / run-time servers. Give suggestions accordingly.
• Talend infrastructure; keeping Talend infrastructure up to date according to predefined schedule
• Patching, upgrades, deployment, etc.
• Debugging and optimizing implementations Technical:
• Experience with (a) modern integration platform(s).
• Should be well-versed with SQL (database designing, create tables, stored procedures)
• Hands-on experience with creating / configuring / maintaining ActiveMQ / MSMQ / Azure Service Bus queue
• Developing APIs / web services in Talend
• Knowledge on FTP / SFTP / APIs / WEB services
• Sound knowledge of JSON / XML
• Knowledge of java scripts
• Experience on integration with SAP / Salesforce / MS Dynamics CRM
• Experience with Talend Cloud Real-Time Big Data Platform
• Nice to have – Talend certification; experience with Talend infrastructure, e.g. installation/upgrade of remote engines / runtimes will be an added advantage Experience required in/with:
• Essential – willingness to expand their knowledge of the above
• A globally acting company and working in international project teams
• ~ 10 years overall experience in similar role out of which ~ 6-7 years in Talend
• Integration around Salesforce and SAP
• Salesforce platform events
• Talend data mapper Education/Qualification: o Any graduate with the above-mentioned professional experience We offer In an international environment, you will take over global responsibilities. You will work in an international team and in different cultures. This position enables to further personal development. If you can identify yourself with this challenge, then we would like to get to know you! descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role ​Company Overview: Sulzer Services is an independent provider of services and equipment repairs for the Rotating Equipment industry. Sulzer Services specializes in the repairs and overhaul of gas turbines, steam turbines, compressors, pumps and electromechanical equipment for the Oil & Gas, Petrochemical, and Power Generation industries. Position Overview: We are seeking a dynamic and detail-oriented Early Career Programs Specialist to develop and execute our internship and new-hire rotational programs. This role will also provide support to the Training Program Manager with strategic initiatives. Additional responsibilities include internal communications such as newsletters, program updates, department calendars, e-learning content creation, and designing promotional content for training programs. The ideal candidate will have 3–5 years of experience in designing, implementing, and evaluating developmental programs that provide emerging talent with meaningful learning experiences. This role requires a blend of project management, instructional design, and stakeholder collaboration to ensure program success and alignment with organizational goals. Your main tasks and responsibilities:
• Develop and execute comprehensive new hire rotational programs that align with organizational objectives and provide participants with structured learning experiences.
• Internship program: establish program and enhance for growth throughout the region and product lines.
• Work closely with department managers and HR to define program goals, identify skill gaps, and ensure alignment with business needs.
• Lead the recruitment process, including sourcing candidates, conducting interviews, and facilitating onboarding to integrate interns and new hire rotational employees effectively.
• Manage all logistical aspects of the programs, including scheduling, venue arrangements, coordinating with volunteers, and resource allocation.
• Monitor and assess program effectiveness through feedback, performance metrics, and evaluations to ensure continuous improvement.
• Assist the Training Program Manager in developing and implementing training strategies that align with organizational goals including but not limited to developing e-learning content, maintaining training calendars, and developing procedures.
• Maintain the Learning Management System (LMS), ensuring accurate entry and upkeep of training records, course schedules, and participant data. To succeed in this role, you will need:
• Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Education, Business Administration, or a related field.
• Proven experience as a Program Coordinator or similar role, with a track record of coordinating comprehensive internship and rotational programs in a corporate environment.
• 3–5 years of experience in training and development, program coordinator, or a similar role.
• Strong project coordination skills with the ability to manage timelines, logistics, and multiple stakeholders.
• High attention to detail and strong organizational skills.
• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
• Ability to work collaboratively with cross‑functional teams, managers, and external partners.
• Proficiency with Learning Management Systems (LMS) and e-learning platforms.
• Ability to analyze data and assess the effectiveness of training programs.
• Familiarity with instructional design theory and adult learning principles.
• Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and meet deadlines in a dynamic, fast-paced environment. What we offer you
• 15 days of paid time off and 12 company-paid holidays
• 401k plan with a 6% match
• Comprehensive health plan including medical, dental, vision, Life, short-term & long-term disability
• Mot

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Job Summary The Tax Jr. Analyst is responsible for assisting with basic tax-related tasks, including data entry, document preparation, and administrative support. This role works under close supervision and follows established procedures. This job profile is intended for early-career professionals who apply broad theoretical knowledge and require the ability to investigate and analyse problems. Solutions are typically discussed/verified with a more senior member. Key Responsibilities Indirect Tax Compliance
• Prepare, analyze, and file indirect tax returns (U.S. Sales & Use Tax, Canada GST/HST, and VAT in South America), ensuring accuracy and regulatory compliance.
• Use automation tools such as Vertex Returns and Avalara, reconciling information against accounting records (SAP/Dynamics), accounts receivable, and accounts payable.
• Set up and maintain new tax jurisdictions as needed, including system configuration/parameterization.
• Manage the electronic filing of returns and payments, as well as manual preparation when automation is unavailable.
• Prepare property tax renditions and coordinate payment requests.
• Manage annual tax license renewals, ensuring timely compliance. Stakeholder Management
• Address internal and external inquiries related to indirect taxes (tax rate determination, taxability criteria, etc.).
• Support audit processes by compiling, validating, and providing required information.
• Maintain, analyze, and cleanse customer records, tax reports, and supporting documentation (exemption/resale certificates, export evidence, among others).
• Collaborate with finance, legal, and operations teams to ensure tax compliance and process improvements. Profile Requirements
• Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
• 3+ years of experience in Mexican VAT (knowledge of U.S., Canada, and/or South America is a plus).
• Experience with tax automation tools (Vertex and Avalara highly preferred).
• Knowledge of ERP systems such as SAP and/or Dynamics.
• Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel (pivot tables, reconciliations, data analysis).
• Intermediate to advanced English level (B1/B2+) for professional communication.
• Strong analytical, organizational, and attention-to-detail skills.
• Good communication and teamwork abilities. What we offer you
• Benefits Over law
• Saving found
• Training
• Christmas bonus over low
• Development plan Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role At Sulzer, we specialise in delivering top-tier service to our customers across the oil & gas, power generation, and renewable sectors. With our recent £1 million investment, our Ellon facility is now a Centre of Excellence, providing cutting-edge support for electric motors, pumps, gearboxes, and turbo-compressors. We are looking for a skilled Gas Compressor Technician to join our team. As a Gas Compressor Technician, you will be working directly on the repair, overhaul, and maintenance of gas compressors. You will play a key role in ensuring that our customers' equipment is serviced to the highest standards, meeting industry specifications and maintaining operational efficiency Your Main Tasks and Responsibilities:
• Disassembling, inspecting, and rebuilding gas compressors and their components
• Diagnosing and repairing mechanical faults in a variety of compressor types
• Precision fitting, machining, and assembly work as required
• Performing dynamic and functional testing on overhauled equipment
• Collaborating with engineering and quality teams to ensure compliance with technical specifications
• Maintaining a clean and safe working environment in line with HSE requirements To succeed in this role, you will need:
• Experience in the overhaul and maintenance of gas compressors or similar rotating equipment
• Proficiency in mechanical fitting, assembly, and fault diagnosis
• Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality
• Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings and technical manuals
• Good communication skills and a proactive attitude to teamwork
• Awareness of Health, Safety, and Environmental regulations What we offer you
• Competitive basic salary.
• 33 days of annual leave.
• Defined pension contribution.
• Confidential support and guidance through our Employee Assistance Programmes.
• Access to a wide range of discounts on everyday shopping, entertainment, and lifestyle.
• Discounted Personal Car Leasing - available for you, your family, and friends.
• Long Service Awards to celebrate your dedication.
• Ongoing learning and development through Sulzer Learning Pathways.
• Free and secure onsite parking, with electric charging facilities.
• We're proud to support those who've served. Sulzer is a Bronze Award holder under the MoDs Defence Employer Recognition Scheme meaning we actively welcome and support ex-military personnel and reservists in building successful careers with us. Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Job Summary The workplace of this role is Xin Jiang, China. The role is responsible for supervising a team of technical professionals in delivering field service engineering support to customers, and responsible for the sales plans and budgets for the assigned area. This role ensures the effective execution of service operations, resolves complex technical issues, and maintains high levels of customer satisfaction. The manager plays a key role in setting team goals, managing performance, and ensuring compliance with service standards. Job Responsibilities
• Oversee the commissioning, installation, and testing of products and equipment at customer sites.
• Organize tenders/quotations and commercial negotiations; drive contract signing and order acquisition.
• Resolve technical issues and ensure timely and effective service delivery.
• Collaborate with internal teams to support product upgrades and customer training.
• Monitor service metrics and implement improvements to enhance efficiency and customer satisfaction.
• Manage service documentation, reporting, and administrative tasks.
• Ensure compliance with safety, quality, and regulatory standards. Qualifications
• Typically a University degree and 8+ years of relevant work experience.
• Bachelor's degree or higher in Mechanical Engineering or a related subject.
• Sound knowledge of rotating equipment such as pumps, turbines, compressors and motor etc.
• Experience in field service engineering or technical service management.
• Strong leadership and team supervision skills.
• Excellent problem-solving and decision-making abilities.
• Strong customer service orientation and communication skills.
• Knowledge of industry standards and safety regulations. What we offer you
• 11 days' public holidays and maximum 15 days' annual leave.
• Supplementary Commercial Insurance.
• Annual Physical Examination.
• Festival & Birthday Gifts.
• Long service awards. Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Job Summary The Controller is responsible for supporting the financial integrity of the organization through accurate reporting, compliance, and internal controls. This role involves preparing financial statements, assisting with audits, and ensuring adherence to accounting standards and policies. This job profile is intended for experienced professionals who apply practical knowledge of a job area and work independently with general supervision. Key Responsibilities
• Support the preparation and consolidation of the annual budget, providing accurate data and analysis
• Assist in refreshing predictive financial forecasts periodically, ensuring accuracy and relevance
• Help in conducting profitability and performance reporting, providing essential data for decision-making
• Contribute to plan analytics and risk management, assisting in the continuous improvement of financial planning and analysis processes
• Conduct in-depth financial analysis to support business recommendations, under the guidance of senior team members
• Support collections reporting and analytics, ensuring accurate and timely information is available for decision-making
• Provide comprehensive reporting and analytics on procurement activities, aiding informed purchasing decisions
• Help oversee period end close processes, generating accurate and insightful financial reports and analytics
• Assist in period end closing and related analytics, ensuring thorough financial tracking and reporting for projects
• Help oversee CAPEX planning, forecasting, investment strategy, period-end close activities, and reporting
• Support the adherence to International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) in all financial reporting and processes.
• Ensure internal controls are in place for the processes performed by this role
• Comply with relevant QESH regulations Education and experience
• University degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration or related field
• Minimum of 3-5 years of experience in financial planning and analysis or related finance roles
• Experience within the manufacturing or industrial sectors is a plus Critical success factors
• Proficiency in financial modelling and forecasting, advanced skills in data analytics and financial software
• Strong understanding of global financial processes and standards
• Strong financial acumen
• Excellent communication skills for delivering key insights to leadership
• Excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to work collaboratively with other stakeholders Technical & language skills
• Experience with Tagetik and Qlik Sense is a plus
• Understanding of integrated ERP systems is a plus
• Strong MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint) skills
• Proficiency in English What we offer you Medical insurance for self and family Company sponsored transportation facility during week days Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Als Teil der Business Unit Water & Industrial der Sulzer AG vertreibt die Sulzer Flow Germany GmbH Produkte und Lösungen zur mechanischen und biologischen Reinigung von kommunalem und industriellen Abwasser. Als Service-Techniker sind Sie unser Gesicht zum Kunden. Auf Tages-Montagen untersuchen und lösen Sie auftretende Probleme in Kundenanlagen. Sie werden eingesetzt im Rahmen von Neumontagen, Inbetriebnahmen, Umbaumaßnahmen, Revisionen, Wartungen, Befundungen und Reparaturen von Pumpen, Hebeanlagen und Steuerungen. In dieser Stelle sind Sie verantwortlich für:
• Prüfung, Wartung & Reparatur von Pumpen, Hebeanlagen und Steuerungen am Einbauort
• Neuinstallation von Pumpstationen, Hebeanlagen und Schaltanlagen am Einbauort
• Störungsanalysen
• Beratung unserer Kunden bei technischen Fragestellungen Um in dieser Stelle erfolgreich zu sein, sollten Sie Folgendes mitbringen:
• Abgeschlossene technische Berufsausbildung als Mechatroniker/in (oder Elektroniker/in / Industriemechaniker/in oder vergleichbar)
• Idealerweise Elektrofachkraft für festgelegte Tätigkeiten (wird sonst als Weiterbildung durch uns durchgeführt)
• Erste Berufserfahrung als Servicetechniker/in von Vorteil
• Grundkenntnisse in Word und Excel
• Führerschein Klasse B
• Reisebereitschaft (ca. 80% Tagesreisen) What we offer you Bei Sulzer werden Sie Teil eines renommierten Teams. Wir bieten Ihnen ein hohes Maß an Eigenverantwortung, sowie ausgezeichnete Zukunftsperspektiven.
• Zukunftssichere Position in einem modernen und wachsenden Unternehmen
• Unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag
• Leistungsgerechte Vergütung, inkl. Urlaubs- und Weihnachtsgeld
• 30 Tage Urlaub
• Intensive Einarbeitung und Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten
• Einsatzmöglichkeit vom Wohnort
• Top ausgestattete Service-Vans mit modernem Werkzeug Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Proporcionar diagnóstico, asistencia técnica, entrenamiento y servicios de mantenimiento para bombas y equipos relacionados en las instalaciones del cliente. El candidato puede estar basado en Lima o Arequipa. Funciones básicas
• Realizar la instalación, puesta en marcha y arranque de bombas y equipos asociados en las instalaciones del cliente.
• Realizar el mantenimiento preventivo y las inspecciones de las bombas para garantizar un desempeño y una fiabilidad óptimos.
• Diagnosticar y solucionar problemas mecánicos, eléctricos y del sistema de control con bombas y componentes relacionados.
• Utilizar documentación técnica, esquemas y herramientas de diagnóstico para identificar y resolver problemas de forma eficaz.
• Coordinarse con los clientes para programar visitas de servicio, comunicar actualizaciones de proyectos y abordar cualquier duda o pregunta.
• Proporcionar formación y asistencia in situ a los clientes sobre el funcionamiento correcto y los procedimientos de mantenimiento de las bombas.
• Colaborar con los equipos internos para escalar y resolver problemas técnicos complejos según sea necesario.
• Documentar las actividades de servicio, incluidas las tareas de mantenimiento, el uso de piezas y las interacciones con los clientes, de forma clara y organizada.

title: Area Sales Manager (m/w/d) / Technischer Vertrieb - Verkaufsgebiet Süd

titleByLocale.en: Area Sales Manager (m/w/d) / Technischer Vertrieb - Verkaufsgebiet Süd

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Bei Sulzer unterstützen wir Ihre kontinuierliche Entwicklung nicht nur durch Lernprogramme, sondern auch durch Weiterentwicklungsmöglichkeiten am Arbeitsplatz. Treiben Sie Ihre Karriere proaktiv voran und entwickeln Sie Ihr Know-how weiter – so können Sie zu Lösungen beitragen, die unsere Leben sicherer, intelligenter und nachhaltiger gestalten. Sie suchen einen neuen Wirkungsbereich bei einem renomierten Unternehmen und sind bereit die berühmte Extrameile freiwillig mit Rückenwind zu gehen? Dann sind Sie bei uns im Team genau richtig: Als Area Sales Manager (m/w/d) betreuen Sie eigenverantwortlich Ihren bestehenden Kundenstamm im Bereich der Baustellenentwässerung und bauen diesen durch gezielte Vertriebsmaßnahmen weiter aus. Dabei werden Sie unterstützt durch unser Sulzer-internes Netzwerk, sowie durch unsere internen technischen Fachstellen. Ihre Hauptaufgaben und Verantwortlichkeiten: In dieser herausfordernden Aufgabe verantworten Sie in den PLZ Gebieten 35000 -36999, 50000 bis 57999, 6 – 9 den Verkauf von Sulzer-Produkten aus dem Bereich der Baustellenentwässerung. Dies beinhaltet unter anderem:
• Beratung von Kunden und Interessenten im Verkaufsgebiet PLZ 35000 -36999, 50000 bis 57999, 6 – 9
• Erweiterung von Vertriebspartnerstruktur
• Betreuung der Bestandskunden und Akquise von Neukunden
• Persönliche technische Beratung und Betreuung großer Baustellen
• Prüfung von Kundenanforderungen auf technische Machbarkeit und die Entwicklung passender Lösungskonzepte
• Projektverfolgung, Auftragsverhandlung, Auftragsklärung
• Mitwirkung bei der Erstellung und Durchführung technischer Präsentationen und die Teilnahme an Verkaufsverhandlungen
• Unterstützung bei der Beobachtung und Analyse der Markt- und Wettbewerbssituation
• Mitwirkung bei der Planung und Umsetzung der kurz- und mittelfristigen Absatzziele
• Reklamationsbearbeitung in Zusammenarbeit mit Kundendienst
• Teilnahme an Messen, Tagungen und sonstigen dienstlichen Veranstaltungen
• Unterstützung bei Marketing- und Verkaufsfördermaßnahmen
• Ausbau und Stärkung der Marktposition und nicht zuletzt deutliche Steigerung der Umsätze
• Durchführung von Kundenschulungen Ihr Profil:
• Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Außendienst, idealerweise im technischen Vertriebsumfeld
• Fundierte Kenntnisse im Bereich Pumpentechnik und Zubehör sowie idealerweise im Tief- und Spezialtiefbau
• Abgeschlossene technische oder kaufmännische Ausbildung
• Ausgeprägtes Verhandlungsgeschick, Durchsetzungsstärke sowie eine hohe Kunden- und Vertriebsorientierung
• Strukturierte und eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise
• Souveränes Auftreten sowie ausgezeichnete kommunikative Fähigkeiten
• Wohnsitz im Vertriebsgebiet sowie idealerweise bestehende Kundenkontakte in der Region
• Uneingeschränkte Reisebereitschaft innerhalb des Verkaufsgebiets, einschließlich gelegentlicher Übernachtungen
• Analytisches Denkvermögen, hohe Problemlösungskompetenz und Belastbarkeit auch in anspruchsvollen Situationen
• Erfahrung mit CRM, idealerweise mit SalesForce
• Gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift
• Gültiger Führerschein der Klasse B What we offer you Bei Sulzer werden Sie Teil eines renommierten Teams. Wir bieten Ihnen eine anspruchsvolle, eigenständige Aufgabe in einem fordernden und fördernden Umfeld. Wir bieten Ihnen ein hohes Maß an Eigenverantwortung, eine adäquate Vergütung sowie gute Zukunftsperspektiven. Firmenfahrzeug (auch zur privaten Nutzung) und moderne Kommunikationsmittel werden zur Verfügung gestellt. Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Irel

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Als Field Service Techniker (m/w/d) sind Sie ein zentraler Ansprechpartner für unsere Kunden im Außendienst und sorgen für einen zuverlässigen Betrieb unserer Anlagen zur Wasser- und Abwasseraufbereitung. Sie übernehmen eigenverantwortlich Serviceeinsätze, Wartungen und Inbetriebnahmen direkt vor Ort und tragen maßgeblich zur hohen Servicequalität unseres Unternehmens bei. Freuen Sie sich auf eine abwechslungsreiche Tätigkeit mit viel technischer Verantwortung, direktem Kundenkontakt und modern ausgestatteten Arbeitsmitteln. Ihre Aufgaben
• Sicherstellung eines reibungslosen, kostenbewussten und kundenorientierten Serviceablaufs
• Durchführung von Serviceeinsätzen an Anlagen zur Aufbereitung von Wasser und Abwasser
• Austausch von Ersatz- und Verschleißteilen sowie Durchführung von Reparaturen, Sanierungen und Wartungsarbeiten direkt beim Kunden vor Ort
• Analyse und Behebung technischer Störungen
• Durchführung von Werkstatt- und Montagearbeiten
• Auf- und Abbau sowie Inbetriebnahme unserer Versuchsanlagen
• Erstellung von Analyseberichten sowie ausführlichen technischen Basisberichten
• Betreuung unserer Kunden inklusive Durchführung von Kundenschulungen Ihr Profil
• Abgeschlossene technische Ausbildung, z. B. im Maschinenbau, in der Instandhaltung, Wassertechnik oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation
• Kenntnisse im E- und WIG-Schweißen von Vorteil
• Führerschein der Klasse B (ehemals Klasse 3)
• Hohe Reisebereitschaft im Rahmen der Außendiensttätigkeit
• Eigenverantwortliche, strukturierte und kostenbewusste Arbeitsweise
• Teamfähigkeit, Selbstständigkeit sowie Flexibilität
• Ausgeprägte Kommunikations- und Argumentationsstärke
• Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift, Englischkenntnisse wünschenswert
• Grundkenntnisse in MS Word und Excel sowie Erfahrung im Umgang mit Salesforce von Vorteil What we offer you
• Eine sichere Position in einem modernen und zukunftsorientierten Unternehmen
• Ein angenehmes und kollegiales Betriebsklima
• Eine intensive Einarbeitung sowie regelmäßige Schulungen
• Hohe Eigenverantwortung und abwechslungsreiche Aufgaben
• Attraktive Sozialleistungen, z. B. betriebliche Altersvorsorge und Direktversicherungen
• Firmenfahrzeug (Werkstattwagen), Firmenhandy und Firmennotebook
• Einsatzmöglichkeit direkt vom Wohnort aus

We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Job Summary The Sr. (Field) Service Engineering Lead is responsible for installing, configuring, calibrating, and repairing technical products and systems at customer locations. The role includes diagnosing malfunctions, performing maintenance, and providing on-site training to customer personnel. This job profile is intended for experienced professionals who apply practical knowledge of a job area and work independently with general supervision. Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. The Service Engineer & Field Auditor is responsible for delivering on-site technical expertise, auditing customer installations, and ensuring an outstanding customer experience throughout the project lifecycle. By combining deep technical knowledge with a proactive and consultative approach, this role supports Sulzer’s commitment to reliability, performance, and customer satisfaction. Main tasks and responsibilities : Provide on-site technical support for commissioning, troubleshooting, failure analysis, and training in the operation and maintenance of Sulzer equipment. Audit customer installations and propose tailored solutions that optimize production, reliability, and efficiency. Translate customer needs into concrete recommendations (e.g., equipment upgrades, spare parts strategies, maintenance optimization, or process improvements). Ensure an optimal customer journey, from pre-sales to final delivery, with proactive, transparent, and passionate engagement at every stage. Proactively engage with customers, anticipate needs, and identify opportunities for value creation. Comply with Sulzer’s quality policies, safety standards, and environmental regulations on both company premises and customer sites. Contribute to the continuous improvement of the company’s processes, services, and team environment. Participate in and actively support company initiatives Initially, to adhere to Sulzer policies: Code of Business Conduct, Authority and Approval Procedures, Risk Management, Travel policies, etc… HSE Responsibilities :
• Ensure compliance with safety instructions, use of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE).
• Proactive intervention in the event of a dangerous situation.
• Propose improvements in terms of safety. Competencies and behavior required (What strengths needed?) Management Competencies: Results driven, Proactive, reliable, and capable of working independently as well as in cross-functional teams. Leadership Competencies: Exceeding customer expectations, Ensuring accountability and integrity, Customer-oriented mindset with excellent communication and interpersonal skills Profile: Mechanical engineer or equivalent technical background Industrial Competencies : Strong technical expertise in rotating equipment, commissioning, maintenance, and failure analysis. Ability to perform audits, analyze findings, and recommend practical, value-added solutions. Adaptability and problem-solving skills in challenging field environments. Professional experience: - Proven experience in field service engineering, technical support, or equipment auditing, ideally in fertilizers, or rotating equipment industries. - Local experience and local markets knowledge - Experience in customer-facing roles, with demonstrated ability to manage relationships across different stages of the project lifecycle. - Knowledge of safety and environmental standards applicable to industrial sites
• Strong technical skills
• Problem-solving and conflict management
• Open for changes, demonstrates willingness to change
• International in thinking and acting
• Autonomous
• General computer sk

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role We have an exciting opportunity for a Spare Parts Business Owner to strengthen our aftermarket operations and accelerate growth across France and international markets. In this pivotal commercial and operational role, you will drive the development of the spare parts portfolio, enhance customer satisfaction, and ensure strong economic and operational performance. If you combine business acumen with solid technical understanding - and enjoy working at the intersection of sales, operations, and product strategy - this role offers an opportunity to make a significant impact. Based at our site in Saint-Quentin Your main tasks and responsibilities
• Manage the complete spare parts portfolio, including range definition, offer structure, pricing policy, and product life‑cycle decisions.
• Develop and execute the commercial strategy for spare parts in alignment with group policy, identify high‑potential business segments in collaboration with service teams.
• Define and implement pricing strategies, discount frameworks, and margin optimization measures, Lead initiatives aimed at improving profitability and competitiveness.
• Operational Coordination (≈50%): Collaborate closely with Logistics, Production, and Purchasing to ensure availability and reliability of spare parts.
• Optimize inventory levels, lead times, order processing, and prioritization, contributing to continuous improvement initiatives in forecasting, planning, and sourcing.
• Maintain KPIs and reporting including backlog, overdue backlog, lead time, workload, and warranty performance.
• Act as the central point of contact for domestic and international spare parts customers.
• Prepare monthly dashboards and drive progress plans based on performance insights. To succeed in this role, you will need
• English level B2.
• Understanding of industrial equipment such as pumps, rotating systems, turbines, or similar mechanical assemblies.
• Knowledge of spare parts characteristics, functions, constraints, compatibility, and substitution options.
• Ability to read and use technical documentation (drawings, BOMs, specifications, supplier references).
• Strong B2B business development experience in an industrial environment.
• Familiarity with spare parts sales processes: costing, quotation, negotiation, contracts, and T&Cs.
• Proficiency in pricing strategies, margin management, and bundled or kit‑based product offerings.
• Understanding of aftermarket service models (maintenance, retrofits, upgrades, parts). What we offer you
• A key role within a global and innovative industrial organization.
• The opportunity to shape and drive the spare parts business in strategic markets.
• A collaborative environment focused on technical excellence, operational reliability, and customer satisfaction.
• Strong professional development prospects in a company that values initiative, expertise, and cross‑functional teamwork. Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Join our team as Global Commercial Excellence Manager in our Water & Industry Business Unit and play a key role in driving growth and profitability. In this role, you will work closely with the Global Commercial Excellence team, contributing to global initiatives and strategies while driving pricing and value management, optimizing go-to-market models, and enabling sales teams with tools and insights for consistent execution within the Business Unit. The role can be based at any of our European Operations Your main tasks and responsibilities:
• Collaboration with sales leadership and commercial excellence teams to co-create Go-to-Market strategies in your business unit by driving channel strategy, key account management, business partner enablement, account and territory planning in collaboration with the global commercial excellence team.
• Ensure adoption of the global sales process and methodology within your business unit by promoting best practices, monitoring compliance, and identifying areas for improvement. Take ownership of driving corrective actions and implementing enhancements in collaboration with the global Commercial Excellence teams
• Establish and standardize robust data and analytics frameworks to support consistent pipeline reviews and accurate forecasting across commercial teams. Ensure alignment of tools, metrics, and methodologies to drive visibility, accountability, and strategic decision-making
• Drive Pricing & Value Management by implementing pricing governance, value-based pricing, discount controls, and margin optimization working in tandem with the global commercial excellence team.
• Ensure accurate and structured customer data in CRM systems to enable effective segmentation, precise targeting, and full sales lifecycle management. To succeed in this role, you will need:
• Master degree in Business, Marketing, or related field (MBA preferred) and 5+ years of relevant experience in commercial excellence, pricing, or sales operations.
• Knowledge of Pricing & Value Management, including value-based pricing, discount governance, and margin optimization.
• Strong understanding of sales processes, methodologies, and account management practices in B2B environments.
• Hands-on experience with CRM systems (Salesforce preferred) and data-driven forecasting.
• Advanced analytical skills with ability to perform analytics and build actionable insights.
• Excellent stakeholder management and change leadership skills to drive adoption across functions and regions. What we offer you
• Chance to make a significant impact and drive the global strategy
• Collaborative and supportive work environment with a focus on innovation and excellence.
• Competitive salary package with attractive benefits, pension scheme, and employee assistance program.
• Exciting opportunities for professional growth and advancement in a dynamic and evolving industry. Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Job Summary The Sales Engineering Specialist supports the sales process by providing technical expertise and helping customers understand how products meet their needs. This role bridges the gap between engineering and sales, ensuring technical accuracy and customer satisfaction. This job profile is intended for professionals who apply advanced knowledge of a job area. Required to manage projects / processes independently with limited supervision. Typically coaches and reviews the work of lower level professionals. Votre mission ? Assurer le développement des parts de marché et, par extension, du chiffre d’affaires en tenant compte des objectifs commerciaux définis et des instructions de travail en vigueur. Pour ce faire, vous devrez:
• Etablir et déployer un plan d’actions commerciales dans le cadre de la stratégie d’entreprise et des objectifs commerciaux qui lui sont impartis.
• Fidéliser son portefeuille Clients.
• Prospecter de nouveaux marchés ou nouveaux Clients.
• Assurer la promotion des gammes de produits en détectant et en analysant les besoins des Clients et Prospects afin de leur proposer des solutions techniques appropriées.
• Communiquer de manière active avec les clients afin d’établir une relation de confiance et développer l’activité.
• Concevoir les études de faisabilité technique avec l’équipe des commerciaux sédentaires.
• Etablir et suivre les offres commerciales établies.
• Effectuer les relances appropriées.
• Négocier et rédiger les contrats en s’assurant des conditions de réalisation des commandes (prix, délais…).
• Suivre la réalisation des prestations techniques.
• Analyser les résultats des ventes. What we offer you Envie de mettre votre expertise au service de projets qui comptent vraiment ? Nous recherchons un Sales Engineer, pour le business Water. Au cœur de nos opérations, vous jouerez un rôle clé : analyser, sécuriser, optimiser et garantir un niveau d’excellence à toutes les étapes. Vous serez force de proposition sur des solutions innovantes, travaillerez au plus près du terrain et collaborerez avec des équipes passionnées, prêtes à relever les défis techniques et réglementaires de demain. Chez nous, vous trouverez :
• un environnement où votre expertise est valorisée
• une mission porteuse de sens et d’impact concret
• un terrain d’innovation permanent
• de vraies opportunités d’évolution dans un groupe en mouvement Si vous avez envie de progresser, d’apporter votre vision et de faire bouger les lignes, alors rejoignez-nous ! Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Ihre Hauptaufgaben und Verantwortlichkeiten: Sie verantworten in dem Verkaufsgebiet Rheinland und Rheinland-Pfalz den Verkauf von Sulzer-Produkten aus dem Bereich der Abwassertechnik inklusive Serviceleistungen. Dies beinhaltet unter anderem:
• Außendienst im Bereich der kommunalen Wassertechnologie
• Beratung von Ingenieurbüros, Interessenten, Servicepartner und Kunden im Verkaufsgebiet
• Betreuung der Bestandskunden und Akquise von Neukunden
• Aktiver Verkauf von Neuanlagen und Serviceleistungen
• Persönliche technische Beratung und Betreuung großer Bedarfsträger
• Prüfung von Kundenanforderungen auf technische Machbarkeit und die Entwicklung passen-der Lösungskonzepte
• Projektverfolgung, Auftragsverhandlung, Auftragsklärung und Projektbegleitung während der Abwicklungsphase
• Mitwirkung bei der Erstellung und Durchführung technischer Präsentationen und die Teil-nahme an Verkaufsverhandlungen
• Unterstützung bei der Beobachtung und Analyse der Markt- und Wettbewerbssituation
• Mitwirkung bei der Planung und Umsetzung der kurz- und mittelfristigen Absatzziele
• Teilnahme an Messen, Tagungen und sonstigen dienstlichen Veranstaltungen
• Unterstützung bei Marketing- und Verkaufsfördermaßnahmen
• Ausbau und Stärkung der Marktposition und nicht zuletzt deutliche Steigerung der Umsätze Um in dieser Stelle erfolgreich sein, sollten Sie Folgendes mitbringen: Folgende Voraussetzungen machen Sie zu unserem idealen Kandidaten:
• Sie haben eine abgeschlossene technische oder kaufmännische Ausbildung, z. B. als Techni-ker, Ingenieur der Elektrotechnik oder im Maschinenbau
• Sie sind ein Vertriebsprofi mit langjähriger Außendiensterfahrungen und nachweislichen Ver-triebserfolgen, sind belastbar und verfügen über eine ausgeprägte Problemlösungskompetenz
• Sie verfügen möglichst über Vorkenntnisse im Vertrieb von beratungsintensiven Produkten, im besten Fall im Bereich der Pumpentechnik, bei Rührwerken und Zubehör
• Ihre Stärke ist, neben einer überzeugenden Verkaufsrhetorik, Verhandlungsgeschick und ab- schlussstarken Verhandlungsführung, die ausgeprägte Kunden- und Verkaufsorientierung
• Zusätzlich zu einer verantwortungsvollen, selbstständigen Arbeitsweise verfügen Sie über die Fähigkeit, sich selbst zu organisieren und zu motivieren
• Im sicheren Umgang mit der deutschen Sprache, durch Ihr Auftreten und Ihre ausgeprägten Kommunikationsfähigkeiten schaffen Sie es, Kunden zu begeistern
• Einen Wohnort und nutzbare Kundenkontakte im Vertriebsgebiet können Sie vorweisen
• Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift, soziale Kompetenz und die Bereitschaft zu flexibler Reisetätigkeit im Verkaufsgebiet (teilweise mit Übernachtungen) runden Ihr Profil ab
• Geübte PC-Anwenderkenntnisse, insbesondere die Beherrschung der MS-Office-Produkte und einen PKW-Führerschein setzen wir als selbstverständlich voraus What we offer you Bei Sulzer Flow werden Sie Teil eines renommierten Teams. Wir bieten Ihnen eine anspruchsvolle, eigenständige Aufgabe in einem fordernden und fördernden Umfeld. Wir bieten Ihnen ein hohes Maß an Eigenverantwortung, eine adäquate Vergütung sowie gute Zukunftsaussichten. Firmenfahrzeug (auch zur privaten Nutzung) und moderne Kommunikationsmittel werden zur Verfügung gestellt. Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Sulzer is looking for a driven and commercially minded Account Manager to grow and develop our relationships with major Water Utility providers across the Southern Regions. You’ll manage an established customer base, identify new opportunities within those accounts, and take ownership for revenue growth across both Capital and Service & Aftermarket portfolios. This is a strategic, customer-facing role for someone who thrives on autonomy, consultative selling, and long-term partnership building — with a genuine opportunity to progress into leadership as the account base grows. Key Responsibilities
• Managing and developing existing Water Utility accounts across the Southern Regions.
• Identifying and converting new business opportunities within those accounts across Capital equipment and Aftermarket services.
• Acting as the primary point of contact, building strong technical and commercial relationships at multiple stakeholder levels.
• Owning the number: forecasting, pipeline management, and delivering against growth targets.
• Working closely with internal Engineering, Service, and Commercial teams to deliver high-quality solutions.
• Growing these accounts to a scale where you will have the opportunity to develop and lead your own team in future. What We’re Looking For
• Experience as an Account Manager, Sales Engineer, or Business Development professional within Water Utilities, Engineering, Pumps, Rotating Equipment, or related industrial sectors.
• A strong understanding of the Water sector’s operational and regulatory environment.
• Proven ability to grow accounts, uncover opportunities, and close technical solutions.
• Confident communicator with the ability to build trust and credibility.
• Commercially sharp, organised, and capable of managing a complex regional territory.
• Self-driven, proactive, and comfortable owning both the customer relationship and commercial outcomes. What we offer you
• A competitive base salary
• An annual scheme that rewards company success and individual impact, featuring significant multipliers for exceptional results and role-modeling our core values
• Company car or allowance, including EV options.
• 33 days annual leave and home-working flexibility with full diary autonomy.
• Defined contribution pension scheme and Long Service Awards.
• Continuous professional development through our dedicated Learning Pathways.
• Costco membership, discounted car leasing, and a wide range of retail/lifestyle discounts. Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

Vous souhaitez rejoindre une entreprise innovante, reconnue pour son savoir‑faire et ses équipes passionnées ? • Suivre vos KPIs : bases d’offres, taux de conversion, axes d’amélioration. What we offer you Pour réussir et vous épanouir dans ce poste, vous disposez idéalement de : Compétences techniques
• Solides bases en mécanique et hydraulique ,

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role At Sulzer, we keep the world’s water flowing. As a global engineering powerhouse, we design, maintain, and service mission‑critical pumping equipment that supports drinking water supply, wastewater networks, flood control, industrial utilities, and energy infrastructure across the planet. Across Ireland, demand for world‑class Water & Wastewater solutions has never been stronger. Internally, Ireland is recognised as one of the fastest‑growing strategic markets for Sulzer—so we’re investing. This brand‑new role is key to our growth plans, and we’re looking for a commercially driven Sales Engineer to help us strengthen our Service & Aftermarket success nationwide. In this role, you’ll be the technical and commercial bridge between customers and our market‑leading engineering capability. You will:
• Develop and grow Service & Aftermarket business across municipal Water & Wastewater markets and selected industrial sectors
• Build strong, long‑lasting relationships with utilities, contractors, consultants, and framework partners
• Identify opportunities for maintenance, repairs, upgrades, retrofits, replacement pumping solutions, and performance optimisation
• Conduct site visits, troubleshoot customer challenges, and recommend the right engineering solution
• Work closely with our local service centre and wider Sulzer network to deliver outstanding customer experience
• Drive revenue and margin growth through proactive account management and strong pipeline development If you enjoy combining technical expertise with commercial impact, this role gives you the best of both. What you bring
• Technical background in mechanical, electrical, water, wastewater, or related engineering disciplines
• Proven experience in a field‑based sales, service, or customer‑facing engineering role
• Strong communication skills with the ability to influence, challenge, and build trust
• A proactive, self‑motivated mindset—and the ambition to help build a high‑growth territory
• Understanding of the municipal water sector is highly beneficial. What we offer you
• A fully remote, home‑based role where you manage your own schedule and workload
• A competitive basic salary
• Annual personal bonus scheme based on company and personal performance
• Car or Car Allowance
• 26 Days holiday (exclusive of bank holidays)
• Defined contribution pension scheme
• Employee Assistance Program
• Company Sick pay scheme
• Company Income Continuance Scheme Although this is a remote, home‑based role, candidates must be permanently based in the Republic of Ireland and fully permitted to work in Ireland . We cannot offer visa sponsorship for this position. Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Sulzer Flow is wereldwijd marktleider in de ontwikkeling en levering van onder andere pompen, roerwerken, vermalers, compressoren en beluchters in geselecteerde industriële markten, met name in olie & gas, energie, water, afvalwater en de papierindustrie. De Sulzer Water & General Industry Business Unit heeft vestigingen in België en Nederland en is in deze regio met ongeveer 50 medewerkers actief in de verkoop, installatie en service van bovengenoemde producten. Kom werken bij Sulzer als Workshop Technician (monteur) en help mee om onze service naar een next level te brengen. In deze rol ben je verantwoordelijk voor:
• Het analyseren, reviseren en repareren van pompen, roerwerken, vermalers, compressoren en beluchters in onze werkplaats te Maastricht-Airport
• Machinale werkzaamheden
• Opstellen van analyserapporten
• Uitvoeren van testen in de proefstand Om te slagen in deze rol, heb je nodig:
• Succesvol afgeronde technische mbo-opleiding, bij voorkeur in werktuigbouwkunde of vergelijkbaar
• Ervaring met montage van of service aan Rotating Equipment is een pré maar geen must
• Affiniteit met elektrotechniek is een pré
• Technisch inzicht, je bent een echte sleutelaar
• Je beschikt over analytisch en probleemoplossend vermogen
• Je bent accuraat en werkt gestructureerd
• Goede beheersing van de Nederlandse taal is een must, Engelse taal is een pré
• Je beschikt over enige computerervaring (Word, Excel)
• Een zelfstandige, flexibele en klantgerichte instelling What we offer you Sulzer biedt een uitstekend pakket aan arbeidsvoorwaarden, waaronder:
• Een meer dan marktconform salaris
• Jaarlijkse prestatiebonus
• Een royaal aantal vakantie en ATV dagen (38)
• Een solide pensioenregeling (PMT) Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Kom werken bij Sulzer Flow in Maastricht als Field Service Technician (monteur) Rotating Water Equipment en help onze service in de Benelux naar een next level te brengen. In deze rol word je verantwoordelijk voor:
• Preventief en correctief onderhoud aan onze producten: pompen, mixers en beluchters in afvalwater- en industriële toepassingen op locatie bij onze klanten in de Benelux. Dit betreft hoofdzakelijk mechanische en deels elektrotechnische en besturingstechnische werkzaamheden
• De uitvoering van renovatie- en nieuwbouwprojecten
• Als visitekaartje van Sulzer denk je proactief mee over potentële verbeteringen en commerciële kansen en ben je onze belangrijkste ambassadeur bij onze klanten
• Consignatie- / wachtdienst en af en toe een externe overnachting zijn voor jou geen probleem Om succesvol te zijn in deze functie heb je nodig:
• Een technische opleiding, bijvoorbeeld op het gebied van werktuigbouwkunde
• Ervaring met rotating equipment in een industri ë le setting is een pre
• Ervaring en affiniteit met elektrotechniek en PLC/ meet- en regeltechniek inzake toepassingen in (industriële) pompen/ rotating equipment is een pre
• Voldoende kennis van de Nederlandse taal in woord en geschrift is een must
• (Basis) kennis van de Franse en Engelse taal is zeer gewenst
• Uitstekend ontwikkelde communicatieve vaardigheden
• Affiniteit met een technisch commerciële serviceorganisatie
• Een zelfstandige, flexibele en klantgerichte instelling
• Een geldig rijbewijs CE/ C1E is een pre . What we offer you Jouw Arbeidsvoorwaarden:
• Sulzer biedt je een meer dan goed salaris inclusief vakantiegeld
• Een jaarlijkse prestatiebonus
• Een royaal aantal vakantie- en ATV dagen (38)
• Een solide pensioenregeling (PMT)
• Een volledig ingerichte servicewagen, mobiele telefoon en laptop Locatie: Onze activiteiten vinden plaats in de Benelux en worden aangestuurd vanuit ons Service Center in Maastricht-Airport, waar je indien nodig aanwezig kunt zijn. Je vertrekt naar onze klantlocaties veelal vanuit thuis. Je bent woonachtig in de regio Midden NL (Nijmegen, Breda, Rotterdam, Utrecht , Eindhoven) of Zuid NL Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Sulzer Flow is wereldwijd marktleider in de ontwikkeling en levering van onder andere pompen, roerwerken, vermalers, compressoren en beluchters in geselecteerde industriële markten, met name in olie & gas, energie, water, afvalwater en de papierindustrie. De Sulzer Water & General Industry Business Unit heeft vestigingen in Nederland en België en is in deze regio met ongeveer 50 medewerkers actief in de verkoop, installatie en service van bovengenoemde producten. Kom werken bij Sulzer als (Technisch) Werkvoorbereider en help mee in onze verdere groei en om onze service naar een next level te brengen. In deze rol ben je verantwoordelijk voor:
• Voorbereiden van onderhouds- en modificatiewerkzaamheden aan de installaties/machines of onderdelen hiervan
• Opstellen van werkpakketten inclusief tekeningen, materialen, veiligheidsinstructies en planningen
• Coördineren van werkzaamheden met klanten, eigen Field Service Engineers, Workshop Engineers en externe partijen
• Aanvragen en beoordelen van offertes van leveranciers en aannemers
• Bewaken van voortgang, kosten en kwaliteit tijdens de voorbereiding en uitvoering
• Ondersteunen bij storingsanalyses en het implementeren van structurele verbeteringen
• Zorgen voor naleving van veiligheids-, milieu- en kwaliteitsnormen (bijv. VCA, ISO, ATEX)
• Beheren van technische documentatie en onderhoudsplannen in het onderhoudsbeheersysteem of administratie. Om te slagen in deze rol, heb je nodig :
• MBO+/HBO werk- en denkniveau, bij voorkeur richting Werktuigbouwkunde, Elektrotechniek, Mechatronica of vergelijkbaar
• Aantoonbare ervaring in een industriële omgeving (bijv. industriële/communale waterzuiveringen, procesindustrie; chemie, food, pharma, metaal, energie)
• Kennis van industriële installaties, onderhoudsprocessen en technische regelgeving
• Ervaring met onderhoudsbeheersystemen en MS Office
• Bekend met LEAN, TPM of andere verbetermethodieken is een pré
• Goede communicatieve vaardigheden en organisatorisch sterk What we offer you Jouw arbeidsvoorwaarden: Sulzer biedt een uitstekend pakket aan arbeidsvoorwaarden, waaronder:
• Een meer dan marktconform salaris
• Een prestatiebonusregeling
• Een royaal aantal vakantie en ATV dagen (38)
• Een solide pensioenregeling (PMT) Locatie: Je werkt je samen met je collega’s vanuit onze locatie in Maastricht- Airport en af en toe ook bij onze klanten in de Benelux. We werken in onze moderne locatie met eigen werkplaats in een informele sfeer op een professionele manier met elkaar samen. Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Sulzer Flow is wereldwijd marktleider in de ontwikkeling en levering van o.m. pompen, roerwerken, vermalers en beluchting in geselecteerde industriële markten, met name in olie & gas, energie, water, afvalwater en de papierindustrie. De Sulzer Water & General Industry Business Unit heeft vestigingen in België en Nederland en is in deze regio met bijna 50 medewerkers actief in de verkoop, installatie en service van bovengenoemde producten. Kom werken bij Sulzer Flow in Maastricht als Field Service Technician (monteur) Flow Equipment Midden-Zuid NL en help onze service in de Benelux naar een next level te brengen. In deze rol word je verantwoordelijk voor:
• Preventief en correctief onderhoud aan onze producten: pompen, mixers en beluchters in afvalwater- en industriële toepassingen op locatie bij onze klanten in de Benelux. Dit betreft hoofdzakelijk mechanische en deels elektrotechnische en besturingstechnische werkzaamheden
• De uitvoering van renovatie- en nieuwbouwprojecten
• Als visitekaartje van Sulzer denk je proactief mee over potentële verbeteringen en commerciële kansen en ben je onze belangrijkste ambassadeur bij onze klanten
• Consignatie- / wachtdienst en af en toe een externe overnachting zijn voor jou geen probleem Om succesvol te zijn in deze functie heb je nodig:
• Een technische opleiding, bijvoorbeeld op het gebied van werktuigbouwkunde
• Ervaring met rotating equipment in een industri ë le setting is een pre
• Ervaring en affiniteit met elektrotechniek en PLC/ meet- en regeltechniek inzake toepassingen in (industriële) pompen/ rotating equipment is een pre
• Voldoende kennis van de Nederlandse taal in woord en geschrift is een must
• (Basis) kennis van de Franse en Engelse taal is zeer gewenst
• Uitstekend ontwikkelde communicatieve vaardigheden
• Affiniteit met een technisch commerciële serviceorganisatie
• Een zelfstandige, flexibele en klantgerichte instelling
• Een geldig rijbewijs CE/ C1E is een pre What we offer you Jouw Arbeidsvoorwaarden: Sulzer biedt je een meer dan goed salaris inclusief vakantiegeld
• Een jaarlijkse prestatiebonus
• Een royaal aantal vakantie- en ATV dagen (38)
• Een solide pensioenregeling (PMT)
• Een volledig ingerichte servicewagen, mobiele telefoon en laptop Locatie: Onze activiteiten vinden plaats in de Benelux en worden aangestuurd vanuit ons Service Center in Maastricht-Airport, waar je indien nodig aanwezig kunt zijn. Je vertrekt naar onze klantlocaties veelal vanuit thuis. Je bent woonachtig in de regio Midden NL (Nijmegen, Breda, Rotterdam, Utrecht, Eindhoven) of Zuid NL. Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Join our Water & Industry Business Unit and be part of a global team delivering high-impact pumping and rotating equipment solutions. Purpose of the Role We are seeking an experienced Sales Manager, Water and Wastewater to lead sales activities across Greece, Cyprus, and Israel for our Water and Industrial Business Uni . The role focuses on developing long-term customer relationships, identifying and converting commercial opportunities, and delivering tailored pumping and rotating equipment solutions within the water industry. You will represent Sulzer in front of key customers, manage complex technical and commercial engagements, and consistently achieve agreed sales targets. Key Responsibilities
• Build and maintain strong relationships with new and existing customers across the assigned territories
• Develop and manage a robust sales pipeline and key account strategy
• Visit customers regularly, lead project discussions, and deliver technical presentations on the Sulzer Water portfolio
• Prepare technical and commercial quotations with support from tendering teams
• Negotiate contracts and support project order wins
• Work closely with engineering, procurement, manufacturing, project management, and global Sulzer WIBU offices
• Coordinate with local agents in Greece, Cyprus, and Israel
• Prepare structured handover documentation to Project Management and support delivery through to contractual completion Requirements:
• Strong technical and commercial acumen within the water industry
• B.E / B.Tech / Diploma in Mechanical Engineering
• 10+ years’ experience in the water industry , including 7+ years living and working in Greece
• Proven experience in technical sales, proposals, or tendering functions
• Strong ability to read engineering drawings, specifications, and tender documents
• Sulzer product knowledge is a strong advantage
• CRM experience (Salesforce preferred) What we offer you
• Chance to make a meaningful impact by driving growth across the Sales organisation within our Water & Industrial business, with sustainability at the heart of our strategy.
• Collaborative and supportive work environment with a focus on innovation and excellence.
• Exciting opportunities for professional growth and advancement in a dynamic and evolving industry in a global environment Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Job Summary The Lead (Field) Service Technician is responsible for installing, configuring, calibrating, and repairing technical products and systems at customer field locations. This role performs a variety of maintenance and technical support tasks and may provide onsite training to customer support personnel. This job profile is intended for experienced support-level staff that generally works autonomously and only requires closer supervision in non-routine situations. Résumé du poste** En tant que Technicien de Service (Field Service Technician) chez Sulzer Ensival Moret France SASU, vous serez responsable de l'installation, de la maintenance préventive et corrective, ainsi que du dépannage de nos équipements sur les sites de nos clients. Vous assurerez un service de haute qualité, garantissant la satisfaction client et le bon fonctionnement de nos produits. Responsabilités** * Effectuer des interventions de maintenance préventive et corrective sur les pompes, agitateurs et autres équipements Sulzer Ensival Moret. * Diagnostiquer les pannes et dysfonctionnements, proposer des solutions techniques et les mettre en œuvre. * Réaliser des installations et mises en service d'équipements neufs. * Former les clients à l'utilisation et à la maintenance de premier niveau des produits. * Rédiger des rapports d'intervention détaillés et précis (rapports techniques, feuilles de temps, etc.). * Gérer son stock de pièces détachées et outils de manière autonome. * Assurer un reporting régulier à son responsable et aux équipes internes (ventes, support technique). * Respecter scrupuleusement les règles de sécurité, les procédures internes et les normes en vigueur. * Participer à la veille technologique et à l'amélioration continue des processus.
• Qualifications** * Diplôme de niveau Bac+2/3 en maintenance industrielle, mécanique, électromécanique, ou équivalent. * Expérience significative (minimum 3 ans) en maintenance d'équipements industriels, idéalement dans le domaine des pompes ou des machines tournantes. * Solides connaissances en mécanique, hydraulique, électricité et automatisme industriel. * Capacité à lire et interpréter des schémas techniques (mécaniques, électriques, hydrauliques). * Maîtrise des outils de diagnostic et de mesure. * Autonomie, rigueur, sens de l'organisation et esprit d'équipe. * Excellentes aptitudes à la communication et au service client. * Permis de conduire B valide (déplacements fréquents sur le territoire national). * Maîtrise du français (écrit et oral) indispensable. * Des connaissances en anglais technique seraient un plus.
• What we offer you . Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Job Summary The (Field) Service Team Lead is responsible for supervising professional-level employees in the field service team. This role sets day-to-day operational objectives, ensures adherence to procedures, and supports the delivery of high-quality technical services to customers. This job profile is intended for People Managers of 4+ professional-level roles. Ihre Aufgaben
• Fachliche Führung und Koordination der Servicetechniker sowie Begleitung der lokalen Servicekoordinatoren bei regionalen Themen
• Sicherstellung eines reibungslosen operativen Servicebetriebs in enger Zusammenarbeit mit der Einsatzplanung
• Eskalationsinstanz bei komplexen oder kritischen Serviceeinsätzen
• Überwachung und Weiterentwicklung der Servicequalität sowie Einhaltung von Sicherheits‑ und Qualitätsstandards (u. a. DGUV, ATEX)
• Durchführung und Begleitung von Safety Walks, Schulungen und technischen Unterweisungen
• Monitoring zentraler Service‑KPIs wie Auslastung, Reaktionszeiten und Qualitätskennzahlen
• Unterstützung bei technischen Fragestellungen, Fehleranalysen und Kundeneskalationen
• Enge Abstimmung mit dem Head of Service in allen personal‑ und organisationsrelevanten Themen
• Mitwirkung an der Weiterentwicklung von Prozessen und Strukturen im Field Service
• Perspektivische Weiterentwicklung in die Rolle des elektrischen Betriebsleiters (Zeithorizont 1–3 Jahre) Ihr Profil
• Abgeschlossene technische Ausbildung mit Weiterbildung zum Meister oder Techniker, Elektromeister zwingend erforderlich
• Mehrjährige Erfahrung im technischen Serviceumfeld; erste oder mehrjährige Führungserfahrung von Vorteil
• Erfahrung in industriellen Anwendungsbereichen, idealerweise in der Pumpen‑, Abwasser‑, Rechen‑, Filter‑ oder Gebläsetechnik
• Sehr gutes Verständnis für Arbeitssicherheit, Qualitätsanforderungen und technische Regelwerke
• Strukturierte, lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise mit ausgeprägter Kommunikations‑ und Teamfähigkeit
• Reisebereitschaft innerhalb Deutschlands (bis ca. 30 %)
• Wohnort im Raum Bonn oder angrenzend What we offer you
• Abwechslungsreiche und verantwortungsvolle Aufgaben in einem professionellen Arbeitsumfeld
• Eigenständiges Arbeiten mit klaren Zuständigkeiten
• Zusammenarbeit in einem kollegialen Team
• Marktgerechte Vergütung
• Zugang zu einem Firmenwagen, auch zur privaten Nutzung
• Sichere Perspektiven in einem langfristig ausgerichteten Unternehmen

In dieser Position koordinieren Sie Termine, begleiten Projekte im Tagesgeschäft und stehen in engem Austausch mit internen Fachbereichen sowie externen Partnern. • Bearbeitung von Reklamationen, Retouren und Rechnungskorrekturen

• Gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

• Kundenorientiertes Auftreten sowie ausgeprägte Teamfähigkeit

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Job Summary The Sr. Tendering Engineer is responsible for providing technical support to sales teams and conducting technical analysis of product configurations to determine customer-specific pricing. This job profile is intended for experienced professionals who apply practical knowledge of a job area and work independently with general supervision. Résumé du poste** En tant que Technico-commercial sédentaire chez Sulzer Ensival Moret France SASU, vous serez un élément clé de notre équipe commerciale, chargé de développer et de maintenir d'excellentes relations avec nos clients, tout en assurant la promotion et la vente de nos solutions techniques. Responsabilités** * Gérer un portefeuille de clients existants et le cas échéant, prospecter de nouveaux clients par téléphone et par e-mail. * Analyser les besoins techniques des clients et leur proposer des solutions adaptées parmi notre gamme de produits (pompes, agitateurs, etc.). * Élaborer des offres commerciales détaillées et techniques, en collaboration avec les équipes d'ingénierie et de production. * Négocier les conditions commerciales et conclure les ventes. * Assurer le suivi des commandes, de la réception à la livraison, en coordination avec les services internes. * Répondre aux demandes techniques des clients et les conseiller sur l'utilisation de nos produits. * Participer à l'élaboration de la stratégie commerciale et au reporting des activités. * Maintenir une veille technologique et concurrentielle sur le marché.
• Qualifications** * Diplôme technique (Bac+2 à Bac+5) en mécanique, électromécanique, génie des procédés ou équivalent. * Expérience significative (minimum 3 ans) en vente de produits techniques industriels, idéalement dans le secteur des pompes ou équipements rotatifs. * Excellentes compétences relationnelles et de communication, à l'écrit comme à l'oral. * Maîtrise des outils informatiques (CRM, Pack Office). * Capacité à travailler en autonomie et en équipe. * Sens de l'organisation, rigueur et proactivité. * La maîtrise de l'anglais technique est un plus.
