descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role The jobholder will work closely with Regional Head of Sales, Segment heads, and their own team to drive Strategic and Tactical initiatives (GDP), manage the marketing team, ensure integration and utilization of business optimization tools, and generally support the sales management team. The position will ensure GDP initiatives are organized and executed monthly and facilitate the data collection of the required TTI’s. Regional marketing will prioritize activities that are in alignment with these initiatives. Business excellence processes and tools (Salesforce, CPQ, etc.) will be supported by driving adoption and execution of the tools monitoring utilization and escalating any roadblocks or lack of adoption issues as well as overseeing new product order entry management. A background in LEAN/VBSS or similar is considered beneficial to identify opportunities to simplify business processes especially from an internal efficiency and/or customer perspective. Targeted location: Within traveling distance of Easley, SC Main accountabilities and tasks
• Organize and support the GDP initiatives
• Partner with the segment heads to develop, track, and report on the various action plans
• Work with business analyst personnel to automate the collection of TTI data
• Collect and communicate performance data, market insights, and opportunities to assist sales teams and services (collect KPI’s, structure data, visual management, etc.)
• Coordinate Regional marketing managers’ activities
• Combine marketing promotion, analytics, and GDP/initiatives together to coordinate and focus resources
• Oversee management of marketing communication and Marketing Initiatives
• Support channel partners development programs
• Support sales leadership to create and manage the communication flow on the main social internal and external
• Focus on execution and waste removal in business processes, primarily in Sales and Service activities Drive Sales Support department providing data intelligence to sales leaders to facilitate businesses.
• Organize and oversee data mining, accessibility to data in various systems (ERPs)
• Management level dashboard creation and maintenance
• Support Business Intelligence data collection and Analysis.
• Coordinate with other functions that SalesForce CRM, CPQ, SAPConf and other main systems are developed according to business requirements.
• Liaise with Finance and with Strategy (Budgeting Process, by Segment, by Region, by Product)
• Regular Pipeline Review and CRM maintenance
• Trainer for SalesForce
• Rolling Forecast management, both for OI (Order Intake) and Sales
• Partner with sales leaders and corporate business development personnel to track timely execution of key tasks
• Assist with preparation for corporate presentations and reports What we offer you
• Competitive Paid Time Off
• 12 Company Paid Holidays per year
• Annual Bonus Program
• Full Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits
• Company Paid Short Term and Long-Term Disability, Company Paid Life Insurance
• 6% 401K or Roth Company Match with Immediate Vesting
• Company Paid Retirement Security Contributions following 1 year of employment
• Tuition Reimbursement/Educational Assistance
• Quarterly Gym Reimbursement Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role This role leads and develops Direct and Regional Sales Managers, implements sales strategies, and supports the Pulp and Paper market. This position has direct accountability for all PPI sales activities, both direct and indirect, in the USA. This role will necessitate effective collaboration and coordination with operations, procurement, quality, and other relevant departments. Essential Functions:
• Achieve sales growth targets by developing and executing annual sales plans.
• Lead the RSM’s, monitor individual performance against goals, and provide coaching, mentoring, and training.
• Responsible for ownership and personal management of the direct corporate accounts. Develops trust and solid partnerships with Corporate and OEM accounts. Negotiates and manages agreements with both.
• Engages collaboratively with technical associations and partners with leading technical universities.
• Analyze and identify market trends, and the competition to jointly develop strategic plans for expanding sales of new and existing products.
• Travel, as necessary within the assigned territory. Other Duties:
• Must possess superior presentation, communication, and negotiation skills.
• Experience with multiple direct reports and a proven history of leading teams.
• Superior analytical, strategic thinking, leadership skills.
• Demonstrated success through focus, good judgment, and decision-making.
• Keen sense of teamwork and business goal alignment.
• Well-developed sense of urgency to deliver results.
• Excellent relationship and people skills. Supervisory Duties:
• Network of Regional Sales Managers and Application Specialists covering the PPI market. Qualifications:
• Bachelor’s degree in engineering or a similar technical degree preferred. MBA is a plus.
• At least 10-15 years’ regional sales experience.
• At least 5 years people management experience. What we offer you

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Bajo la posición de Orden entry & tendering, el Especialista en Entrada de Órdenes es responsable de ingresar, gestionar y dar seguimiento a todas las órdenes de materiales y servicios, asegurando el cumplimiento de los estándares establecidos, así como de las directivas, procedimientos de trabajo y políticas vigentes de la compañía. Adicionalmente, colabora en la generación de cotizaciones, brinda apoyo administrativo al equipo de ventas y, previa solicitud, realiza otras tareas relacionadas acordes a su función. Responsabilidades:
• Gestionar los pedidos de clientes desde la recepción de la orden hasta su correcta facturación.
• Asegurar la conciliación de los pedidos recibidos con las cotizaciones previamente emitidas o con las listas de precios vigentes.
• Ejecutar y controlar todas las funciones asociadas a la entrada de pedidos y facturación, incluyendo aquellos relacionados con la fabricación de productos para clientes.
• Realizar la entrada de pedidos en SAP, manteniendo comunicación permanente y coordinando la planificación con el equipo de ventas, hasta su facturación.
• Elaborar cotizaciones comerciales, asegurando el correcto uso de precios, condiciones comerciales y políticas internas.
• Brindar apoyo administrativo al equipo de ventas, incluyendo gestión documental, actualización de información en sistemas, apoyo en informes y coordinación interna.
• Elaborar y presentar informes de ventas periódicos.
• Demostrar habilidad para seguir métodos y procedimientos establecidos, trabajo en equipo, criterio profesional, atención al detalle y capacidad de comunicación clara y concisa, tanto oral como escrita.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Job Summary The Sales Engineering Specialist supports the sales process by providing technical expertise and helping customers understand how products meet their needs. This role bridges the gap between engineering and sales, ensuring technical accuracy and customer satisfaction. This job profile is intended for professionals who apply advanced knowledge of a job area. Required to manage projects / processes independently with limited supervision. Typically coaches and reviews the work of lower level professionals. Responsabilidades:
• Responsable de realizar presentaciones a los clientes con el fin de asesorar, formar y promocionar nuestros productos y servicios, relacionados con los procesos de tratamiento de aguas residuales urbanas e industriales (bombas y mixers sumergibles, aireadores, trituradoras, tamices, decantadores, filtros).
• Trabajar de manera multidisciplinaria con los otros departamentos para preparar planes de ventas y ofertas, garantizando la precisión técnica y financiera.
• Trabajar con el equipo de ventas en general para identificar y desarrollar nuevas oportunidades de mercado.
• Establecer y mantener relaciones efectivas con los clientes, comprender sus necesidades y promover la comprensión por parte del cliente de nuestra oferta de productos, sistemas y/o servicios.
• Crear valor agregado para el cliente y, a continuación, alinearse para ofrecer una solución, garantizando una experiencia positiva para el cliente.
• Preparar planes de ventas y realizar revisiones periódicas de la situación para mantener los volúmenes de pedidos, y gestionar los procesos administrativos de ventas.
• Promocionar activamente todo el portafolio de productos Sulzer en los mercados asignados.
• Alcanzar o superar los objetivos de venta acordados para el segmento o región.
• Desarrollar e implementar estrategias comerciales consistentes con los objetivos de Sulzer.
• Preparar y acompañar activamente las ofertas para los clientes en las regiones y segmentos asignados.
• Responsable por la proyección precisa de ventas para su región y cuentas relacionadas.
• Revisar órdenes de compra, contratos, términos y condiciones para las cuentas y clientes asignados.
• Preparación de ofertas en coordinación con el departamento de ofertas y propuestas, garantizando que se cumplen los aspectos técnicos y financieros adecuados, incluidos los precios y las condiciones comerciales.
• Visitas constantes a los clientes para desarrollo de nuevos mercados.
• Visitas con clientes importantes y buscar prospectos potenciales. Requisitos:
• Mínimo 5 años de experiencia como ingeniero de ventas y/o ingeniero de aplicaciones en el área de gestión de agua urbana y/o industrial.
• Titulado en ingeniería industrial, mecánica, hidráulica o afín.
• Experiencia en ventas directas e indirectas a clientes industriales.
• Conocimientos sobre procesos de tratamiento de aguas residuales urbanas e industriales, bombas centrífugas y motores eléctricos.
• Cartera de clientes/relaciones existentes en los mercados de industrias y aguas municipales, incluyendo O&M, EPC, empresas de ingeniería y usuarios finales
• Disponibilidad para viajes (50% del tiempo)
• Dominio de Microsoft Office (Excel) y Sales Force.
• Manejo de inglés intermedio.
• Buenas habilidades de comunicación.
• Capacidad para trabajar de forma independiente.
• Proactivo.
• Motivado, con un historial demostrado de obtención de resultados por encima de los objetivos y las expectativas. What we offer you Beneficios:
• Salario y prestaciones acordes con el mercado.
• Bonificación anual basada en los objetivos corporativos y personales.
• Seguro médico y dental. Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce an

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role The Applications Engineer is responsible for evaluating customer requirements and developing technical and commercial proposals for industrial equipment solutions. This role serves as a critical link between customers, sales teams, and internal engineering/manufacturing to ensure accurate, timely, and competitive responses to inquiries. This position operates in a fast-paced, high-volume environment supporting distributors, OEMs, EPCs, and end users across a wide range of applications. Applications include Pulp and Paper, Biofuels, Foods, Chemical processing, Mining / Metals, Industrial wastewater, and Auxiliary equipment in other segments as needed. The Applications Group is a dynamic organization with both junior and senior engineers who possess a wide range of experience and competencies. This is a great opportunity to contribute to a growing company and offers great mentorship opportunities to enhance professional development. This role is designed as a foundational position with clear visibility into commercial strategy and customer engagement, offering a defined pathway into Accounts Management and outside sales roles. This role is based out of our Easley, SC office. Key Responsibilities: Proposal & Technical Evaluation
• Review customer RFQs, specifications, and datasheets to determine appropriate product selection
• Perform pumping equipment sizing, selection, and configuration
• Generate detailed quotations including scope, pricing, and lead time Customer & Sales Support
• Serve as a technical resource for internal sales teams and external customers
• Support distribution network with product selection, troubleshooting, and application guidance
• Participate in distributor and customer calls, visits, and training as needed
• Support sales efforts by contributing to technical sales strategy, participating in customer discussions, and developing an understanding of commercial drivers behind winning opportunities Cross-Functional Coordination
• Work closely with the Project Management team to define documentation packages, testing requirements, and customer deliverables early in the quotation phase to ensure accurate scope, compliance, and execution readiness.
• Collaborate with manufacturing, engineering, and supply chain to confirm feasibility, lead times, and cost
• Work with global teams when required to support international or specialized opportunities
• Ensure alignment between customer expectations and internal capabilities Quote and Opportunity Management
• Manage multiple RFQs simultaneously in a high-volume environment
• Maintain accurate records of opportunities, quotes, and communications in Salesforce (CRM system) Continuous Improvement & Team Support
• Identify opportunities to improve quoting efficiency, accuracy, and standardization
• Support development of tools, templates, and documentation
• Assist in training new team members and sharing application knowledge Secondary Responsibilities:
• Perform other duties as assigned. Supervisory Responsibilities:
• None Qualifications:
• Required
• Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering, chemical engineering, or related field.
• 0-5 years of related engineering experience (industrial, process, applications, pumps & hydraulics preferred)
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
• Ability to manage multiple priorities under tight deadlines
• Excellent communication skills (both written and verbal)
• Willingness to travel as needed
• Preferred
• Experience with pumps, fluid systems, or rotating equipment
• Exposure to reading specifications and technical drawings
• Familiarity with CRM systems (Salesforce) and/or ERP systems (SAP)
• Experience working with distributors or in a customer-facing role Key

Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role We’re looking for a high-impact Key Account Manager to take ownership of one of our most significant long-term utility partnerships – a major regional water provider serving millions of customers across the East of England This is a commercially critical role where you will own the account strategy end-to-end—driving growth across capital projects (pump packages and related equipment) and aftermarket services, while shaping the future of a well-established, high-value relationship. Your main responsibilities:
• Own the P&L and growth strategy for a utility account, with clear accountability for revenue and margin performance
• Drive the narrative with the customer—positioning us as a trusted, strategic partner across both capital investment and lifecycle services
• Lead and coordinate a multi-disciplinary account team, ensuring alignment across sales, service, engineering and delivery
• Build and deepen senior stakeholder relationships, influencing decision-making at operational and strategic levels
• Develop and execute a long-term account development plan, aligned to the customer’s AMP cycles and investment priorities
• Provide accurate forecasting, pipeline management and reporting
• Act as the voice of the customer internally, ensuring continuous improvement and delivery excellence What We’re Looking For
• Proven experience in a Key Account Management or Strategic Account role within engineering, industrial or utilities environments
• Strong commercial acumen with experience owning revenue targets and driving growth
• Background in pumps, rotating equipment, or fluid handling systems is highly desirable. Alternatively, direct experience working closely with a UK -based water utility provider is a strong advantage
• Demonstrated ability to build and manage high-value, long-term customer relationships
• Experience leading or influencing cross-functional teams without direct line management
• Confident communicator, capable of engaging at both technical and executive levels
• Strategic mindset with the ability to translate customer needs into tangible commercial outcomes What we offer you
• Competitive basic salary

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Er du opptatt av en bærekraftig fremtid og levende fjorder? Vil du lære og utvikle deg hver eneste dag på jobb? Motiveres du av å ha en salgsjobb som bidrar til renere vann og et bedre miljø? Som oss vet du at vann ikke bare er en ressurs – det er selve grunnlaget for alt liv. Og få ting gir større mening enn å jobbe med løsninger som sikrer at vannet renses, transporteres og forvaltes på best mulig måte. Du ikke bare forstår prosessene – du elsker dem. Enten det handler om flotasjon, mekanisk filtrering eller biologisk rensing, så er du hjemme. Du har gjerne vært tett på anlegg og prosesser tidligere i karrieren, og du vet hva som faktisk fungerer i praksis – ikke bare på papiret. Men du er ikke bare teknisk dyktig. Du er en relasjonsbygger som kundene raskt får tillit til, og du stiller alltid opp når de trenger deg. Salg gir deg energi – ikke fordi du selger, men fordi du løser problemer og skaper verdi for kunder som stoler på din faglige tyngde. Du trives i møte med mennesker, og du har et engasjement som smitter når du presenterer eller holder foredrag. Du er god på å legge planer, liker å kombinere selvstendighet med samarbeid, og mestrer digitale verktøy som en naturlig del av hverdagen. En hverdag som innebærer noe reising for å besøke kunder – nye som gamle – er noe du setter pris på. Høres dette ut som deg? Da gleder vi oss til å høre fra deg. Oppsummert håper vi at du er:
• En som har erfaring med B2B-salg og som blir motivert av lykkelig kunder
• Opptatt av å bygge tillit og være tilgjengelig for kundene
• Fleksibel og liker å styre hverdagen din selv
• Selvstendig og reiseglad
• Smart, engasjert og god på å løse problemer
• Strukturert og tydelig i kommunikasjonsformen – norsk er arbeidsspråket Hvem er vi tenker du? Og hva kan vi tilby akkurat deg? Hos Sulzer tror vi på kontinuerlig læring og mulighetene det skaper for fremtiden din. Vi jobber i team for å komme frem til de beste løsningene for våre kunder, og du vil ha ingeniører og fageksperter i ryggen som hjelper deg der det trengs. I Norge har Sulzer kontorer og verksteder i Asker, Bergen, Fredrikstad, Kristiansand og Trondheim. Vi har gode pensjons- og forsikringsordninger. Vi tilbyr fleksible arbeidstidsordninger, og legger til rette for bruk av hjemmekontor. Du får firmabil, og det er ønskelig at du velger en miljøvennlig bil, på den måten bidrar du til å gjøre bedriften mer bærekraftig. Denne stillingen er svært sentral for selskapet vårt, så er vi mest opptatt av å finne det riktige mennesket, som vil trives og ønsker å vokse sammen med oss. Nøyaktig hvor du bor, er ikke så viktig. Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Sulzer Flow is wereldwijd marktleider in de ontwikkeling en levering van onder andere pompen, roerwerken, vermalers, compressoren en beluchters in geselecteerde industriële markten, met name in olie & gas, energie, water, afvalwater en de papierindustrie. De Sulzer Water & General Industry Business Unit heeft vestigingen in België en Nederland en is in deze regio met bijna 50 medewerkers actief in de verkoop, installatie en service van bovengenoemde producten. Kom werken bij Sulzer Flow als Workshop Technician (monteur) - Meewerkend voorman (m/v/x) en help mee om onze service naar een next level te brengen. In deze rol ben je verantwoordelijk voor:
• Werkt actief mee bij het analyseren, reviseren en repareren van pompen, roerwerken, vermalers, compressoren en beluchters in onze werkplaats te Maastricht-Airport
• Opstellen van analyserapporten
• Coördinatie en verdeling dagelijkse werkzaamheden in het team rekening houdend met planning, prioriteiten en beschikbare capaciteit
• Bewaakt de kwaliteit, veiligheid en voortgang
• Fungeert als eerste aanspreekpunt voor de werkplaats bij technische en operationele vraagstukken
• Machinale werkzaamheden
• Uitvoeren van testen in de proefstand Om te slagen in deze rol, heb je nodig:
• Succesvol afgeronde technische mbo-opleiding, bij voorkeur in werktuigbouwkunde of vergelijkbaar
• Ervaring met montage van of service aan Rotating Equipment
• Affiniteit met elektrotechniek is een pré
• Technisch inzicht, je bent een echte sleutelaar
• Je beschikt over analytisch en probleemoplossend vermogen
• Je bent accuraat en werkt gestructureerd
• Goede beheersing van de Nederlandse taal, Engelse taal is een pré
• Je beschikt over enige computerervaring (Word, Excel)
• Een zelfstandige, flexibele en klantgerichte instelling What we offer you Sulzer biedt een uitstekend pakket aan arbeidsvoorwaarden, waaronder:
• Een meer dan marktconform salaris
• Attractieve bonusregeling,
• Een royaal aantal vakantie en ATV dagen (38)
• Een solide pensioenregeling (PMT) Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Servicetekniker till Servicecentret, CSS Stockholm Servicetekniker till Servicecentret, CSS Stockholm Sulzer är ett globalt ledande företag inom utveckling och leverans av pumpar, omrörare, luftarutrustning och blåsmaskiner till kunder inom områden som olja, gas, vatten, vattenrening gruvdrift, pappersindustri och liknande. Vi tillhandahåller en utmanande och givande arbetsmiljö där mångfald är värderad som nyckelfaktorn till framgång. Vi söker en servicetekniker till vårt servicecenter i Stockholm. Vi erbjuder en intressant tjänst med goda möjligheter för vidare utveckling. Vårt huvudkontor ligger i Vadstena och vi har även kontor i Malmö, Göteborg, Norrköping och Stockholm samt service centers i Vadstena, Göteborg, Årsta, Järfälla, Karlstad, Arlöv och Piteå. Placeringsort för denna roll är Årsta. Tjänsten: I arbetet ingår bl a service, felsökning, reparation och montage av våra egna och externa produkter. Arbetet utförs på servicecentret och ute hos kund. Även vissa administrativa uppgifter ingår i tjänsten såsom arbete i vårt affärssystem SAP samt dokumentation av utförda servicearbeten. Servicecentret jobbar framförallt med kunder verksamma inom länshållning samt vatten- och avloppshantering. Kvalifikationer: Du har någon form av teknisk utbildning och minst 3-5 års erfarenhet av praktiskt verkstads- och fältarbete. Dessutom ska du vara tekniskt intresserad, ansvarstagande, engagerad och serviceinriktad. Du behöver kunna ta egna initiativ och vara duktig på att få saker gjorda. Du ska även vara flexibel och vilja arbeta med praktiska och en del administrativa uppgifter. Vi är en del av ett större serviceteam och samarbetar med våra kollegor inom Sulzer Sverige. Du behöver ha lätt för att arbeta individuellt och i grupp, för att vi tillsammans skall kunna utveckla verksamheten. I tjänsten förekommer resor framförallt inom Stockholmsområdet med omnejd. B-körkort är ett grundkrav. Övernattningar och även beredskap förekommer. Vem är du? Du är praktiskt lagd och har ett genuint intresse av teknik och mekanik. Grundläggande el/styr/reglerkunskaper är meriterande. Vidare är Du flexibel, kommunikativ och social, och trivs lika bra med att vara ute hos kund som att utföra arbete i vår egen verkstad. Du är välorganiserad och har en god analytisk förmåga, samarbetsvillig och självgående är tydliga drag i din personlighet. Övrig information: För mer information kontakta, Mikael Larsson, Årsta Servicecenter, mikael.larsson@sulzer.com What we offer you
• Friskvårdsbidrag 3000kr/år (E-passi)
• Collea – Gratis pension och försäkringsrådgivning
• Gratis kaffe och frukt
• Företagshälsovård med regelbundna hälsokontroller Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

About the role Servicetekniker till Servicecentret, CSS Stockholm Servicetekniker till Servicecentret, CSS Stockholm Sulzer är ett globalt ledande företag inom utveckling och leverans av pumpar, omrörare, luftarutrustning och blåsmaskiner till kunder inom områden som olja, gas, vatten, vattenrening gruvdrift, pappersindustri och liknande. Vi tillhandahåller en utmanande och givande arbetsmiljö där mångfald är värderad som nyckelfaktorn till framgång. Vi söker en servicetekniker till vårt servicecenter i Stockholm. Vi erbjuder en intressant tjänst med goda möjligheter för vidare utveckling. Vårt huvudkontor ligger i Vadstena och vi har även kontor i Malmö, Göteborg, Norrköping och Stockholm samt service centers i Vadstena, Göteborg, Årsta, Järfälla, Karlstad, Arlöv och Piteå. Placeringsort för denna roll är Årsta. Tjänsten: I arbetet ingår bl a service, felsökning, reparation och montage av våra egna och externa produkter. Arbetet utförs på servicecentret och ute hos kund. Även vissa administrativa uppgifter ingår i tjänsten såsom arbete i vårt affärssystem SAP samt dokumentation av utförda servicearbeten. Servicecentret jobbar framförallt med kunder verksamma inom länshållning samt vatten- och avloppshantering. Kvalifikationer: Du har någon form av teknisk utbildning och minst 3-5 års erfarenhet av praktiskt verkstads- och fältarbete. Dessutom ska du vara tekniskt intresserad, ansvarstagande, engagerad och serviceinriktad. Du behöver kunna ta egna initiativ och vara duktig på att få saker gjorda. Du ska även vara flexibel och vilja arbeta med praktiska och en del administrativa uppgifter. Vi är en del av ett större serviceteam och samarbetar med våra kollegor inom Sulzer Sverige. Du behöver ha lätt för att arbeta individuellt och i grupp, för att vi tillsammans skall kunna utveckla verksamheten. I tjänsten förekommer resor framförallt inom Stockholmsområdet med omnejd. B-körkort är ett grundkrav. Övernattningar och även beredskap förekommer. Vem är du? Du är praktiskt lagd och har ett genuint intresse av teknik och mekanik. Grundläggande el/styr/reglerkunskaper är meriterande. Vidare är Du flexibel, kommunikativ och social, och trivs lika bra med att vara ute hos kund som att utföra arbete i vår egen verkstad. Du är välorganiserad och har en god analytisk förmåga, samarbetsvillig och självgående är tydliga drag i din personlighet. Övrig information: För mer information kontakta, Mikael Larsson, Årsta Servicecenter, mikael.larsson@sulzer.com What we offer you
• Friskvårdsbidrag 3000kr/år (E-passi)
• Collea – Gratis pension och försäkringsrådgivning
• Gratis kaffe och frukt
• Företagshälsovård med regelbundna hälsokontroller Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Service i Sulzer er et spennende og interessant fagfelt, og har ofte et høyt tempo. Det å bidra til at folk har rent vann og fungerende infrastruktur for vann- og avløp er et av de viktigste samfunnsoppdragene som finnes! Vi trives best med flere baller i luften, i et arbeidsmiljø hvor kreativitet og rasjonalitet går hånd i hånd. Vi liker kort avstand mellom verksted og ledelse, hvor ideer blir hørt og hvor muligheter for både faglig og personlig utvikling blir gitt. Sulzer søker nå etter en fagsterk og kundeorientert serviceleder. Du kommer til å være lokalisert ved vårt verksted på hovedkontoret i Asker, og også ha personalansvar for teknikerne på flere lokasjoner. Har du dokumenterte erfaringer med å skape, lede, og utvikle effektive team, håper vi at nettopp du ønsker å være med på denne reisen med oss! Stillingen inneholder blant annet:
• Du vil være en del av et team med 2 serviceledere, som tilsammen har personalansvar for alle teknikerne.
• Du vil være ansvarlig for salg av servicetjenester, driften av og effektiv bruk av ressursene, både menneskelige og materielle. Sulzer har stort fokus på kontinuerlig forbedring, utvikling, og vekst.
• Vi ønsker at du er en rollemodell, at du viser engasjement og felles retning.
• Sørge for at de ansatte får et tett og effektivt samarbeid, slik at de blir inspirert til å oppnå felles suksess.
• Sikre at teknikerne har riktig kompetanse for å utføre avdelingens arbeid, gjennom kompetanseutvikling og ansettelser, i samråd med serviceleder i Norge.
• I og med at våre serviceteknikere jobber med tungt maskineri og med arbeid som kan være risikopreget, er det svært viktig at leder har stort fokus på å drifte på en sikker og helsefremmende måte, og sikrer HMS og kvalitet i alle ledd.
• Dette er en operativ rolle, som består av både ledelse og salg, samt administrative oppgaver som bidrar til å holde hjulene i gang. Hovedoppgaver Arbeidsoppgavene inkluderer, men er ikke begrenset til:
• HMS ansvar for teknikerne og verkstedene.
• Personalansvar for teknikerne
• Kundekontakt og befaringer
• Salgsrelaterte oppgaver på serviceområdet
• Ansvar for servicebiler/flåtestyring lokalt
• Det er behov for en del reising i stillingen, for å vise tilstedeværelse på flere lokasjoner. Rapporterer til: Serviceleder Norge Ønsket erfaring og formell utdanning
• Gjerne utdanning på BSc- nivå, eller teknisk utdannelse
• Operativ ledelseserfaring, gjerne fra bransje med serviceteknikere i felt eller lignende
• Erfaring innen vedlikehold av prosessutstyr eller annet mekanisk utstyr
• Det er en fordel å kjenne til vann- og avløpsbransjen.
• Kompetanse innen HMS for arbeid i felt
• Kompetanse eller interesse for tilstøtende fagdisipliner; mekaniske, elektro, automasjon og bygg & anlegg
• Gode kommunikasjonsevner på både norsk og engelsk
• Førerkort klasse B, fordel med BE (henger)
• Gode kunnskaper innen IT Personlige styrker
• Gode kommunikasjons- og samarbeidsevner
• Komfortabel med elektroniske verktøy og systemer
• Gode mellommenneskelige egenskaper, og evne til å skape og lede et team
• Kundeorientert
• Teknisk nysgjerrighet What we offer you Hvem er vi tenker du? Og hva kan vi tilby akkurat deg? Sulzer er en stor og stabil arbeidsgiver, og samtidig har vi et lokalt miljø som er liten og dynamisk. Sulzer er kjent for produkter med høy kvalitet, har en solid ordrereserve, egne fabrikker, og er en ledende aktør i en bærekraftig og livsnødvendig industri. Ansatte hos oss har stor påvirkningskraft på egen hverdag og bedriftens retning. Sulzer tilbyr et hyggelig miljø med høy yrkesstolthet og faglig tyngde. Vi har gode pensjons- og forsikringsordninger, og fleksible arbeidstidsordninger, og ikke minst gode muligheter for videreutvikling internt og eksternt

• Dette er en operativ rolle, som består av både ledelse og salg, samt administrative oppgaver som bidrar til å holde hjulene i gang. Hovedoppgaver Arbeidsoppgavene inkluderer, men er ikke begrenset til:
• HMS ansvar for teknikerne og verkstedene.
• Personalansvar for teknikerne
• Kundekontakt og befaringer
• Salgsrelaterte oppgaver på serviceområdet
• Ansvar for servicebiler/flåtestyring lokalt
• Det er behov for en del reising i stillingen, for å vise tilstedeværelse på flere lokasjoner. Rapporterer til: Serviceleder Norge Ønsket erfaring og formell utdanning
• Gjerne utdanning på BSc- nivå, eller teknisk utdannelse
• Operativ ledelseserfaring, gjerne fra bransje med serviceteknikere i felt eller lignende
• Erfaring innen vedlikehold av prosessutstyr eller annet mekanisk utstyr
• Det er en fordel å kjenne til vann- og avløpsbransjen.
• Kompetanse innen HMS for arbeid i felt
• Kompetanse eller interesse for tilstøtende fagdisipliner; mekaniske, elektro, automasjon og bygg & anlegg
• Gode kommunikasjonsevner på både norsk og engelsk
• Førerkort klasse B, fordel med BE (henger)
• Gode kunnskaper innen IT Personlige styrker
• Gode kommunikasjons- og samarbeidsevner
• Komfortabel med elektroniske verktøy og systemer
• Gode mellommenneskelige egenskaper, og evne til å skape og lede et team
• Kundeorientert
• Teknisk nysgjerrighet What we offer you Hvem er vi tenker du? Og hva kan vi tilby akkurat deg? Sulzer er en stor og stabil arbeidsgiver, og samtidig har vi et lokalt miljø som er liten og dynamisk. Sulzer er kjent for produkter med høy kvalitet, har en solid ordrereserve, egne fabrikker, og er en ledende aktør i en bærekraftig og livsnødvendig industri. Ansatte hos oss har stor påvirkningskraft på egen hverdag og bedriftens retning. Sulzer tilbyr et hyggelig miljø med høy yrkesstolthet og faglig tyngde. Vi har gode pensjons- og forsikringsordninger, og fleksible arbeidstidsordninger, og ikke minst gode muligheter for videreutvikling internt og eksternt

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Job Summary The Process Engineering Supervisor is responsible for supervising expert-level engineers in the development and optimization of manufacturing processes. This role ensures operational efficiency and supports continuous improvement initiatives. This job profile is intended for People Managers of 4+ junior to experienced expert-level roles. Résumé du poste** En tant que Superviseur Ingénierie des Procédés, vous serez responsable de l'optimisation, de la gestion et de la supervision des processus de fabrication au sein de notre usine, en assurant l'efficacité, la qualité et la sécurité. Responsabilités** * Superviser et encadrer une équipe d'ingénieurs et de techniciens en procédés. * Concevoir, développer, mettre en œuvre et optimiser des processus de fabrication pour améliorer la productivité, réduire les coûts et garantir la qualité des produits. * Analyser les données de production et identifier les opportunités d'amélioration continue des processus. * Élaborer et maintenir la documentation technique des procédés, y compris les schémas de tuyauterie et d'instrumentation (P&ID), les procédures opérationnelles standard (SOP) et les instructions de travail. * Participer à la sélection, à l'installation et à la mise en service de nouveaux équipements de production. * Assurer la conformité des processus aux normes de sécurité, environnementales et de qualité (ISO, etc.). * Collaborer étroitement avec les départements de production, de maintenance, de R&D et de qualité. * Gérer les projets d'amélioration des procédés, y compris la planification, le suivi du budget et le respect des délais. * Former et développer les compétences de votre équipe.
• Qualifications** * Diplôme d'ingénieur en génie des procédés, génie chimique, mécanique ou domaine connexe. * Minimum de 5 ans d'expérience en ingénierie des procédés dans un environnement industriel, avec une expérience significative en supervision ou gestion d'équipe. * Maîtrise des outils et méthodologies d'optimisation des procédés (Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, etc.). * Excellentes compétences en résolution de problèmes et en analyse technique. * Capacité à travailler de manière autonome et en équipe dans un environnement dynamique. * Maîtrise du français et de l'anglais technique (écrit et oral). * Connaissance des logiciels de simulation de processus (par exemple, Aspen Plus, HYSYS) serait un plus. * Expérience dans l'industrie des pompes, de la compression ou de l'équipement rotatif serait un atout.
• What we offer you . Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer è una società di ingegneria leader con un patrimonio orgoglioso di innovazione. Unisciti al nostro team globale per accrescere le tue competenze e sviluppare soluzioni innovative che consentano una società prospera e più sostenibile. Informazioni sul ruolo Siamo alla ricerca di un Senior Finance Business Partner commercialmente pensato per supportare il nostro business Servizi in tutta la regione del Regno Unito & Nordics. In questo ruolo strategico, si combinano competenze finanziarie profonde con un forte acume aziendale per guidare il processo decisionale, migliorare le prestazioni e garantire che gli insight finanziari sono incorporati a ogni livello dell'organizzazione. Come partner chiave per la leadership regionale, si svolgerà un ruolo fondamentale nella definizione della direzione futura del business - aiutando a guidare la crescita sostenibile, la redditività e l'eccellenza operativa in più siti e linee di servizio. Il ruolo può essere basato presso le nostre strutture Birmingham o Leeds. Cosa farai:
• Sviluppare e rivedere piani strategici a livello regionale, aziendale o divisionale, fornendo informazioni finanziarie per sostenere la crescita a lungo termine e le strategie aziendali
• Stabilire e mantenere un quadro completo di gestione delle prestazioni per i team interfunzionali e geograficamente diversi
• Gestire i principali programmi di capitale e supervisionare la modellazione dei costi, dei prezzi e della redditività.
• Partner con leader senior, strategia di modellazione e allineamento finanziario con gli obiettivi aziendali.
• Sostenere le recensioni dei progetti e fornire una guida finanziaria esperta attraverso il ciclo di vita del progetto completo. Cosa porterai:
• Laurea in finanza, contabilità, amministrazione aziendale, o simili.
• Esperienza di 7-10 anni nella leadership nella finanza o nella pianificazione aziendale, idealmente all’interno dei servizi industriali, ingegneristici o industriali.
• Forte capacità di gestione degli stakeholder con la capacità di influenzare i decisori senior.
• Eccellente capacità di comunicazione, traducendo complesse intuizioni finanziarie per il pubblico non finanziario.
• Avanzate competenze di MS Office; l'esperienza con Tagetik, Qlik Sense o sistemi ERP è un plus. Cosa ti offriamo
• Possibilità di avere un impatto significativo e guidare la strategia globale
• Ambiente di lavoro collaborativo e di supporto con un focus sull'innovazione e l'eccellenza.
• pacchetto di stipendio competitivo con benefici attraenti, regime pensionistico e programma di assistenza ai dipendenti.
• Eccitanti opportunità di crescita e di progresso professionale in un settore dinamico ed in evoluzione. Se sei un pensatore strategico con un forte acume aziendale e una passione per la collaborazione con la leadership per guidare le prestazioni, ci piacerebbe sentire da voi. Sulzer è un datore di lavoro pari opportunità. Crediamo nella forza di una forza lavoro diversificata e ci impegniamo ad offrire un ambiente di lavoro inclusivo. Siamo orgogliosi di essere riconosciuti come Top Employer 2026 in Brasile, Canada, Cina, Finlandia, Germania, Irlanda, Messico, Svizzera, Sud Africa, Regno Unito e Stati Uniti.
descriptionByLocale.en:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role We are looking for a commercially minded Senior Finance Business Partner to support our Services business across the UK & Nordics region. In this strategic role, you will combine deep financial expertise with strong business acumen to guide decision‑making, improve performance, and ensure financial insights are embedded at every level of the organisation. As a key partner to regional leadership, you will play a critical part in shaping the future direction of the business - helping drive sustainable growth, profitability, and operational excellence across multiple sites and service lines. The role can be based at our Birmingham or Leeds facilities. What you’ll do:
• Develop and review strategic plans at a regional, business unit, or divisional level, providing financial insights to support long-term growth and business strategies
• Establish and maintain comprehensive performance management frameworks for cross-functional and geographically diverse teams
• Manage major capital programs and oversee costing, pricing and profitability modelling.
• Partner with senior leaders, shaping strategy and ensuring financial alignment with business goals.
• Support project reviews and provide expert financial guidance through the full project lifecycle. What you’ll bring:
• Degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or similar.
• 7–10 years’ experience in leadership in finance or business planning, ideally within the industrial, engineering services or manufacturing sectors.
• Strong stakeholder‑management skills with the ability to influence senior decision‑makers.
• Excellent communication skills, translating complex financial insights for non‑financial audiences.
• Advanced MS Office skills; experience with Tagetik, Qlik Sense or ERP systems is a plus. What we offer you What we offer you:
• Chance to make a significant impact and drive the global strategy
• Collaborative and supportive work environment with a focus on innovation and excellence.
• Competitive salary package with attractive benefits, pension scheme, and employee assistance program.
• Exciting opportunities for professional growth and advancement in a dynamic and evolving industry. If you're a strategic thinker with strong business acumen and a passion for partnering with leadership to drive performance, we’d love to hear from you. Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.
descriptionByLocale.de:
Sulzer ist ein führendes Ingenieurunternehmen mit einem stolzen Innovationserbe. Begleiten Sie unser globales Team, um Ihr Know-how zu erweitern und innovative Lösungen zu entwickeln, die eine erfolgreiche und nachhaltigere Gesellschaft ermöglichen. Über die Rolle Wir suchen einen kaufmännischen Senior Finance Business Partner, der unser Services-Geschäft in der gesamten Region Großbritannien & Nordics unterstützt. In dieser strategischen Rolle kombinieren Sie fundierte finanzielle Expertise mit starkem Geschäft, um Entscheidungsfindung zu führen, die Leistung zu verbessern und die finanziellen Einsichten auf jeder Ebene der Organisation zu gewährleisten. Als zentraler Partner für die regionale Führung werden Sie eine wichtige Rolle bei der Gestaltung der zukünftigen Geschäftsrichtung spielen – dabei helfen Sie nachhaltiges Wachstum, Profitabilität und operative Exzellenz über mehrere Standorte und Servicelinien hinweg. Die Rolle kann auf unseren Einrichtungen in Birmingham oder Leeds basieren. Was du tun wirst:
• Entwicklung und Überprüfung strategischer Pläne auf regionaler, geschäftlicher oder sektoraler Ebene, die finanzielle Einblicke zur Unterstützung langfristiger Wachstums- und Geschäftsstrategien bieten
• Aufbau und Aufrechterhaltung umfassender Leistungsmanagement-Frameworks für funktions- und geographisch unterschiedliche Teams
• Verwalten von Großkapitalprogrammen und Überwachung der Kosten-, Preis- und Rentabilitätsmodellierung.
• Partner mit leitenden Führungskräften, der Gestaltung der Strategie und der Sicherstellung der finanziellen Ausrichtung mit Geschäftszielen.
• Projektrezensionen unterstützen und durch den gesamten Projektlebenszyklus eine kompetente Finanzberatung bieten. Was Sie bringen werden:
• Abschluss in Finanzen, Buchhaltung, Betriebswirtschaft oder dergleichen.
• 7–10 Jahre Erfahrung in der Führung in der Finanz- oder Geschäftsplanung, ideal im Industrie-, Engineering- oder Fertigungssektor.
• Starke Stakeholder-Management-Fähigkeiten mit der Fähigkeit, ältere Entscheidungsträger zu beeinflussen.
• Ausgezeichnete Kommunikationsfähigkeiten, die komplexe finanzielle Einsichten für nichtfinanzielle Publikum übersetzen.
• Erweiterte MS Office-Fähigkeiten; Erfahrung mit Tagetik, Qlik Sense oder ERP-Systemen ist ein Plus. Was wir Ihnen anbieten
• Chance, einen erheblichen Einfluss zu entfalten und die globale Strategie voranzutreiben
• Zusammenarbeit und unterstützendes Arbeitsumfeld mit Schwerpunkt Innovation und Exzellenz.
• Wettbewerbsfähiges Gehaltspaket mit attraktiven Leistungen, Pensionsregelung und Arbeitshilfeprogramm.
• Spannende Chancen für professionelles Wachstum und Wachstum in einer dynamischen und sich entwickelnden Industrie. Wenn Sie ein strategischer Denker mit starkem Business-Acumen und eine Leidenschaft für die Zusammenarbeit mit der Führung sind, um die Leistung zu steigern, würden wir gerne von Ihnen hören. Sulzer ist ein Arbeitgeber der Chancengleichheit. Wir glauben an die Stärke einer vielfältigen Belegschaft und sind verpflichtet, ein inklusives Arbeitsumfeld anzubieten. Wir sind stolz, als Top Employer 2026 in Brasilien, Kanada, China, Finnland, Deutschland, Irland, Mexiko, Schweiz, Südafrika, Großbritannien und den USA anerkannt zu werden.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Sulzer est une entreprise d'ingénierie de premier plan avec un fier héritage d'innovation. Rejoignez notre équipe mondiale pour développer votre expertise et développer des solutions innovantes qui permettent une société prospère et plus durable. Sur le rôle Nous sommes à la recherche d'un Senior Finance Business Partner pour soutenir nos activités de Services dans la région du Royaume-Uni et des Nordiques. Dans ce rôle stratégique, vous combinerez une expertise financière profonde avec un sens fort de l'entreprise pour guider la prise de décision, améliorer les performances et veiller à ce que les connaissances financières soient intégrées à tous les niveaux de l'organisation. En tant que partenaire clé du leadership régional, vous jouerez un rôle essentiel dans l'orientation future de l'entreprise - contribuant à stimuler la croissance durable, la rentabilité et l'excellence opérationnelle sur plusieurs sites et lignes de services. Le rôle peut être basé sur nos installations de Birmingham ou de Leeds. Ce que vous allez faire:
• Élaborer et examiner des plans stratégiques à l'échelle régionale, de l'unité opérationnelle ou de la division, en fournissant des informations financières pour appuyer la croissance à long terme et les stratégies d'affaires;
• Établir et tenir à jour des cadres complets de gestion des performances pour les équipes interfonctionnelles et géographiquement diverses
• Gérer les grands programmes d'immobilisations et superviser l'établissement des coûts, la tarification et la modélisation de la rentabilité.
• Établir des partenariats avec les hauts responsables, élaborer une stratégie et assurer l'alignement financier sur les objectifs opérationnels.
• Appuyer l'examen des projets et fournir des conseils financiers spécialisés tout au long du cycle de vie du projet. Ce que vous apporterez:
• Diplôme en finance, comptabilité, administration des affaires, ou similaire.
• 7-10 ans d'expérience en leadership en finance ou en planification d'entreprise, idéalement dans les secteurs industriel, des services d'ingénierie ou de la fabrication.
• Des compétences solides en gestion des parties prenantes avec la capacité d'influencer les décideurs supérieurs.
• Excellentes compétences en communication, traduisant des perspectives financières complexes pour les publics non financiers.
• Compétences avancées MS Office; l'expérience avec les systèmes Tagetik, Qlik Sense ou ERP est un plus. Ce que nous vous offrons
• La chance d'avoir un impact significatif et de conduire la stratégie mondiale
• Un environnement de travail collaboratif et solidaire mettant l'accent sur l'innovation et l'excellence.
• Ensemble de salaires concurrentiels comportant des prestations attrayantes, un régime de retraite et un programme d'aide aux employés.
• Possibilités de croissance et d'avancement professionnels dans une industrie dynamique et en évolution. Si vous êtes un penseur stratégique avec un sens fort des affaires et une passion pour le partenariat avec le leadership pour conduire la performance, nous aimerions entendre de vous. Sulzer est un employeur à chances égales. Nous croyons en la force d'un effectif diversifié et sommes déterminés à offrir un milieu de travail inclusif. Nous sommes fiers d'être reconnus comme l'un des meilleurs employeurs 2026 au Brésil, au Canada, en Chine, en Finlande, en Allemagne, en Irlande, au Mexique, en Suisse, en Afrique du Sud, au Royaume-Uni et aux États-Unis.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role El/La Junior Logistics Officer da soporte a las operaciones logísticas, incluyendo transporte, almacén y seguimiento de inventario, contribuyendo a garantizar un flujo eficiente de mercancías y materiales. Esta posición está orientada a profesionales junior que, bajo supervisión, aplican conocimientos teóricos básicos y desarrollan sus capacidades analíticas para la resolución de problemas, en colaboración con perfiles más senior. Responsabilidades principales
• Coordinar el transporte y la entrega de mercancías (nacional e internacional)
• Dar soporte a procesos de importación/exportación y asegurar el cumplimiento normativo

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Are you passionate about engineering and looking for an exciting opportunity to grow your career? We have a vacancy at our Wexford Service Centre for a Service Engineer to join our dedicated team. This role involves servicing and installing industrial, municipal, and commercial wastewater and stormwater pumping equipment. Key Responsibilities:
• Planned Inspections & Maintenance : Conduct effective planned inspections, fault finding, and maintenance of pumping equipment at customer sites.
• Ownership & Initiative : Take an active role and ownership of your responsibilities.
• Technical Expertise : Demonstrate strong skills in the service and repair of wastewater equipment.
• Reporting : Complete repair, service, and technical reports accurately and timely.
• Work Environment : Support the company's drive to create a better working environment.
• Client Communication : Communicate effectively and liaise with our client base to ensure satisfaction and service excellence. What We Are Looking For:
• Mechanical Ability : Strong mechanical skills and aptitude.
• Health & Safety : A dedicated approach to health and safety practices.
• Computer Skills : Proficiency in computer skills for reporting and communication.
• Interpersonal Skills : Strong interpersonal and customer service skills.
• Team Player : Ability to work alone or as part of a team, under pressure and to deadlines.
• Attention to Detail : Excellent attention to detail in all aspects of the role
• Applicants must hold a full manual driving license. Automatic‑only licenses cannot be accepted for this role. What we offer you
• A competitive salary based on experience.
• An interesting and rewarding position with opportunities for career progression.
• Performance related bonus scheme related to personal and company performance paid end Q1 each year.
• Defined contribution pension scheme.
• Access to our Employee Assistance Programme.
• Additional ongoing training to enhance your skills.
• A real opportunity to grow your career with a global engineering company
• Working hours Mon-Fri hours 8:30-5:00 with flexi time depending on workloads. Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Job Summary The Lean Manager is responsible for supporting the development and optimization of manufacturing processes. This role applies practical engineering knowledge to improve efficiency, quality, and safety in production environments. This job profile is intended for experienced professionals who apply practical knowledge of a job area and work independently with general supervision.
• At factory level, use lean manufacturing principles to achieve operational business targets.
• Assist supervisor and managers with action plan to achieve company objectives.
• Support manufacturing improvements through tooling and equipment design and equipment specification development.
• Improve On Time Delivery and Lead Times though the implementation of continuous flow, layout optimization, pull-system and speed up flows by coaching and/or leading lean principles workshops.
• Contribute to Factory Improvement Plan.
• Review continuous improvement plans and cost-saving projections, challenging where necessary, and provide feedback that drives additional improvements.
• Support continuous failure analysis in cooperation with affected areas.
• Improve Root Cause Analysis knowledge and utilization within the organization.
• Prepare and submit performance reports as required.
• Support corporate initiatives as defined by the Management Team.
• All employees are required to comply with all work instructions, policies, and posted signs or instructions regarding safety, including but not limited to proper use of Personal Protective Equipment. What we offer you
• Competitive Paid Time Off
• 12 Company Paid Holidays per year
• Annual Bonus Program
• Full Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits
• Company Paid Short Term and Long Term Disability, Company Paid Life Insurance
• 6% 401K or Roth Company Match with Immediate Vesting
• Company Paid Retirement Security Contributions following 1 year of employment
• Tuition Reimbursement/Educational Assistance
• Quarterly Gym Reimbursement Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Driven by growth in the FRC business, this role provides focused project delivery, improves cross-functional coordination, and protects margins across advanced turnkey projects ($1M–$5M) . Operating from our Cumming, GA facility, the Senior Project Manager serves as the technical execution hub—collaborating with Mechanical Design, Electrical, and Project Engineering departments to combine resources and deliver complete industrial process systems on time and within budget . Key Responsibilities:
• Synchronize workflows across mechanical design, electrical, and project engineering teams to efficiently output complex systems.
• Travel 30%–40% nationwide to supervise on-site installation work and assist with system commissioning and startup efforts.
• Review, interpret, and resolve discrepancies across technical specifications, customer layout drawings, orders, and P&IDs.
• Prepare engineering submittal documentation and directly address or rectify consulting engineer comments.
• Size, select, and generate purchase requisitions for system components including pumps, piping, tanks, and dosing equipment.
• Maintain sharp cost control, prepare project change orders, review vendor quotes, and negotiate with suppliers.
• Inspect fabricated equipment at manufacturing subcontractor facilities and record strict quality control documentation.
• Maintain close client communication regarding order status and support the sales process by answering technical engineering questions. Skills & Qualifications Minimum Requirements:
• Bachelor’s degree in Process, Chemical, or Mechanical Engineering (or 15 years of equivalent hands-on engineering experience).
• 6 to 10+ years of progressive project engineering and management experience, specifically within the industrial water and wastewater fields.
• High proficiency in reading P&IDs, checking layout drawings, and working within AutoCAD and standard office suites (Excel/Word).
• Legally authorized to work in the US with the flexibility to travel nationwide 30%–40% of the time
• Proven ability to manage multiple simultaneous projects, make quick decisions under pressure, and manage costs against budgets. Preferred Assets:
• Active PMP certification or Professional Engineer (PE) license.
• Prior experience with wastewater OEM technologies, industrial fluid handling, or onshore/offshore oil and gas process equipment.
• Familiarity with components like Dissolved Air Flotation (DAF) systems, mixers, biological systems, and valves.
• Existing OSHA 30 or OSHA 40 safety certifications (training provided as needed). What we offer you
• 15 days of paid time off and 12 company-paid holidays
• 401k plan with a 6% match
• Comprehensive health plan including medical, dental, vision, Life, short-term & long-term disability
• Health savings account matching
• Motivating wellness program
• Employee Assistance Program
• Paid paternal leave
• Gym reimbursement Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Job Summary The Lead (Field) Service Technician is responsible for installing, configuring, calibrating, and repairing technical products and systems at customer field locations. This role performs a variety of maintenance and technical support tasks and may provide onsite training to customer support personnel. This job profile is intended for experienced support-level staff that generally works autonomously and only requires closer supervision in non-routine situations. Résumé du poste Nous recherchons un Technicien Service passionné et expérimenté pour rejoindre notre équipe chez Sulzer Ensival Moret France SASU. Le titulaire du poste sera responsable de l'installation, de la maintenance, du diagnostic et de la réparation de nos équipements sur site et en atelier. Responsabilités du poste * Effectuer l'installation, la mise en service, la maintenance préventive et corrective des pompes, agitateurs et équipements rotatifs de Sulzer chez les clients. * Réaliser des diagnostics techniques précis et identifier les causes des pannes ou dysfonctionnements. * Rédiger des rapports d'intervention détaillés, incluant les actions réalisées, les pièces remplacées et les recommandations pour le client. * Assurer un support technique aux clients, les conseiller sur l'utilisation et l'entretien de leurs équipements. * Participer à la formation des clients sur l'utilisation et la maintenance de base des produits. * Respecter scrupuleusement les procédures de sécurité et les normes de qualité en vigueur. * Gérer les stocks de pièces détachées nécessaires aux interventions. * Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes commerciales et d'ingénierie pour améliorer la satisfaction client. * Participer aux interventions fixées
• Qualifications requises * Minimum 3 ans d'expérience en tant que Technicien Service ou dans un rôle similaire, idéalement dans le secteur des pompes, des équipements rotatifs ou de l'industrie lourde. * Diplôme technique (BTS, DUT) en maintenance industrielle, mécanique, électromécanique ou équivalent. * Solides compétences en mécanique, hydraulique, électricité et automatisme industriel. * Capacité à lire et interpréter des schémas techniques et électriques. * Maîtrise des outils de diagnostic et de mesure. * Permis de conduire valide (déplacements fréquents à prévoir). * Bonnes aptitudes relationnelles, sens du service client et autonomie. * Capacité à travailler de manière indépendante et en équipe. * Maîtrise du français (écrit et oral). Des connaissances en anglais technique seraient un plus. * Habilitations électriques à jour (B1V, BR, H0V) seraient un avantage. * Connaissance des produits Sulzer serait appréciée.
• What we offer you . Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

Responsabilités du poste * Effectuer l'installation, la mise en service, la maintenance préventive et corrective des pompes, agitateurs et équipements rotatifs de Sulzer chez les clients. * Réaliser des diagnostics techniques précis et identifier les causes des pannes ou dysfonctionnements. * Rédiger des rapports d'intervention détaillés, incluant les actions réalisées, les pièces remplacées et les recommandations pour le client. * Assurer un support technique aux clients, les conseiller sur l'utilisation et l'entretien de leurs équipements. * Participer à la formation des clients sur l'utilisation et la maintenance de base des produits. * Respecter scrupuleusement les procédures de sécurité et les normes de qualité en vigueur. * Gérer les stocks de pièces détachées nécessaires aux interventions. * Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes commerciales et d'ingénierie pour améliorer la satisfaction client. * Participer aux interventions fixées
• Qualifications requises * Minimum 3 ans d'expérience en tant que Technicien Service ou dans un rôle similaire, idéalement dans le secteur des pompes, des équipements rotatifs ou de l'industrie lourde. * Diplôme technique (BTS, DUT) en maintenance industrielle, mécanique, électromécanique ou équivalent. * Solides compétences en mécanique, hydraulique, électricité et automatisme industriel. * Capacité à lire et interpréter des schémas techniques et électriques. * Maîtrise des outils de diagnostic et de mesure. * Permis de conduire valide (déplacements fréquents à prévoir). * Bonnes aptitudes relationnelles, sens du service client et autonomie. * Capacité à travailler de manière indépendante et en équipe. * Maîtrise du français (écrit et oral). descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer è un'azienda ingegneristica leader con un orgoglioso patrimonio di innovazione. Unisciti al nostro team globale per far crescere la tua esperienza e sviluppare soluzioni innovative che permettano una società più prospera e sostenibile. Informazioni sul ruolo Stiamo cercando un Area Manager SEE (tutti i generi) per unirsi al nostro team in Austria. I tuoi principali compiti e responsabilità:
• Espansione e sviluppo del mercato nell'Europa sudorientale per i nostri gruppi di prodotti tecnicamente sofisticati
• Sviluppo di soluzioni sostenibili utilizzando l'intero portafoglio prodotti Sulzer
• Aumento della nostra presenza di mercato in nuovi segmenti
• Supporto ai nostri clienti chiave, nonché acquisizione di nuovi clienti, inclusa responsabilità di budget e costi
• Presentazione di offerte, negoziazione e completamento dei contratti, follow-up e supporto tecnico del Elaborazione degli ordini
• Formazione e presentazioni sui prodotti ai nostri rivenditori e distributori Cosa serve per avere successo in questo ruolo:
• Hai completato una formazione tecnica (apprendistato, HTL, FH, università), preferibilmente in ingegneria di processo, e idealmente hai già acquisito 2-3 anni di esperienza pratica in un'attività comparabile.
• Sei caratterizzato da un modo di lavorare strutturato, efficiente e orientato alle scadenze, combinato con un pensiero analitico e un alto livello di capacità di problem solving.
• Ottieni ottime capacità utente in MS Office, ma anche ottime competenze in tedesco e inglese e una patente di guida di classe B.
• La tua capacità di lavorare in squadra, affidabilità e capacità di lavorare sotto pressione completano il tuo profilo. Cosa ti offriamo Cosa ti offriamo noi:
• Libertà, fiducia e responsabilità per i compiti che ti vengono assegnati.
• Attraverso la nostra comunicazione aperta e onesta, basata su una gerarchia piatta e una cultura informale, creiamo un ambiente di lavoro piacevole e divertente.
• Le opportunità di formazione professionale e personale orientate alle necessità sono importanti per noi.
• Una retribuzione equa (corrispondente pagamento in eccesso al salario minimo secondo il contratto collettivo di lavoro € 3.329,62 a tempo pieno), materiali di lavoro di alta qualità, un pacchetto sociale attraente e la promozione della salute sul posto di lavoro sono tra i "must-have" per noi Sulzer è un datore di lavoro che offre pari opportunità. Crediamo nella forza di una forza lavoro diversificata e siamo impegnati a offrire un ambiente di lavoro inclusivo. Siamo orgogliosi di essere riconosciuti come Top Employer 2026 in Brasile, Canada, Cina, Finlandia, Germania, Irlanda, Messico, Svizzera, Sudafrica, Regno Unito e USA.

Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Job Summary The Sales Engineering Specialist supports the sales process by providing technical expertise and helping customers understand how products meet their needs. This role bridges the gap between engineering and sales, ensuring technical accuracy and customer satisfaction. This job profile is intended for professionals who apply advanced knowledge of a job area. Required to manage projects / processes independently with limited supervision. Typically coaches and reviews the work of lower level professionals. Résumé du poste Nous recherchons un Ingénieur Technico-Commercial passionné pour rejoindre notre équipe chez Sulzer Ensival Moret France SASU. Le titulaire du poste sera responsable de la promotion et de la vente de nos solutions techniques, ainsi que du développement et de l'entretien des relations clients sur un territoire défini. Responsabilités du poste * Développer et mettre en œuvre des stratégies de vente pour atteindre les objectifs de chiffre d'affaires et de marge. * Identifier et prospecter de nouveaux clients potentiels dans les secteurs d'activité ciblés par Sulzer Ensival Moret France SASU. * Comprendre les besoins techniques des clients et proposer des solutions adaptées parmi notre gamme de produits et services (pompes, agitateurs, etc.). * Préparer et présenter des propositions techniques et commerciales détaillées. * Négocier les contrats et les conditions de vente avec les clients. * Assurer un suivi régulier des clients existants pour garantir leur satisfaction et identifier de nouvelles opportunités. * Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes techniques et de production pour s'assurer que les solutions proposées sont réalisables et conformes aux attentes du client. * Participer à des salons professionnels et des événements de l'industrie. * Réaliser des rapports d'activité commerciale et des prévisions de vente. * Veiller à la conformité avec les politiques et procédures de l'entreprise.
• Qualifications requises * Diplôme d'ingénieur (BAC+5) en mécanique, électromécanique, génie des procédés ou domaine technique équivalent. * Expérience significative (minimum 3-5 ans) dans un rôle d'ingénieur technico-commercial, idéalement dans le secteur des équipements industriels, des pompes ou des machines tournantes. * Solides compétences techniques et compréhension des principes de fonctionnement des équipements industriels. * Excellentes compétences en communication, négociation et présentation. * Capacité à établir et entretenir des relations professionnelles solides. * Autonomie, proactivité et orientation résultats. * Maîtrise du français et de l'anglais (écrit et oral). * Permis de conduire valide et disponibilité pour des déplacements fréquents. * Maîtrise des outils informatiques (CRM, Pack Office).

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

About the role Lagerarbetare – Självständig roll med varierade arbetsuppgifter Är du en självgående person som trivs med ansvar och ett praktiskt arbete? Vi söker nu en engagerad lagerarbetare som vill arbeta i en varierad och viktig roll i vår organisation. Nordic Water är ett ingenjörsföretag med passion för att utveckla innovativa, tekniska lösningar och produkter som revolutionerar vår bransch. Vattenrening är ett snabbt växande område där Nordic Water är en av de största aktörerna på en global marknad. Våra kunder finns över hela världen och försäljningen sker både direkt och via distributörer. Vår försäljning består i allt från enskilda produkter till större projekt samt eftermarknad Om rollen Som lagerarbetare hos oss arbetar du självständigt och har en central funktion i att serva olika delar av organisationen. Rollen är bred och innefattar både traditionellt lagerarbete och mer praktiska moment såsom att bygga emballage. Arbetsuppgifter
• Hantering av material och gods i lager
• Serva interna avdelningar med material och leveranser
• Bygga och anpassa emballage för transport
• Truckkörning och lastning/lossning
• Administrativa uppgifter kopplade till lagerhantering Kvalifikationer
• Erfarenhet av lagerarbete
• Truckkort
• God förmåga att arbeta självständigt och ta eget ansvar
• Praktisk läggning med viss hantverkskunskap (t.ex. att bygga emballage) Meriterande
• Erfarenhet av arbete i ERP-system
• Särskilt meriterande är kunskap i Pyramid What we offer you

• Collea – Gratis pension och försäkringsrådgivning

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Job Summary The Lead (Field) Service Technician is responsible for installing, configuring, calibrating, and repairing technical products and systems at customer field locations. This role performs a variety of maintenance and technical support tasks and may provide onsite training to customer support personnel. This job profile is intended for experienced support-level staff that generally works autonomously and only requires closer supervision in non-routine situations. Résumé du poste** En tant que Technicien Service / Lead (Field) Service Technician, vous serez responsable de l'installation, de la maintenance, de la réparation et du dépannage de nos équipements sur les sites de nos clients en France. Vous agirez également en tant que référent technique pour l'équipe de service sur le terrain. Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Job Summary Communicates with internal and external customers to interpret customer requirements for aftermarket parts and service. Responsible for ensuring customers receive quality and professional service by providing adequate product support to the extent of attaining purchase orders and/or negotiating resolutions with customers as required. Have extensive knowledge on Service programs including; provides quotes (written and or verbal), discuss all programs to include Exchanges, Repairs, Parts, New Cutter Cartridges and proficient in processing the for mentioned programs in Visual ERP system. Principle Duties & Key Responsibilities
• Responsible for preparing parts quotes to meet both the customer’s needs and specific contractual requirements as determined by the purchase order.
• Specify correct part for previously supplied equipment.
• Prepare quotes, advise of pricing and required lead time for parts.
• Estimate cost and prices when actuals are not available, when necessary.
• Document quotes on system quote program and hard copy serial file when applicable.
• Effectively learn all aspects of Visual and Call Center and have a working knowledge to process orders; reference historical information, understand the Material Planning and Lead times.
• Responds to customers, sales managers and manufacturing representatives inquiries regarding status and delivery of orders/proposals.
• Understands and explains service programs and product warranty to end customers.
• Builds relationships to provide repeat business and excellent customer service.
• Performs other duties and special projects as assigned. Education, Experience, & Skills: Desirable: Associates Degree in a technical field or related field Required:
• High School Diploma
• 3+ years working in a Customer Service, help desk or troubleshooting environment
• Excellent oral and written communication skills.
• Ability to use technology and analysis tools (Excel, Outlook, web, databases)
• Highly self-motivated.
• Mechanical background/knowledge highly desirable
• Flexible, reliable, strong work ethic, dependable team player, positive, constructive attitude.
• Outstanding business etiquette skills. Rate: $28.00/hr - $29.50/hr What we offer you What we offer you: 401K plan with up to a 6% company match. 12 Paid Holidays. Paid Time Off Comprehensive benefits program including medical, dental, vision, life, short- and long-term disability. Health savings account with employer matching 4 weeks of paid parental leave Motivating wellness program Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.
